An SP MP asked 13 questions about a newspaper report describing a pattern of angry outbursts by the minister for Primary and Secondary Education, including whether the Chamber can monitor his self-improvement, staff departures, communication staffing and local journalism. The answer is a cross-reference to a separate letter published in response to a Woo request, so the substance of the answers is not given in this document.

The written questions from MP Kwint (SP) to the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Primary and Secondary Education about the report 'The rage attacks of Minister Wiersma are not an incident but a pattern' (2023Z09138) have been answered by means of a letter (Publication of documents following a Woo request regarding conduct of former Minister Wiersma).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) aan de Ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs over het bericht «De woedeaanvallen van Minister Wiersma zijn geen incident, maar een patroon» ( 2023Z09138 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande minister Wiersma

The SP MP Kwint asks the government about reports that Minister Wiersma behaved aggressively during a work visit and towards the Inspectorate of Education, including what the complaint and 'difficult conversations' involved and how the inspectorate's independence will be safeguarded. The minister refers the questions to a letter on Woo-published documents concerning Wiersma's conduct, without answering them substantively in this reply.

The written questions from MP Kwint (SP) to the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Primary and Secondary Education about various reports concerning Minister Wiersma (2023Z11630) have been answered by letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) aan de Ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs over diverse berichten aangaande Minister Wiersma ( 2023Z11630 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over onderzoek naar mogelijk discriminerende algoritmen door DUO

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked the minister about a possibly discriminatory DUO fraud-detection algorithm targeting students with a migration background, and about transparency, privacy checks, and oversight. The minister answered that an independent external investigation is announced, the algorithm is suspended pending results, DUO will only do random checks, and publication and the Algorithm Register are being pursued.
As indicated in my letter to the House of 21 June, I find these signals very disturbing and I have immediately announced an independent external investigation.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 21 juni vind ik deze signalen zeer verontrustend en heb ik direct een onafhankelijk extern onderzoek aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de invloed van het bedrijfsleven op het onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked how the government will limit business influence on academic research and teaching, ensure independence where companies fund chairs, and address gaps in universities' information on external funding. The minister answered that academic independence is the universities' own responsibility under supervision of supervisory boards, pointed to a UNL overview of external funding and a national register of ancillary activities due by end 2023, and said the broader funding review will not be adapted.
I consider it important that universities have current, complete and publicly accessible information on external funding of chairs.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat universiteiten informatie over externe financiering van leerstoelen actueel, volledig en publiek toegankelijk hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Jeugdzorgmanagers verdienen bij met handeltje in zzp’ers bij hun eigen werkgever'

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about reports that youth care managers profited from placing freelancers at their own employer, asking about sector revenues, flex work, dual shifts, iHUB's requests for extra funding, IGJ investigation and reporting of fraud. The state secretary gave detailed answers, acknowledged the need for more measures and an upcoming letter on private equity, but declined to judge the iHUB case or confirm whether a criminal complaint would be filed, referring to ongoing investigations and other bodies.
iHUB has indicated that it is currently still investigating the signals referred to in the article.
iHUB heeft laten weten dat zij momenteel de signalen nog onderzoeken waarin in het artikel naar gerefereerd wordt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat meer bevrijdingsfestivals niet door dreigen te gaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether the government would guarantee funding so that liberation festivals stay free and nationwide, and whether it would reconvene with the National Committee 4 and 5 May. The government answered that all festivals go ahead this year, that the festivals are decentralised and funded mainly by provinces and municipalities, that it sees no federal role, and that it will keep monitoring talks between the festivals and the National Committee.
Since the Liberation Festivals are organised at decentralised level, I see no role for central government in finding a solution.
Aangezien de Bevrijdingsfestivals decentraal worden georganiseerd, zie ik geen rol vanuit het Rijk weggelegd om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog altijd homoseksualiteit afwijzen en identiteitsverklaringen hanteren

MPs De Hoop, Kwint and Westerveld asked why reformed schools still use identity declarations rejecting homosexuality, and how this fits with the Inspectorate lifting extra supervision at Gomarus. Minister Wiersma answered that such declarations are not yet banned, that she finds conditioning admission on signing them undesirable, that the Inspectorate will intervene where pupils are rejected, and that she is studying how to implement the motions to ban such declarations, to be reported later this year.
I do not consider it desirable for schools to express themselves in this way and to make admission conditional on signing such a declaration.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat scholen zich op deze wijze uitdrukken en toelating voorwaardelijk maken op het ondertekenen van zo'n verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over initiatieven voor thuiszitters die dreigen te verdwijnen

MP Kwint asked the minister why initiatives supporting home-sitting children still face funding problems, why the motion giving the Inspectorate binding power to order school boards to cooperate has not been implemented, and how many initiatives take part in the experiment. The minister acknowledged the problem, rejected the Inspectorate option as inconsistent with its independent supervisory role, noted 39 of 41 experiment applications were approved, and committed to developing legislation within a year after the experiment's start.
As I already indicated in my answer to question 1, I am working on several tracks to improve the truancy approach.
Zoals ik al in mijn antwoord op vraag 1 aangaf werk ik op verschillende trajecten aan het verbeteren van de verzuimaanpak
Antwoord op vragen van Kwint over de gevolgen van gemeentelijke aanbestedingen voor kinderen in Maastricht

Kwint (SP) asked the state secretary about the consequences of Maastricht's youth care tender for children with complex needs at Bibihuis, which was not contracted, and about continuity of care and freedom of choice. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for continuity, that non-contracted providers must transfer care by 31 December 2023, that choice is offered as far as possible, and that the Rijk supervises continuity.
For children receiving care from non-contracted parties, such as Bibihuis, ongoing arrangements will where possible be completed in 2023 by the existing care provider.
Voor kinderen in zorg bij niet gecontracteerde partijen, zoals Bibihuis, geldt dat lopende arrangementen waar mogelijk in 2023 worden afgerond door de bestaande zorgaanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de Universiteit Leiden ‘slimme’ camera’s toch weer wil aanzetten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the University of Leiden's plan to re-activate smart sensor cameras that count people, raising privacy and safety concerns, with questions on purpose, data, costs, suppliers, other institutions, the DPIA and a shared guideline. The minister answered that the university has since decided not to use the cameras, that only anonymised person counts would be produced, that the DPIA is already public, and that no extra guideline is needed since the GDPR applies.
Universities and universities of applied sciences are not obliged to report the use or intended use of 'smart' cameras.
Universiteiten en hogescholen zijn niet verplicht tot het melden van het gebruik of het voornemen van gebruik van «slimme» camera’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het onderzoeksrapport van Casual Academy over precaire werkomstandigheden in het hoger onderwijs

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she would respond to a Casual Academy report on precarious, temporary contracts in Dutch higher education, including their effects on wellbeing, education quality, and whether universities deliberately deny staff permanent contracts. The Minister acknowledged the negative effects of temporary contracts, pointed to employer responsibility, planned monitoring, sector plan funding and CAO agreements, but declined to add structural new research or direct measures beyond these.
I do not recognise this, but if it happens, I consider that undesirable.
Ik herken dit niet, maar als het gebeurt, acht ik dat onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Westerveld en Kwint over Wob documenten aangaande de aanschaf van De vaandeldrager en de informatiepositie van de Staten-Generaal

MPs Teunissen, Westerveld and Kwint asked why the 2018 Call Option Agreement for De Vaandeldrager, the expired 165 million euro option, was not shared with parliament, why parts of documents were redacted, and whether parliament was fully informed before approving the purchase. The State Secretary answered that the option had already expired, the agreement was confidential and not a state contract, the redactions protected the state's negotiating position, and parliament was informed as fully as possible.
Therefore the Sale and Purchase Agreement will be placed confidentially for inspection shortly so committee members can still take note of it.
Daarom zal de Sale and Purchase Agreement op korte termijn vertrouwelijk ter inzage worden gelegd zodat de commissieleden hier alsnog kennis van kunnen nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Alkaya en Van der Plas over het bericht dat sluiting dreigt voor groen vmbo in Noord-Brabant wegens nieuwe aanbesteding van het openbaar vervoer

Three MPs asked whether the threatened closure of a green vocational school in Andel, linked to a provincial public transport tender cutting pupil buses, is acceptable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the closure threat is premature, that the province guarantees accessibility in its draft programme of requirements, and that it is for decentralised authorities to decide, so the government declines to intervene.
Since both municipalities and the province have their own democratically elected checks, the government exercises restraint here.
Aangezien zowel gemeenten als de provincie hun eigen democratisch verkozen controles hebben past de regering hier terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er onbevoegde docenten voor de klas staan

An SP MP asked the minister for a full overview of unqualified teachers in front of classes, the Inspectorate's stance on unqualified teachers, its enforcement, and when the teacher shortage will be solved. The minister gave trend figures showing 1.6-1.8% of primary teachers unqualified, noted that individual qualification progress is not tracked, said the Inspectorate will report on shortage impacts in 2024, and described its enforcement through regular supervision and remedial orders.
How many of the unqualified persons in the various sectors have since obtained a qualification cannot be traced one-to-one, because this data is not kept at individual level.

Hoeveel van de onbevoegde personen in de verschillende sectoren inmiddels een bevoegdheid hebben gehaald, is niet één op één te herleiden, omdat deze gegevens niet op individueel niveau worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Kwint en Van Nispen over de inzet van voorspellende algoritmes met betrekking tot kinderen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether the police would keep using the ProKid Plus algorithm to predict violent crime among children, and about oversight, data, safeguards and links to youth care and the Top400 approach. The minister answered that ProKid Plus was used only once in a 2016 Amsterdam trial, is no longer used, that a new police alerting system (ProKid 23-) is still under legal and ethical assessment, and described existing legal safeguards and oversight, while committing to no new structural rule changes.

The experiences with ProKid Plus underline the importance of good safeguards for the use of algorithms, to which the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, is giving extra attention.

De ervaringen met ProKid Plus onderstrepen het belang van goede waarborgen voor het gebruik van algoritmen, waar de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming extra aandacht voor heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over Bijlesbureaus die misbruik maken van ouders

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about commercial tutoring agencies pressuring parents, whether the Chamber's earlier motion against advertising via schools has been implemented, and what rules apply to tutors. The minister acknowledges the problem, promises stricter sector guidelines, a VOG requirement bill, and a monitor, but gives no firm timeline and has not answered the questions before the budget debate.
I will introduce a bill for internet consultation this winter stating that schools may only hire staff from providers of supplementary education who hold a certificate of conduct (VOG).
Daarom breng ik nog deze winter een wetsvoorstel in internetconsultatie waarin staat dat scholen alleen personeel van aanbieders van aanvullend onderwijs mogen inhuren die een VOG bezitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de berichten dat het aantal tijdelijke contracten in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs ondanks de krappe arbeidsmarkt stijgt

An MP asks the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about rising temporary contracts in education despite a tight labour market, including the share of temporary teaching contracts, the role of temp agencies, and the effect of NPO funds. The minister acknowledges temporary contracts are undesirable, promises agreements with social partners to raise permanent contracts and cites ongoing measures, but gives no binding commitment and attributes trends to pensions, new hires and falling pupil numbers.
My ambition is to give this concrete substance as soon as possible, preferably still this school year.
Mijn ambitie is om hier zo snel mogelijk, liefst nog dit schooljaar concreet invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat studentgegevens ondanks kritiek massaal in de cloud zijn gezet

An MP from the SP asks the Minister of Education whether storing student data with US tech companies' cloud datacenters, despite criticism, is acceptable given privacy and US access risks, and asks for alternatives and overviews of payments. The Minister answers that institutions are autonomous and responsible for risk assessments, that SURF supports Data Protection Impact Assessments, Privacy Shield has been invalidated and a new EU-US framework is being implemented, and that ending external storage is not a starting point, while no overview of payments or concrete alternatives is provided.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over jeugdbescherming

An SP MP asked the Minister about reports that children were placed out of home without a judge's involvement, and about inequality in child protection measures by income, education and migration background. The Minister explains that voluntary placements require parental consent and can be revisited, notes there is no reliable data on their number, and says the government will work on monitoring, clearer distinction between voluntary and coercive routes, and reducing unequal chances of child protection measures.
There is no reliable, meaningful data available on the number of voluntary out-of-home placements.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare, betekenisvolle gegevens over het aantal vrijwillige uithuisplaatsingen beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over berichten dat artiesten hun tour annuleren vanwege onder meer te hoge kosten

MP Kwint asked the state secretary how many Dutch artists have cancelled tours due to high costs, and about support for the pop sector, streaming revenue, insurance, energy costs and corona aid. The state secretary said the number of cancellations is unknown, pointed to new support schemes for pop artists and a tour desk, and deferred several structural questions to ongoing consultations and evaluations.
However, I am not aware of how many cases have led to the cancellation of tours by Dutch artists.
Het is mij echter niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen dit geleid heeft tot het annuleren van tournees van Nederlandse artiesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de pilots van de mbo-card met budget

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about which MBO schools take part in the pilot of the MBO Card with budget, whether all student types are reached, when results will be available, and whether the budget will be increased. The government answered that the card is open to all MBO schools and students, that participation is voluntary, that a monitoring and evaluation study (first results expected Q4 2023) will guide decisions on the pilot's continuation, and that the budget question will be decided on that basis.
Decisions on the further course of the pilot will be made by me on the basis of the monitoring and evaluation study carried out by research bureau ResearchNed.
Beslissingen over het verdere verloop van de pilot neem ik op basis van het monitorings- en evaluatieonderzoek dat wordt uitgevoerd door onderzoeksbureau ResearchNed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat uitgeverijen boeken pas leveren in november en dat tienduizenden mbo’ers nog zonder boeken zitten

An MP asked the education ministers about late delivery of textbooks by publishers to vocational (mbo) and secondary school students and whether publishers should be obliged to deliver. The ministers answered that logistics problems caused delays, that schools improvised with alternative materials, that digital licences were decoupled from print delivery, and that they expect parties to find solutions while market and Wet Gratis Schoolboeken issues will be addressed in a later policy response.
We therefore expect institutions to work with students, where possible, towards appropriate solutions to prevent and limit any learning delays.
Van instellingen verwachten wij daarom dat zij waar mogelijk samen met studenten tot passende oplossingen komen, om eventuele leerachterstanden te voorkomen en te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en El Yassini over het onderzoek dat JOB MBO deed naar ongebruikte leermiddelen

MPs Kwint and El Yassini asked the Minister of Education about a JOB MBO study showing 93 percent of vocational students must buy unused textbooks, and about compliance with the mandatory buy-back scheme. The minister reports that 43 of 57 institutions have a scheme, seven are working on one, and he commits to talks with the remaining institutions and to publicising the scheme, while declining for now a single universal scheme and stating he will consider legal obligation only if institutions fail to comply.
After inquiry it has emerged that 43 of the 57 vocational education institutions have established a scheme for unused learning materials.
Na uitvraag is gebleken dat 43 van de 57 mbo-instellingen een regeling voor ongebruikte leermiddelen hebben ingesteld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de in

MPs Leijten and Kwint asked what the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science has done after the childcare benefits scandal regarding hardship-causing laws, the review of such rules, its information management and handling of FOI requests. The minister answered that departmental inventories of hardship-causing regulations are underway under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, with results and timelines to be sent to parliament, and that chat-message retention follows government-wide rules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the delayed national baseline support norm for inclusive education, thuiszitters, leerlingenvervoer, and samenwerkingsverband financing. The Minister answers that the norm will first be developed for three support areas with delivery expected by early 2023, promises a bundled verzuim approach, a 2023 onderwijszorgarrangementen experiment with a doorzettingsmacht figure, but declines to give the Inspectie direct enforcement power as the motion requested.
As previously indicated to your House, this is not an appropriate solution.
Zoals al eerder aangegeven aan uw Kamer, is dit geen passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat het Ministerie van Financiën grote invloed had op hoogleraarsplek Erasmus Universiteit

SP MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked whether the Ministry of Finance sponsored and influenced a tax-law professorship at Erasmus University, and about transparency and the funding of special chairs. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that Finance initiated the sponsorship arrangement, a selection procedure with a Finance representative on the committee was held, transparency should be improved, and he will consult the sector on the balance between regular and special professors.
I will send the Chamber the overview as soon as it is ready.
Ik zal de Kamer het overzicht doen toekomen zodra het gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over gesponsorde hoogleraren

SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about externally funded endowed professorships at Dutch universities, including chairs financed by the Tax Authority and accounting firms that were not disclosed. The minister listed seven Finance-funded chairs, said the rules on private chairs are intended to guarantee independence, and promised an independent evaluation of the research integrity code while noting the Inspectorate has no legal basis to enforce on external funding.
As to the extent to which accounting firms have been open about matters, I cannot make a statement.
Over de mate waarin accountantskantoren openheid van zaken hebben gegeven kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Wel minimum inkomen, uitgesloten van compensatie: de eindjes aan elkaar knopen is voor studenten nu wel heel lastig'

MPs Kwint asked the ministers about reports that students struggle to make ends meet and whether government will raise support, cap student loan interest, extend energy allowances and housing benefit, or address student housing costs. The government answered that the basic grant returns from 2023/2024, the minimum wage will rise, a national student housing action plan is being drafted, and it sees no room to increase funding or extend housing benefit to rented rooms for now.
I am always willing to enter into discussion with students.
Ik ben altijd bereid om in gesprek te gaan met studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit Leiden sponsoring hoogleraar door Belastingdienst verzweeg

MPs Kwint and Jasper van Dijk asked why Leiden University did not disclose that a professorship in tax law was funded by the Tax Authority, and what sanctions or transparency measures would follow. Minister Dijkgraaf acknowledged the lack of openness, said the university has adjusted its disclosures and is reviewing the case, but stated the ministry cannot impose sanctions and promised a letter to parliament on registration of side activities.
The ministry does not have the power to impose sanctions.
Het ministerie heeft niet de mogelijkheid sancties op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint over het bericht 'stagiair wordt te vaak ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht

An SP MP asks the ministers whether internships are misused as cheap labour, whether a minimum internship allowance and enforcement are needed, and about internship shortages and 'green plucking' of students. The minister says employers are not legally required to pay internship allowances, promises talks with education and employers, notes the Labour Inspectorate can fine employers for regular work done by interns, and says the government sees no role in covering employers' costs.
The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate checks whether interns are improperly deployed and can fine a company if this is the case.
De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie controleert of er sprake is van oneigenlijke inzet van stagiairs en kan een boete uitdelen aan een bedrijf als hier sprake van is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat Poetin de RUG noopt tot uitbreiden blended onderwijs

MP Kwint asked whether the RUG's plan to expand blended and hybrid teaching because of energy prices from the war in Ukraine was justified, and whether it conflicts with a motion making in-person teaching the norm. The minister answered that institutions decide their own teaching format based on their educational vision, that blended learning was already part of the RUG's 2021 strategy, and that there is no reason to contact the RUG.
Educational institutions are themselves responsible for their educational vision and quality.
Onderwijsinstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de onderwijsvisie en – kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Ons belastinggeld komt niet goed in de klas terecht'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether the 300 million euros for reducing teacher workload in secondary education will reach teachers quickly, how spending will be monitored, and whether team-level or individual-level measures are preferred. The minister answered that cao agreements require school boards to pass the funds to schools, involve staff in spending decisions, and that an evaluation of the workload funds will be started.
The evaluation research will show whether the funds have led to the desired effect.
Uit het evaluatieonderzoek zal blijken of de middelen tot een gewenst effect hebben geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over het bericht van NOS van 6 april jl. waaruit blijk dat geen enkele universiteit de registratie van bijbanen van hoogleraren op orde heeft

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how universities can have unregistered side jobs of professors, and what will be done to keep registers accurate and public. The minister acknowledges the problem, says universities are responsible for registration, is talking with UNL about improvements including a possible central public register, and promises a letter to parliament this autumn.
I will send your House a letter this autumn on the state of affairs regarding the registration of side activities.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit najaar een brief sturen over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de registratie van nevenwerkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Maatoug over het bericht dat “investeerders hun greep op de kinderopvang vergroten"

Two MPs asked the minister whether investors' growing control over childcare is desirable, whether profit-focused ownership harms quality and equal opportunity, how decisions on takeovers and parental influence work, and what safeguards are needed before childcare becomes largely subsidised in 2025. The minister says quality is the primary concern, acknowledges worries about private equity, and promises a government study into financing forms, profit-taking and possible profit caps, but defers concrete measures until that study is complete.
That is why I announced, in answer to parliamentary questions from members Kathmann and Maatoug, that I will study the role of the different financing forms in childcare.
Daarom heb ik aangekondigd in antwoord op Kamervragen van de leden Kathmann en Maatoug dat ik de rol van de verschillende financieringsvormen in de kinderopvang ga onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat nog steeds niet alle middelbare scholen duidelijk maken dat de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage echt vrijwillig is

Two MPs asked the Minister why many secondary schools still do not clearly state that the voluntary parental contribution is optional and that children may not be excluded from activities if parents do not pay. The Minister agrees this is unacceptable, reports 88 Inspectorate signals since August 2021 with remedy orders and possible fines, and announces a new communication campaign and extra Inspectorate attention.
The Inspectorate is giving extra attention to the voluntary parental contribution in its supervision this year.
De Inspectie heeft in haar toezicht dit jaar extra aandacht voor de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat de overheidswebsite plat lag vanwege run op aanvraag duizend euro

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked why the STAP training-budget website crashed on opening, whether demand was foreseeable, how many people were blocked, why there was no transition rule for people who started retraining before 1 March 2022, and how training providers are admitted to the register. The ministers acknowledge technical problems and UWV's capacity shortfall, promise improvements and monthly monitoring, but do not give exact figures for blocked applicants and largely explain the existing selection and register procedures.
It is difficult to estimate how many people were unable to submit an application due to the technical problems and rapid exhaustion of the budget.
Het is lastig om in te schatten hoeveel mensen door de technische problemen en snelle uitputting geen aanvraag hebben kunnen doen.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat schoolbesturen jarenlange partnerschappen sluiten met commerciële uitzendbureaus voor de inhuur van flexibel onderwijspersoneel

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about school boards outsourcing flexible teacher staffing to commercial temp agencies at high cost, and whether this conflicts with a motion to limit agency use. The minister answered that agency staffing is sometimes needed, that regional procurement can control costs, that stricter rules for private partnerships will be drafted with sector councils, and that data on agency spending and teacher numbers are not available.
This precise information is not available.
Deze precieze informatie is niet voorhanden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en De Hoop over de aangenomen motie van de leden Kwint en Van den Hul over het in kaart brengen van belemmeringen voor zwangerschapsverlof in het hoger onderwijs (Kamerstuk 35 252, n

MPs Kwint and De Hoop asked whether maternity leave for students in higher education would be legally anchored, and how many institutions had adopted the handreiking for pregnant students. The minister replied that institutions are free in how they implement the guidance, several have adopted it or plan to, that few students report problems, and that an official review of legal anchoring is still ongoing.
The previously announced civil-service exploration into anchoring their legal position is still ongoing.
De eerder aangekondigde ambtelijke verkenning naar de verankering van hun rechtspositie is nog gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de Nederlandse Livemuziek Monitor 2008-2019

An SP MP asks the state secretary about the Dutch live music monitor 2008–2019, the implementation of the Beckerman motion on the pop sector, plans to strengthen pop after the pandemic, and whether the Kwint initiative note on pop will be implemented. The state secretary welcomes the monitor, reports ongoing talks with city culture regions, promises a letter on culture recovery, and says several proposals from the note fit current policy, with a plan of action with ACCT and an upstream-scheme extension being considered.
I am currently working on a letter setting out my plans for the recovery of the cultural sector.
Momenteel werk ik aan een brief waarin ik mijn plannen voor het herstel van de culturele sector uitwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Westerveld en Kwint over de gevolgen van de veranderende bekostigingssystematiek voor het primair onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the new education funding system from 2023 would force primary school boards to draw down reserves by about 500 million euro, and whether this would reduce money for education. The minister answered that the change is a purely accounting adjustment with 100% of funding still paid out, that the inspectorate will treat affected boards leniently for five years, and that no real funds are lost.
As indicated, this is a technical, accounting exercise and in practice no money disappears from school boards.
Zoals aangegeven gaat het hier om een technische, boekhoudkundige exercitie en verdwijnt er feitelijk geen geld bij besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over 'een kinderopvangbedrijf dat betaalde uren kinderopvang niet levert, maar ook niet compenseert'

An MP asks why a childcare provider lets prepaid hours lapse without compensation or extension, and whether this takes state subsidy for undelivered services. The minister answers that the arrangement is a private contract matter, that the provider does incur costs when a child is absent, and that the ministry has no role in such disputes.
How childcare hours that could not take place are handled is set out under private law in the contract the parent and the childcare provider agreed before care began.

Hoe omgegaan wordt met kinderopvanguren die niet hebben kunnen plaatsvinden is privaatrechtelijk vastgelegd tussen de ouder en de kinderopvangorganisatie in het contract dat ze voor de start van de opvang overeen zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat vele tienduizenden Nederlandse studenten maandenlang gemakkelijk te hacken zijn geweest

MP Kwint (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether, and how, students forced to use insecure online proctoring software (Proctorio) could be protected, and what the government would do about privacy and the pending motions. The minister answered that he lacks data on student numbers, that the government does not decide on the software itself, that existing privacy rules suffice, and that proctoring will be scaled back with a vision to follow after the evaluation.
I have no insight into the number of students who used the Proctorio software.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal studenten dat gebruik heeft gemaakt van de software van Proctorio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en El Yassini over het bericht dat een kwart van de scholen geen terugkoopregeling heeft

MPs Kwint and El Yassini asked the Minister of Education about reports that only 22% of schools publicly post information on the buy-back scheme for unused learning materials, and how schools define unused materials and why unused materials remain on lists. The minister acknowledges the transparency concern, notes 14 of 59 institutions published the scheme online, promises talks with the sector and MBO Raad, and states that definitions and list cleaning are primarily for institutions themselves.
In response to the signal JOB gives, I will discuss this with the sector.
Naar aanleiding van het signaal dat JOB geeft, zal ik met de sector hierover in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het goochelen met cijfers over vaste contracten in het onderwijs

Kwint and Westerveld ask why the minister presented figures on permanent contracts for recently graduated teachers as a sweeping increase, omitting that the figures include temporary contracts with prospects of permanence and cover only teachers six months after graduation. The minister answers that the figures are accurate, that the sample is defined as recent graduates working six months after graduating, and that combining permanent and temporary-with-prospect contracts is an essential nuance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat met corona besmette studenten toch naar VU gaan door aanwezigheidsplicht

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that COVID-positive students still have to attend VU lectures because of mandatory attendance rules, and what options students have. The minister said institutions should find tailored solutions, that the VU has relaxed attendance requirements and offers consultation routes, and that she is discussing the issue with education bodies and will clarify institutions' responsibility in a service document.
It is up to the institution to discuss a suitable solution with the student(s).
Het is aan de instelling om met de student(en) in gesprek te gaan over een passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over het ambtshalve toevoegen van een advocaat door een rechter aan een moeder die niet zelfredzaam is

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court that appointed a lawyer ex officio for a mother who could not look after her own interests, despite no statutory basis, and how such cases should be handled. The minister welcomed the outcome, pointed to early-signalling efforts, said costs fall on the legal aid budget, and declined to create a statutory basis for now, awaiting a WODC study due spring 2022.
I do not consider a statutory amendment to create an ex officio legal aid assignment for interested parties who are not self-reliant to be appropriate at this time.
Ik acht een wetswijziging om een ambtshalve last tot toevoeging te creëren aan belanghebbenden die niet zelfredzaam zijn, nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over de aanhoudingen van journalisten tijdens demonstraties

Two SP MPs asked why three journalists were detained at climate demonstrations and what rules protect press identity during arrests. The Justice Minister answered that press cards carry rights but also duties, that the police apply internal rules, that the arrests were lawful and no prosecution followed, and that the issue will be raised in the PersVeilig steering group.
In the aforementioned cases it turned out that the arrest was lawful.
In de voornoemde zaken is gebleken dat de aanhouding rechtmatig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de compensatie van de eigen bijdrage voor kinderopvang vanwege de sluiting door Corona

An SP MP asked whether all parents using childcare, with or without childcare allowance, were compensated for their own contribution during the Covid closures, and whether parents not receiving childcare allowance for certain hours were compensated. The Staatssecretaris explained that parents with allowance received a SVB compensation based on allowance data, that some parents received substantially less, and that the government will revise the scheme and not appeal court rulings.
The State Secretary for Finance – Tax and Customs Administration and I have decided to revise the compensation scheme and not to appeal the court rulings mentioned above.

De Staatssecretaris van Financiën – Toeslagen en Douane en ik hebben besloten om de tegemoetkomingsregeling te herzien en voorts om geen hoger beroep in te stellen tegen de hierboven bedoelde rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kwint over het weglekken van jeugdzorggelden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about profit-making and money flows in youth care, prompted by a Follow the Money investigation, and asked whether national oversight and data access should be strengthened. The State Secretary acknowledged high margins at some providers and pointed to municipalities' contracting and oversight powers, existing public financial reporting, planned data work in the Hervormingsagenda, a new notification requirement from 2022, and pending legislation (WIBZ) on profit distribution, while not committing to new national investigations.
Municipalities, as purchasing parties, can include conditions and hard criteria in their contracts and even in ordinances to limit profits.
Gemeenten kunnen als inkopende partij in hun contractering en zelfs in verordeningen randvoorwaarden en harde criteria opnemen om winsten te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat TopTicketShop valse kaartjes verkoopt

An SP MP asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister whether TopTicketShop sells fake tickets, what steps follow the adopted Kwint motion on secondary ticket resale, and whether a Dutch law banning resale profiteering is needed. The minister replied that fraud is for criminal investigation or the consumer authority, that a resale ban would not work so a consumer awareness campaign was chosen (postponed due to COVID), that EU rules apply from May 2022, and saw no reason for a new law now.
I see no reason for this at this moment.
Ik zie hiervoor op dit moment geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint en Van Meenen over De Monnikskap

MPs asked why the Minister had not kept parliament informed about De Monnikskap, an inclusive education unit facing closure with the Dominicus College, and about the phase-out of its supplementary funding. The Minister answered that the new circumstances arose only recently, that the board guarantees De Monnikskap will continue after 2024, and that the supplementary funding will be phased out from 2023 to 2027.
Only very recently have new circumstances come to light, namely the planned closure of the Dominicus College, which prompted me to inform you.
Er zijn pas zeer recent nieuwe omstandigheden naar voren gekomen, namelijk over de voorgenomen sluiting van het Dominicus College, die aanleiding waren om u te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat student Peter kanker kreeg, maar beurs volledig moet terugbetalen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Education why a seriously ill student must repay his study grant, whether DUO inspectors and their procedures are proportionate, and how DUO will avoid such hardship in future. The minister expresses sympathy, reports that DUO will waive repayment for the period of illness and moderate the fine, and states that DUO will examine how to ease the procedure for students whose parents are absent, while defending its controls against misuse.
For completeness, I note that the first case is still pending before the court on appeal.
Voor de volledigheid vermeld ik dat de eerstgenoemde zaak nog voor de rechter dient in hoger beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat honderden studenten corona-compensatie mislopen, vaak buiten eigen schuld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education why hundreds of students miss the corona compensation through no fault of their own, including those graduating after 31 August 2021, students who started a master after a pre-master, and whether the scheme should be extended to 31 January 2022. The Minister defended the existing scheme as fair within financial limits, rejected extension and pre-master coverage, and pointed to halved tuition fees for students still studying this year.
The LSVb proposal would mean students receive two allowances in the period up to 31 January 2022, which I find undesirable.
Het voorstel van de LSVb houdt in dat studenten in de periode tot 31 januari 2022 twee tegemoetkomingen zouden ontvangen, dat vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat kaartverkoop theaters ver achter blijft bij 2019

MP Kwint (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how to respond to reports that theatre ticket sales lag far behind 2019 levels, and what it means for makers, venues and staff, and the effect of the corona pass and 75% capacity limits. The minister says it is too early to draw conclusions, will monitor developments with the Taskforce, and is setting up a EUR 15 million subsidy scheme via the Fonds Podiumkunsten for venues affected by capacity limits.
To offer venues and festivals affected by the 75% capacity limit a financial contribution, I am currently working on a subsidy scheme to be implemented by the Fonds Podiumkunsten.
Om podia en festivals die te maken hebben met de capaciteitsbeperking van 75% een tegemoetkoming te bieden, werk ik nu aan een subsidieregeling die uitgevoerd zal worden door het Fonds Podiumkunsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Omtzigt, Azarkan, Inge van Dijk, Arib en Ceder over het bericht ‘Uithuisplaatsingen onder gedupeerden toeslagenaffaire’

MPs asked the government about reports that over 1,100 children of parents harmed by the childcare benefits scandal were placed out of home, requesting the grounds, the CBS data scope, plans to return children and a dedicated helpline. The minister answered that a causal link is hard to establish, that CBS data cover 2015–2020, that no central record of placement grounds exists, and that a plan for affected families will be sent to parliament as soon as possible.
No, this specific information is not available. There is no central registration of the grounds on which an out-of-home placement is ordered.
Nee, deze specifieke informatie is niet beschikbaar. Er is geen centrale registratie van de gronden op basis waarvan een uithuisplaatsing wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat Daan niet met het taxibusje naar speciale school mag, omdat de gemeente vindt dat hij wel met de bus kan

An MP asked the minister why municipality Woudenberg refused a taxi bus for a ten-year-old with special needs despite parents' and school concerns, and questioned its reliance on a repeat independent assessment and its finances. The minister said the municipality has now agreed to transport the child by taxi bus this school year, that municipalities bear the legal duty to provide appropriate transport, and that finances should not decide the matter, but declined to commit to a general rule making the school admission decision automatically entitle pupils to transport.
For me it is paramount that pupils who are entitled to pupil transport also receive it, and that the municipality provides for this.
Voor mij staat namelijk voorop dat leerlingen die recht hebben op leerlingenvervoer, dat ook krijgen en de gemeente daarin voorziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over een burgemeester die een boek schreef over kritische burgerjournalisten

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked ministers about a mayor who wrote a book criticising critical citizen journalists, and about local government support for independent local journalism. The government answered that local journalism is essential, that no protocol exists for mayors, that municipalities are encouraged to develop media policy, and that the data available does not show local media budget cuts or communication spending.
No, there is no such protocol.
Nee, er is geen dergelijk protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Kwint over signalen die bij de SP zijn binnengekomen over hoge schoolkosten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that a vocational college requires students to bring flowers, vases and other materials costing up to 40 euro a week, and what alternatives exist. The Minister answered that these items fall under the basic equipment the school must provide free of charge, pointed to a collective agreement allowance and a student fund, and said supervision runs through the Inspectorate and the Taskforce schoolkosten.
students at Yuverta mbo Den Bosch are asked to bring their own materials, including flowers, vases and bowls
Yuverta mbo Den Bosch van studenten gevraagd wordt dat zij zelf hun materialen, waaronder bloemen, vazen en schalen, dienen mee te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over kinderen in jeugdzorg vanwege de gevolgen van de toeslagaffaire

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about children placed in youth care as a consequence of the childcare benefits scandal, including how many families are affected, compensation, and how to prevent further out-of-home placements. The State Secretary acknowledged the signals, said the number is not yet known and is being mapped, pointed to financial compensation and the 'Leven op de rit' programme, and promised further information to parliament in November 2021 on a child and family protection scenario.
It is currently not known how many families of affected parents have had or are having an out-of-home placement or return.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen van gedupeerde ouders te maken hebben (gehad) met een uithuisplaatsing of terugplaatsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het testevenement 538 Oranjefeest

Two MPs asked the government about the 538 Oranjefeest test event, including resale of tickets at high prices, subsidies, selection, health-worker staffing and ticket fraud controls. The minister answered that the event was a research pilot, that the ticket auction was not intended and gave a wrong impression, that tests were required before entry and recommended afterwards, and that a national resale ban was not effective, pointing to a pending EU-based consumer law implementation.
The cabinet financed the research carried out at the field tests.
Het kabinet financierde het onderzoek dat wordt gedaan bij de praktijktesten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse universiteiten weer overspoeld worden door buitenlandse studenten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked the ministers about students sleeping in tents, emergency shelters and on couches because of the student housing shortage, and what will be done for the coming academic year. The government answered that it is working with municipalities and housers through the national student housing action plan, that universities are not primarily responsible for housing, and that it cannot easily quantify homeless students.
It is difficult to establish how many students precisely have housing problems.
Het is moeilijk na te gaan hoeveel studenten precies problemen hebben met huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het lerarentekort een basisschool dwingt tot het vormen van een megaklas

An MP asked the minister about a primary school forced to merge two groups into a 52-pupil class due to teacher shortages, and about the broader teacher shortage, class size limits, unqualified teachers and monitoring. The minister said the school chose a temporary solution with extra support staff, rejected a national maximum class size, and described the measures taken and ongoing efforts while acknowledging the shortage remains high.
These are often temporary solutions that are not registered nationally.
Dit zijn vaak tijdelijke oplossingen, die niet landelijk geregistreerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het artikel 'Het grootste onderwijsprobleem is niet het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about the rapid growth of commercial education firms, whether they are linked to learning losses from school closures, how schools spend National Education Programme funds on external providers, and whether marketisation and lump-sum funding have weakened government control and accountability in education. The minister answered that the CBS count is broad and not directly tied to funded schooling, that no direct link to COVID closures is visible, that schools' use of external providers is being monitored, and that accountability for lump-sum funds is being strengthened, but declined to answer the general question on education policy over 30 years.
The research into the scale of supplementary and private education will be repeated in 2022.
Het onderzoek naar de omvang van aanvullend en particulier onderwijs zal in 2022 worden herhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over rammelende feitenonderzoeken in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Van Nispen asked about unreliable fact-finding reports in youth protection, including a reported case of a wrongly placed child and complaints procedures. The Minister of Justice replied that the case did not rest on a wrong file, that a Dutch action plan on fact-finding runs to end 2021, that the existing checks are adequate in his view, and that a future youth protection scenario is under consultation.
Imposing a youth protection measure may under no circumstances be based on faulty fact-finding.
Het opleggen van een jeugdbeschermingsmaatregel mag overigens nooit gebaseerd zijn op foutief feitenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat mbo-instellingen ook na corona verder gaan met online onderwijs, tegen de wil van de Kamer

An SP MP asked the Education Minister whether she knew of vice-institutions continuing online education against parliament's wishes, what steps she had taken on the Kwint motion requiring physical education as the norm, and how students who need distance learning would be supported. The minister said she is evaluating the measures before reporting, leaves the choice of distance learning to teaching teams and institutions, and promises case-by-case support and an evaluation to parliament in spring 2022.
I am awaiting this evaluation, and will then inform the House of Representatives about further implementation of the motion.
Ik wacht deze evaluatie af, en zal daarna de Tweede Kamer informeren over het verder uitvoeren van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het kabinet ondanks Kamermeerderheid nog geen verbod op homogenezing wil

An SP MP asks why the cabinet will not criminalise conversion therapy (homogenezing) despite a parliamentary majority, what concrete action it will take, and whether a code of conduct and support centres are enough. The minister replies that a broad exploration of effective measures, including a possible legal ban, will be carried out with results expected in early 2022, while a code of conduct and support points are being developed.
For that reason the cabinet will carry out a broad exploration of possible effective further measures, including the option of some form of legal ban.
Om die reden zal het kabinet een brede verkenning uitvoeren naar mogelijke, effectieve nadere maatregelen, inclusief de optie voor enige vorm van wettelijk verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over herkansingen in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

MPs Westerveld, Van Meenen and Kwint asked about staatsexamen retake options for vso (special secondary education) pupils, examiner shortages and recruitment. Minister Slob answered that no exams were cancelled for lack of examiners, that about 450 examiners were recruited mostly to replace last-minute withdrawals, and that a retake option for a specific subgroup will be investigated and reported in autumn.
No, no exams were cancelled due to insufficient qualified examiners.
Nee, er zijn geen examens afgezegd wegens onvoldoende bevoegde examinatoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de coronamaatregelen in het onderwijs en de start van het nieuwe studiejaar

MP Kwint (SP) asked the ministers how the government prioritises reopening schools and universities for the new school year, and about ventilation, vaccination, self-testing and quarantine rules for children. The ministers answered that in-person education has been a top priority, that the 1.5-metre rule was lifted in higher education, and that additional funding for ventilation and vaccination outreach has been arranged.
The monitoring study into the use of self-tests in education is still ongoing.
Het monitoringsonderzoek naar het gebruik van de zelftesten in het onderwijs loopt op dit moment nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de sluiting van de lerarenopleiding aan de Hogeschool Inholland

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education about three students of Hogeschool INHolland who cannot obtain their teaching diploma after the closure of the teacher-training programme, including whether a C1 English level should suffice and whether a solution could be presented. The Minister replied that the students had until 31 August 2021 to finish, that the C2 CPE requirement follows the national knowledge base, and that no intervention is possible, while acknowledging regret for the students.
I consider that the institution has offered the students sufficient opportunities to complete their studies before 31 August 2021.
Ik vind dat de instelling de studenten voldoende mogelijkheden heeft geboden om de studie vóór 31 augustus 2021 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Westerveld en Kwint over het LinkedIn-bericht ‘Grote flyeractie in boekenpakketten!’ van 'Mr. Chadd'

MPs Segers, Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about a LinkedIn post advertising paid homework coaching via flyers in publicly funded school book packages, and whether such advertising, its money flows and shadow education in general are acceptable. The minister confirmed awareness, said schools choose their suppliers, acknowledged risks to equal opportunity, referred to a planned repeat study and a spring 2022 update, and said the distributor's payments were unknown to him.
This is a matter between the distributor and the provider.
Dit is een zaak tussen de distributeur en de aanbieder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over de vrijwillige of verplichte ouderbijdrage voor kosten voor overblijven op school

Two MPs asked the minister whether parents must pay for lunch-break supervision at school, whether a court ruling affects this, and whether guidelines should be tightened. The minister answered that the ruling confirms current rules, that the school followed consultation and consent procedures, and that no new guidelines are needed.
I see no reason to tighten the rules on whether a compulsory parental contribution may be requested.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de regels over het al dan niet mogen vragen van een verplichte ouderbijdrage aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Kwint over de situatie op het Tjalling Koopmans College in Hurdegaryp en de Scholen voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs

MPs Van Meenen and Kwint asked the minister about problems at schools run by SvPO, including a board chair lending foundation money for family mortgages, teacher suspension and high teacher turnover. The minister said the inspectorate is supervising, that financial oversight is being tightened and repair orders issued, but could not act directly on private foundation loans and left several follow-ups to the inspectorate.
I do not have that possibility myself either.
Ik heb die mogelijkheid zelf ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Neef en Ouwehand over het manifest toegankelijke festivals dat op 8 juni jl. is gelanceerd

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, VVD and PvdD asked ministers whether festivals should be more accessible for people with disabilities under the UN convention, why many are not, and whether the government will engage with the sector and international examples. The minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen programme addresses accessibility, that gemeenten can set accessibility conditions in event permits, and that the government will raise the manifesto with VNG and VNO-NCW but gave no concrete new measures.
I will put this manifesto and the accessibility of festivals and events on the agenda in the talks I hold with the VNG and VNO-NCW.
Ik zal dit manifest en de toegankelijkheid van festivals en evenementen agenderen tijdens de gesprekken die ik voer met de VNG en VNO-NCW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er vrees is voor stortvloed aan eigen bijdragen van studenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the regulation on other student contributions in higher education would lead to many extra fees, how 'costs related to the nature of a programme' are defined, how fees are communicated, whether students should pay for a VOG or sports medical advice, and whether the regulation should be withdrawn or fees capped. The minister answered that the regulation clarifies existing practice, that only costs not replaceable by a free alternative may be charged, that VOG and medical advice costs may be borne by students, and that the regulation will not be withdrawn, with caps applying only to certain items.
The regulation will not be withdrawn.
De regeling zal niet worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over onrecht in de jeugdbeschermingsketen en een verborgen gehouden onderzoek van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked about alleged injustice in the youth protection chain and an unpublished ministry review on a father's case. The Minister answers that complaint and appeal routes exist, the action plan on fact-finding continues, and the department did not share the review because the problem was already being addressed and it cannot judge individual cases.

Given the nature of the review and because it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was no reason to inform me about the review and therefore also not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en doordat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over ernstig dementerenden die gedwongen moeten vertrekken uit een kleinschalige woonvorm

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked the Minister of Health why residents with severe dementia must leave a small-scale care home (Het Kristal, Apeldoorn) because the operator says it is loss-making, and whether the ministry will intervene. The minister replied that closure is primarily the responsibility of the care provider and the care office, that the Inspectorate has no concerns about quality, that the ministry has contacted both parties and asked to be kept informed, and that group sizes of 8 are better suited to small-scale dementia care.
At this moment it is up to the care provider and the care office to reach acceptable solutions for the clients.
Het is op dit moment aan de zorgaanbieder en het zorgkantoor om tot acceptabele oplossingen voor de cliënten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de beschikbaarheid en de betaalbaarheid van het aanbod van sport op televisie

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether paywalls making popular sport available only on subscription harm access and what could be done, including a review of the events list. The minister says the market should set broadcasting, notes the events list guarantees free-to-air access for major events, and promises an evaluation in 2023 but no immediate new research.
It is up to the public and commercial broadcasters to determine the content of their programming.
Het is aan de publieke en commerciële omroepen om de inhoud van hun programmering te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het feit dat de Stichting Open Nederland geen testlocaties heeft in de provincies Flevoland, Groningen en Zeeland

MP Kwint asked why there are no access-testing sites for Stichting Open Nederland in Flevoland, Groningen and Zeeland, and why existing sites were not taken over, and whether the GGD should have run testing instead. The minister says sites exist in those provinces, that national coverage under 20 minutes' drive is being pursued as capacity scales up, and that the GGD should not be burdened with access testing.
That is why we are working towards national coverage with a car travel time of under 20 minutes one way.
Daarom werken we toe naar een landelijke dekking van een reistijd met de auto onder de 20 minuten enkele reis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over misstanden bij een evangelische leef- en woongemeenschap in Overijssel

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked the minister to respond to alleged abuses at an evangelical living community in Balkbrug, including poor care, misuse of care funds and inadequate housing, and why authorities acted late and what investigations found. The minister reports that the Wmo supervisor found mostly non-compliance with quality rules, with a deadline of 1 July 2021, that building inspection found the building met code, and that a preliminary administrative inquiry found no urgent facts; the IGJ is not currently investigating, and the community is not obliged to publish annual figures because it is funded by personal budgets.
Given a few findings where possible unlawfulness must be examined further, the supervisor advises commissioning a (more in-depth) Wmo lawfulness investigation.

Gelet op een paar bevindingen waarbij eventuele onrechtmatigheid nader onderzocht moet worden, adviseert de toezichthouder om een opdracht te verstrekken voor een (meer verdiepend) rechtmatigheidsonderzoek Wmo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over signalen dat er nog steeds geen zelftesten beschikbaar zijn op scholen

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers whether schools still lacked COVID self-test kits for teachers and pupils, how distribution was progressing, and where schools could report shortages. The minister replied that rollout to secondary and primary schools was largely complete, with about 300 primary schools receiving top-up deliveries, a helpdesk and online ordering module in place, and secondary schools supplied ahead of reopening.
However, about 300 primary schools reported that they had received too few tests to test all their staff preventively twice a week until the summer holiday.
Wel hebben ongeveer 300 scholen in het primair onderwijs aangegeven te weinig testen te hebben ontvangen om al hun personeel tot aan de zomervakantie twee keer per week preventief te laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat bij het onderwijsplan misbruik en willekeur op de loer ligt

An MP asked the education ministers about Algemene Rekenkamer concerns over the Nationaal Programma Onderwijs (8.5 billion euro for catching up after COVID learning delays), including accountability, reporting burden, distribution, timelines and funding. The ministers answered that accountability will use standardized reporting via XBRL and a national monitor, but that the timeline will not be extended and that structural funding is not for this demissionary cabinet to decide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het gebruik van commerciële bijlesbureaus en examentrainingen om corona-achterstanden in te halen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked whether schools spent corona catch-up funds on commercial tutoring and exam-training firms, and whether this should be curbed. Minister Slob replied that schools control how funds are spent, outsourcing is allowed with works council consent, and that accountability runs through school reports, the works council and the inspectorate, while declining to report detailed spending and deferring broader tutoring measures.
There is no obligation for schools to communicate their spending in detail.
Er is geen verplichting voor solen om gedetailleerd over hun uitgaven te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over een column van Rosanne Hertzberger in de NRC over de orthodox-Joodse school Cheider in Amsterdam

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked about alleged abuse at the Cheider school following a newspaper column, including corporal punishment, sexual abuse and a knife threat, and why the Inspectorate had not intervened. Minister Slob replied that recent inspections found no such incidents, that the school was under intensive supervision with sanctions imposed and suspended by a court, and that a bill to expand the Inspectorate's instruments is expected after the summer.
The inspectorate maintains intensive supervision of the school and has imposed two funding sanctions this school year on my behalf.
De inspectie houdt intensief toezicht op de school en heeft in dit schooljaar (2020/2021) namens mij twee bekostigingssancties opgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de lerarenbeurs

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the number of teacher grant applications, whether all rejected 2020 applicants would be granted, the DUO website outage, whether the budget would be increased if oversubscribed, and compensation for self-paid courses. The minister answered that final numbers are not yet known, promised all 2020 rejected initial applications can be granted, confirmed a brief outage, declined to raise the budget pending an evaluation due this autumn, and said there is no room to compensate teachers.
We will inform you after the allocation by DUO of the final number of applications and the number of grants for the Teacher Grant for the coming school year (by the end of June at the latest).
Wij informeren u na afloop van de toekenning bij DUO over het definitieve aantal aanvragen en het aantal toekenningen voor de Lerarenbeurs voor het aankomende schooljaar (uiterlijk eind juni).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de onderbetaling van artiesten die in de media optreden

MP Kwint asked the ministers whether the adopted motion requiring fair payment of artists appearing on public broadcasting has been implemented, and whether it is true that only about 5 cents per euro of music programme spending reaches artists. The minister replied that public broadcasters set artist fees themselves, that talks with the NPO and broadcasters are ongoing with a report to parliament promised before the summer recess, and that the NPO does not recognise the 5-cent claim.
On 17 February 2021 your House was informed by letter about the progress in implementing the Kwint et al. motion.
Op 17 februari 2021 is uw Kamer per brief 2 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de motie Kwint c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het bericht dat tientallen miljoenen sneltests stof verzamelen in de opslag en het onderwijs aan een lijntje wordt gehouden

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why tens of millions of rapid COVID tests sit in storage while schools are kept waiting for them. The minister answered that professional-supervision requirements blocked school testing, that self-tests were approved and are being rolled out to schools gradually, and that he will continue working on broader availability.
I have adopted the advice of the expert panel.
Ik heb het advies van het deskundigenpanel overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat dertien onderwijsbestuurders meer verdienden dan een minister

An SP MP asked the ministers why thirteen education board executives earned more than a minister despite underfunding, and why publicly funded bodies such as Cito and Surf have not complied with the online disclosure duty under the WNT pay cap. The ministers answered that the WNT is strictly applied, that the seven-year transitional regime for existing contracts is legally required to avoid breaching property rights, and that enforcement and falling numbers of above-cap salaries are expected.
In cases where there is a violation of the WNT, we, or the Inspectorate of Education on our behalf, will take enforcement action.
In de gevallen waarin sprake is van een overtreding van de WNT zullen wij, of de Inspectie van het Onderwijs namens ons, handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over artiesten voor de 'field labs' die niet betaald krijgen

An MP asked whether artists at the government-linked 'field labs' pilot events are unpaid and whether this is acceptable given the sector's hardship. The minister confirmed the events were initiated by the sector, performers participate pro bono, ticket proceeds go to the event, and listed general COVID support measures for culture.
The sector itself took the initiative to organise these events and approached the artists and suppliers to participate pro bono in the field labs.
De sector zelf heeft het initiatief genomen om deze events te organiseren en de artiesten en toeleveranciers benaderd om pro bono deel te nemen aan de fieldlabs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Tientallen jongeren de dupe van sluiting De Hoenderloo Groep, beloofde 'passende vervolgplek' is er niet gekomen'

MPs Kuiken, Westerveld and Kwint asked why dozens of youths from the closed Hoenderloo Groep lack a lasting placement after its closure, and whether the promised 'suitable follow-up placement' was broken. The Staatssecretaris answers that all youths had a placement on closure day, that some later placements proved unsuitable and are being addressed by Pluryn, municipalities and the inspectorate, and that the government is strengthening continuity-of-care rules.
I do not share the view of the questioners that Pluryn has broken the promise that every youth would receive a follow-up placement.
Ik deel het oordeel van de vragenstellers niet dat Pluryn de belofte heeft geschonden dat elke jongere een vervolgplek krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een D66-campagnefoto zes voorpagina’s heeft gehaald

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked about a D66 campaign photo that appeared on six front pages, asking whether photo credits matter for photojournalism, whether political control over journalistic images is desirable, the status of minimum rates for journalists, and the position of freelance photojournalists during COVID-19. The minister answered that source attribution is important, that journalistic independence must be respected, that binding fair practice rules now apply to public broadcasters and talks on a publishing-sector code are ongoing, and that COVID support measures were available to freelancers, without committing to new action.
Journalistic independence is a great good and a strong pillar of our democratic society, in which journalists act as a sound counterweight to politics and government.
Journalistieke onafhankelijkheid is een groot goed en een sterke pijler van onze democratische samenleving, waarin journalisten als een gedegen tegenmacht van politiek en overheid fungeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een directeur zijn eigen journalisten wil volgen met een geheime camera

An MP asked whether a regional broadcaster director may covertly camera-monitor and read the e-mails of his own journalists, and whether the government will investigate and intervene. The minister answered that covert camera surveillance is in principle prohibited and e-mail reading is limited by GDPR and works-council consent, that the director withdrew his plans, and that the matter is an internal one for L1 now before the Enterprise Chamber.
In principle this concerns an internal matter of L1.
In beginsel betreft dit een interne aangelegenheid van L1.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de keuze om digitale uitzendingen van culturele evenementen als elektronische dienst te beschouwen

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 21% VAT rate on digital broadcasts of cultural events, classed as electronic services, should be revised in light of the Geelen case and a critical academic commentary, and about cultural municipal support. The State Secretary replied that Geelen does not settle whether such broadcasts are electronic services, that the EU VAT Directive bars the reduced rate, that no legislative change is planned until EU negotiations conclude, and that the existing support measures are adequate.
The cabinet therefore does not intend to provide for legislative measures for this at this time.
Het kabinet is daarom niet voornemens hiervoor op dit moment te voorzien in wettelijke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over het testprotocol COVID-19 bij kinderen onder de 13 jaar

MPs Kwint and Hijink asked why children under 13 could only be tested for COVID-19 when symptomatic, whether schools' case increases were reported, and why GGD school case figures were not public. The minister answered that testing policy for under-13s was tightened in February 2021, testing capacity is sufficient, GGD school-level data stay regional or aggregated, and the RIVM has central registration by region and age.
I do not have information on the precise figures of the School Reporting Point, however.
De precieze cijfers van het Scholenmeldpunt heb ik echter geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de hoge BTW-heffing over digitale popevenementen

Two MPs asked why digital pop-event tickets are taxed at the 21% standard VAT rate rather than the 9% reduced rate and whether this should change. The State Secretary confirmed that electronic services fall outside the reduced rate under EU law, rejected a reduced rate for online cultural events, and pointed to subsidy packages and the Geefwet instead.
Under EU law it is not permitted to place online cultural events under the reduced rate.
Het is op grond van het EU-recht niet toegestaan online culturele evenementen onder het verlaagd tarief te plaatsen.
