Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat afstand tussen scholieren wel belangrijk is

MP Kwint asked the minister whether the cabinet knew last summer that keeping the 1.5-metre rule in schools was advisable, why it did not act sooner and why the Chamber was not informed, and questioned the consistency of school policy and exam arrangements. Minister Slob replied that the cabinet bases its policy on the collective OMT advice, that the cited views were of individual OMT members, that the cabinet was informed of the adjusted advice only with the 94th OMT advice, and that the advice was shared with the Chamber, while on exam classes and the 1.5-metre rule he said organisational adjustments are needed but largely succeed.
The advice of the OMT is always shared with the Chamber after publication.
De adviezen van het OMT worden na publicatie altijd gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat na het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs de meeste leerlingen een uitkering wacht

An MP asked the education minister about reports that most students leaving special secondary education face benefits after two years, and what regional action, sector data, diplomas and inclusion measures exist. The minister disputed the framing (about two-thirds of the 46% entering the labour market, not of all leavers), listed existing employment initiatives and funding, declined to provide sector data, and said no further action was needed.
OCW does not keep data on the sectors in which students go to work after leaving education.
OCW houdt geen gegevens bij over de sectoren waar leerlingen na het verlaten van het onderwijs gaan werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een laptop eisen niet mag, maar scholen ermee wegkomen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister whether schools may effectively require pupils to buy laptops or tablets, and whether devices should fall under the free-textbook law and its funding. The Minister answered that parents may be asked to buy devices only voluntarily, that schools must provide devices themselves where needed, and that the free-textbook law evaluation and policy response on devices will follow in the first half of 2021.
Schools may never oblige parents to purchase a laptop.
Scholen mogen ouders nooit verplichten een laptop aan te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister Slob: Pluryn in de fout bij overdragen leerlingen Hoenderloo College'

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked why parliament was only informed in November that some pupils of the Hoenderloo College had no school place after closure, despite earlier assurances. The minister answered that Pluryn wrongly reported places were found, that the Inspectorate issued repair orders and intensive monitoring, and that all pupils were placed by 16 October 2020.
The board has taken its responsibility. This led to the last young person receiving a follow-up education place on 16 October 2020.
Het bestuur heeft zijn verantwoordelijkheid genomen. Dit heeft ertoe geleid dat op 16 oktober 2020 de laatste jongere een vervolg onderwijsplek heeft gekregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat NOS-medewerkers bedreigd worden

An SP MP asked the minister whether the NOS dropping logos from its satellite vans due to threats is unacceptable, whether the Stuurgroep Agressie en Geweld tegen Journalisten was consulted, whether police capacity suffices, and whether threats against journalists are rising. The minister condemned the threats, reported contact with NVJ/PersVeilig, police and the NOS, cited rising PersVeilig report figures for 2019 and 2020, and pointed to regeerakkoord funds for investigative journalism.
In our democratic society, the press must be able to do its work in freedom and safety.
In onze democratische samenleving moet de pers haar werk in vrijheid en veiligheid kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht 'De beladen bunker van Seyss-Inquart kwijnt weg'

MPs Beckerman and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the deteriorating Seyss-Inquart bunker, a national monument, and how to protect it during its sale, including maintenance duties, heritage protection against unsuitable buyers, and whether stricter conditions can be imposed. The minister answered that maintenance continues, the sale is planned to conclude by end 2021, existing heritage law and zoning rules are sufficient protection, and additional conditions are being considered.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) has carried out the necessary maintenance in recent years and will continue to do so until transfer to a new owner.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) heeft de afgelopen jaren het nodige instandhoudingsonderhoud gepleegd en zal dit ook tot de overdracht aan een nieuwe eigenaar blijven plegen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over ventilatiesystemen in schoolgebouwen

Two SP MPs asked whether school ventilation systems meet standards, how quickly they could be improved, which countries the RIVM cited for keeping schools open, and what it would cost to fix ventilation in all Dutch schools. The minister said the OMT and RIVM saw no reason to change ventilation policy, pointed schools to existing Bouwbesluit requirements and guidance, noted that 11 percent of school buildings in an incomplete survey fell short, and referred to a 360 million euro fund that municipalities can draw on with schools.
The advice to schools is, insofar as they have not yet done so, to check their ventilation against the applicable requirements.
Het advies aan scholen is – voor zover dat nog niet gedaan is – hun ventilatie te controleren op de daarvoor geldende eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Rutgers: 1 op 3 basisscholen geeft geen les over homoseksualiteit'

MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Education whether schools teach about sexual diversity as required by the core objectives, given a Rutgers survey showing a third of primary schools do not, and what action will be taken on lesson methods, mbo and secondary teaching and teacher training. The minister replied that schools have discretion in how they meet the core objectives, cited an inspectorate study finding 86 percent of schools address sexual diversity, pointed to inspection enforcement and a request for further monitoring, and noted the curriculum revision will sharpen the core objective.

I have asked the inspectorate to give further attention in upcoming studies to how schools address sexual diversity, and to keep me informed of the current state of affairs regarding schools' attention to sexual diversity.

Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd de invulling die scholen geven aan seksuele diversiteit in komende onderzoeken verder aandacht te geven, en mij op de hoogte te houden van de actuele stand van zaken rond de aandacht van scholen voor seksuele diversiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Culturele instellingen in chaos na coronamaatregelen

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.
With these tougher measures, the possibility for the Safety Regions to grant exemptions has lapsed.
Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Cultuursector meldt met 62 procent relatief grootste omzetverlies bij UWV’

MPs Van den Berge, Asscher and Kwint asked the ministers whether the culture sector's 62 percent turnover loss at UWV, the delay in support, the adequacy of the second support package, the talent drain, the link with the April motion, sector robustness and events-sector compensation were acceptable. The minister responds that substantial support (about 1.3 billion euros in total) has been provided in stages, that the second package covers January to June 2021, and that further measures are under discussion with the sector and the Raad voor Cultuur.
I regret that institutions and businesses in the cultural and creative sector have to decide to dismiss staff because of this crisis.
Ik betreur het dat instellingen en ondernemingen in de culturele en creatieve sector door deze crisis moeten besluiten tot het ontslaan van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris Van Ark een compensatie voor de gedupeerden in de CAF-11 zaak blokkeerde in de Ministerraad

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked the state secretary to explain why a compensation plan for CAF-11 childcare-benefit victims was reportedly blocked in cabinet and why earlier documents showed the disproportionate recovery issue was known. The state secretary denies blocking any proposal, says the ministries cooperated, admits the strict enforcement and missed signals were regrettable, and says the parliamentary inquiry has been given the relevant documents.
From the moment the scale of the affair became clear to State Secretary Snel, the cabinet endorsed its commitment to do right by the affected parents.
Vanaf het moment dat de omvang van de affaire bij Staatssecretaris Snel duidelijk begon te worden, heeft het kabinet zijn inzet om de gedupeerde ouders recht te doen onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de verplichte dataverstrekking van kinderopvangorganisaties aan de Belastingdienst

MPs Kwint and Leijten (SP) asked why monthly personal data sharing by childcare organisations with the Tax Administration was set by ministerial regulation rather than law, whether privacy impact assessments and consent/opt-out were provided, and whether the practice conflicts with privacy rights. The state secretaries answered that monthly data delivery aims to prevent high childcare benefit recoveries, that a statutory basis exists and is being strengthened via the Awir amendment, and that parents cannot opt out, while several answers (e.g. on the AP advice and PIA) were given but the timing deadline was missed.
From 2021 the monthly delivery of this data will be mandatory.
Vanaf 2021 is het maandelijks leveren van deze gegevens verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Tielen over het bericht dat de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) de bestuurlijke afspraken over laaggeletterdheid heeft opgezegd

MPs Kwint and Tielen asked why the VNG terminated the administrative agreements on functional illiteracy, whether the budget is adequate, and what this means for quality labels, regional plans and digitalisation. The Minister of Education answers that the budget is supplemented by about €125 million under Tel mee met Taal, that the agreements are too recent to evaluate, that new agreements are being negotiated with municipalities, and that a further letter will follow on quality and the Leesoffensief.
That is why, in implementation of the Tielen-Kwint motion, I am in discussion with municipalities to reach new agreements.
Daarom ben ik, ter uitvoering van de motie Tielen-Kwint, in gesprek met gemeenten om tot nieuwe afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de noodkreet dat het lerarentekort niet meer wordt gemeld

MP Kwint (SP) asked the education minister how the government will respond to a teacher's plea that the shortage reporting website no longer gives a realistic picture of teacher shortages, and whether the government will take over measurement itself. Minister Slob answered that he regrets the initiator stopping, that corona and other data sources are being used, and that a fuller measurement method will be decided in spring after a G5 survey and a review in December.
I would have liked the website to stay online and we would have worked on increasing the number of registrations, but I respect his decision.
Ik had graag gezien dat de website in de lucht bleef en we zouden werken aan het verhogen van het aantal registraties, maar ik respecteer zijn beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het nieuws dat gedupeerde ouders van de CAF 11-zaak al veel eerder compensatie hadden kunnen krijgen

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he blocked a compensation proposal for childcare benefit victims in June 2019, why earlier answers were evasive, and what he concretely did to resolve the affair. Rutte denied that any compensation proposal was blocked in the 7 June 2019 cabinet meeting, stated he was unaware of the Tax Authority's earlier warnings, and largely restated that the cabinet supported restitution, offering answers without new substance.
The questions wrongly assume that a compensation proposal by State Secretary Snel was blocked at the cabinet meeting of 7 June 2019.
In de vraagstelling wordt er ten onrechte van uitgegaan dat in de ministerraad van 7 juni 2019 een compensatievoorstel van Staatssecretaris Snel is tegengehouden.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande ontslagen bij poppodia en andere culturele instellingen

An MP asked ministers about reports of layoffs at Dutch music venues and cultural institutions during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether support schemes such as NOW, TOZO and TVL would be extended. The minister replied that support measures would be continued for nine months and that a range of additional funding, loan and fieldlab arrangements exist, while stating that not every organisation can be saved.
As I indicated in the debate of 29 June, I want to prevent bankruptcies as much as possible.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het debat van 29 juni jl. wil ik faillissementen zoveel mogelijk zien te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'Private equity koopt de crèche, de zorgkinderen moeten weg'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the state secretary about reports that private equity owner Blos is ending its plusgroepen for children with special needs, and about oversight of such takeovers. The state secretary said childcare organisations decide their own offer, municipalities hold the care duty, the oudercommissie was not consulted as required, and research on ownership and quality is underway.
The oudercommissies made this omission known to the childcare organisation, and a conversation with each of the three oudercommissies then took place after all.
De oudercommissies hebben deze omissie bij de kinderopvangorganisatie kenbaar gemaakt en daarop heeft alsnog een gesprek met ieder van de drie oudercommissies plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de VNG de bestuurlijke afspraken over laaggeletterdheid heeft opgezegd

Kwint (SP) asked the Education minister how she views the VNG's unilateral termination of the administrative agreements on functional illiteracy, whether they burdened municipalities, and what happens next. The minister regretted the VNG's decision, said she is in talks with the VNG to address implementation concerns about monitoring and quality labels, and said funding continues and the Kamer will be informed later.
I am in discussion with municipalities about the extent to which they still wish to implement the administrative agreements, specifically regarding monitoring and quality assurance.
Ik ben met gemeenten in gesprek over de vraag in hoeverre zij nog uitvoering willen geven aan de bestuurlijke afspraken, specifiek op het gebied van monitoring en kwaliteitszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen, Kwint en Rog over de lerarenbeurs

MPs asked why the teacher grant (lerarenbeurs) budget was exhausted in 2020, how many applications were rejected, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The ministers answered that 2,416 initial applications were rejected after renewal applications were prioritised, and that budget cuts from parliamentary amendments reduced the budget from 78 to 49.6 million euros, communicated through several channels.
We could not inform you earlier because applications could be submitted until 30 June, and only afterwards was it clear how many renewal applications had been submitted.
Wij konden u niet eerder informeren omdat er tot en met 30 juni aanvragen ingediend konden worden en het pas daarna duidelijk was hoeveel herhaalaanvragen waren ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kwint en Alkaya over het nieuws dat gedupeerde ouders van de CAF 11-zaak al veel eerder compensatie hadden kunnen krijgen

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked PM Rutte what role he played in blocking a June 2019 compensation proposal for CAF 11 childcare benefit parents, and whether he will apologise and why the former State Secretary who tried to compensate was lost while the one blocking it was promoted. Rutte answered briefly that the cabinet consistently supported making the affected parents whole from the moment the scale became clear, and that he has apologised for what happened.
From the moment the scale of the affair became clear to State Secretary Snel, the cabinet endorsed its commitment to do justice to the affected parents.
Vanaf het moment dat de omvang van de affaire bij Staatssecretaris Snel duidelijk begon te worden, heeft het kabinet zijn inzet om de gedupeerde ouders recht te doen onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris Van Ark een compensatie voor de gedupeerden in de CAF-11 zaak blokkeerde in de Ministerraad

Two SP MPs asked why former state secretary Van Ark allegedly blocked compensation for parents harmed in the CAF-11 childcare benefit case, and requested related memos and documents. The government's answers deny the framing, state that the ministry supported compensation, promise a ministry search for signals on the childcare contribution issue around 1 September 2020, and note that compensation was coordinated with the Finance ministry without fully disclosing internal deliberations.
I aim to inform the House around 1 September 2020 about the results found.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer rond 1 september 2020 te informeren over de gevonden resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris van Financiën (de heer Snel) de ouders in juni 2019 al wilde compenseren

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked why a 2019 timeline sent to the ADR and parliament omitted former state secretary Snel's June 2019 attempt to offer compensation to childcare-benefit victims, and about the handling of the Donner advisory commission and the cabinet. The state secretary answered that the timeline served a narrow ADR research question, declined to discuss individual officials' views or internal legal advice citing intra-cabinet deliberation, confirmed contact with the commission (100+ emails, meetings), and disputed that parliament was being deliberately kept uninformed.
However, it is standing cabinet-wide policy not to make personal policy views contained in (legal) documents prepared for internal deliberation a subject of political debate.
Het is echter staand kabinetsbreed beleid om persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen opgenomen in (juridische) documenten die zijn opgesteld voor intern beraad geen onderwerp te maken van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Hijink over de recente Zuid-Koreaanse studie naar de overdraagbaarheid van COVID-19 door kinderen

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Education Ministers about a South Korean study on children's transmission of COVID-19 and its implications for school reopening. The government answered that the study rests on few children, offers no new insight into transmission and did not study school openings, and committed to monitoring the literature and reporting school-linked clusters to OCW.
RIVM informs the Ministry of Health about the latest developments so they can be taken into account in policy-making.
Het RIVM informeert VWS over de meest recente ontwikkelingen, zodat deze meegenomen kunnen worden in de beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Rog over het onterecht innen van verplichte ouderbijdragen voor onderwijs aan hoogbegaafden

MPs Kwint and Rog asked whether schools illegally collected mandatory parental contributions for gifted-children education, how much was collected, whether parents were refunded and informed, and what sanctions apply. The minister answered that the school had stopped collecting, the inspectorate found no reason for specific investigation, refunds were made or reserved, letters were sent to schools, and sanctions are enforced by the inspectorate.
I will ask the board to bring this to the attention of all parents.
Ik zal het bestuur vragen dit onder de aandacht te brengen bij alle ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het sneuvelen van het wetsvoorstel afschaffen fusietoets funderend onderwijs in de Eerste Kamer

MP Kwint asked the Minister what steps will follow the Senate's rejection of the bill abolishing the merger test in primary and secondary education, and why the Commission for the merger test (CFTO) was dissolved early, along with costs, recent mergers, and lessons learned. The Minister answers that the light test remains in force, the council-support guarantees fall away, the CFTO will not be re-established for now, and the Senate's concerns about school scale enlargement are noted.
I will investigate whether I can find a solution for that.
Ik ga onderzoeken of ik daar een oplossing voor kan vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld  en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dertig leerlingen uit het speciaal basisonderwijs noodgedwongen ondergebracht worden bij reguliere scholen

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked whether a school board could unilaterally move 30 pupils from a special primary school to regular schools without parental consent, and how the Inspectorate handled complaints about the school. Minister Slob answered that the law does not expressly regulate this, that parents were individually consulted and given school visits, that the Inspectorate received 12 complaints and a repair inspection is under way, and that no further action is needed.
The legislation does not expressly regulate this.
In de wetgeving is dit niet uitdrukkelijk geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Van den Hul, Van Meenen, Westerveld en Kwint over selectief aanmeldbeleid bij basisscholen

MPs asked the minister how government and the Education Inspectorate responded to research showing Utrecht primary schools operated pre-registration practices that breached the law and harmed equal access, including for children with migrant backgrounds. The minister said the inspectorate can intervene, that the municipality and school boards are drafting an improvement plan due in October, and that a broader study of admission policy and a policy agenda on segregation will follow.
If it becomes apparent that this is not being complied with, the Education Inspectorate can intervene.
Als blijkt dat daaraan niet wordt voldaan kan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld,Kwint, Gijs van Dijk, Bruins en Postma over het bericht 'Grootste Nederlandse kinderopvangbedrijf zit fiscaal op de Kaaimaneilanden'

MPs from five parties asked whether the largest Dutch childcare company, owned via investment funds in the Cayman Islands, is permissible, whether public money leaks to tax havens, and whether ownership rules should change. The Secretary of State answered that childcare quality rules apply regardless of ownership, cited existing anti-avoidance measures, declined to confirm specific dividend flows citing tax secrecy, and rejected extra ownership restrictions.
To the extent information is known to the Tax Authority, the cabinet cannot, under the statutory tax confidentiality duty, confirm or deny which payments an individual taxpayer makes and to whom.

Voor zover hierover informatie bij de Belastingdienst bekend is, kan het kabinet op grond van de wettelijke fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht bevestigen noch ontkennen welke betalingen door een individuele belastingplichtige worden gedaan en aan wie dat gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het Hoenderloo College

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers about an open letter from Hoenderloo College staff alleging misconduct by Pluryn toward the works council, parents and youth, the inspectorate's role, and the closure and social plan. The minister answers that responsibility lies primarily with Pluryn, that the inspectorate monitors closely and rejects the staff's description of its role, that placements are being arranged with ongoing monitoring, and that a social plan was agreed on 26 June 2020.
The education inspectorate supervises the quality and continuity of education.
De onderwijsinspectie ziet toe op de kwaliteit en continuïteit van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Leijten en Van Kent over kinderopvangtoeslag in werkloosheid tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs of the SP asked whether childcare allowance is stopped after three months of unemployment during the coronavirus crisis and whether the government will extend that period to six months given weak job prospects and childcare waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that parents keep the allowance for three months and can use remaining hours until year-end under the annual system, and declined to extend the period because past extensions had limited effect and the economic outlook is uncertain.

Given the room that the existing unemployment period and the annual system already offer, and given the limited effects in the past, the uncertainty about the economic outlook and its effect on waiting lists, I do not consider it opportune to extend the unemployment period.

Gegeven de ruimte die de bestaande werkloosheidstermijn en de jaarsystematiek reeds bieden, en gegeven de beperkte effecten in het verleden, de onzekerheid over het economische beeld en het effect daarvan op wachtlijsten, vind ik het niet opportuun om de werkloosheidstermijn te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de wanhopige oproep van de docenten van de Hoenderloo Groep en de huidige stand van zaken

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked about teachers' distress over the closure of the Hoenderloo Groep, including the lack of a social plan, placement of pupils, and whether the school should stay open. The minister answers that a social plan is under negotiation, pupils are being transferred to suitable youth-care places, and he sees no reason to keep the school open, while promising to keep the Chamber informed.
The Minister of VWS is willing to keep the Chamber informed of the progress of the closure, as he has done in the recent period from his system responsibility.
De Minister van VWS is bereid de Kamer, zoals hij ook de afgelopen periode heeft gedaan vanuit zijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid, op de hoogte te houden van de voortgang van de sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de vraag hoe mensen die kinderopvang geheel zelf betalen ook gecompenseerd zullen worden

MPs Kwint and Leijten asked how parents who pay for childcare entirely themselves, without childcare allowance, will be compensated during the COVID-19 closure, and why the compensation scheme relies on Tax Authority data that does not capture them. The State Secretary answered that only a few thousand such parents are estimated, that the scheme uses existing Tax Authority data for speed and privacy reasons, and that the government will consider a form of compensation for this group once more is known about them.
The number of people who do not qualify for childcare allowance cannot be estimated.
Het aantal mensen dat niet in aanmerking komt voor kinderopvangtoeslag is niet in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Kwint over het bericht 'FunX-dj stopte met Ramadan late Night: 'Niet alleen ik werd met dood bedreigd''

MPs El Yassini and Kwint asked whether the government considers it unacceptable that a FunX DJ needed protection and stopped his Ramadan programme after death threats, and what is being done about press safety. The minister calls the threats unacceptable, says the programme ended for editorial reasons, declines to comment on a criminal investigation, and points to existing press-safety initiatives such as PersVeilig and a protocol with police and prosecutors.
Freedom of expression and press freedom are a great good and an important pillar of our society in a democratic constitutional state like the Netherlands.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid zijn in een democratische rechtsstaat als Nederland een groot goed en een belangrijke pijler van onze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een radioprogramma stopt na doodsbedreigingen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a public radio programme ending after death threats was acceptable, whether the Stuurgroep Agressie en Geweld tegen Journalisten had been contacted, whether police protection was adequate, and whether the affected staff had been offered help. The minister called the threats unacceptable, said the broadcaster decided to end the programme for editorial reasons, reported contact with the NPO and PersVeilig, and stated that staff had not reported feeling unsafe.
Freedom of expression and press freedom are a great good and an important pillar of our society in a democratic constitutional state like the Netherlands.
Vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid zijn in een democratische rechtsstaat als Nederland een groot goed en een belangrijke pijler van onze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over verzekeringen in de culturele sector

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked the ministers of Finance and OCW about insurers refusing payouts to festivals, artists and travel customers during the COVID-19 crisis, and about support for small cultural entrepreneurs and suppliers. The government answered that pandemic losses are often excluded from cover depending on policy terms, that insurers say they will pay event-cancellation claims, and that a support package and talks with insurers are underway, while travel-insurance refusals depend on policy type.
I have no signals that insurers are on a large scale failing to pay out where this is warranted.
Ik heb geen signalen dat verzekeraars op grote schaal niet uitkeren waar dit wel op zijn plaats is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint  en Van Meenen over het artikel ‘De prijs van een kleine klas’

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked the minister about Scholen voor Persoonlijk Onderwijs (SvPO): its time-counting, parental contributions, materials, governance and oversight. The minister answered that the Inspectorate is investigating several of these matters, that the school board may spend its budget freely within legal limits, and that parental contributions are voluntary.
The inspectorate will examine in the autumn whether this shortcoming has been remedied.
De inspectie onderzoekt in het najaar of deze tekortkoming is hersteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Futselaar en Alkaya over ondersteuning voor zelfstandigen en de culturele sector

MPs Kwint, Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about support for self-employed workers and the cultural sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including eligibility criteria, compensation for cancelled events, and a guarantee fund. The government answered that existing general measures apply, cited extra funding of 300 million euro for culture, and explained why certain sectors were included or excluded from the TOGS scheme.
On Tuesday 7 April the extension to non-food retail and a second extension were communicated to the House.
Op dinsdag 7 april jl. is de uitbreiding met non-food retail en nog een tweede uitbreiding aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het uitblijven van ondersteuning voor de culturele sector

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the cultural sector has received no sector-specific support during the COVID-19 crisis, whether a rescue package is coming, and whether the cultural season is lost. The Minister answered that EUR 300 million in additional funds was announced for key cultural infrastructure, alongside general measures, and rejected each premise of the questions with a brief 'no, see answer 1' reply.
The cabinet is adding EUR 300 million in additional funds to the existing instruments to keep the vital parts of the cultural infrastructure intact.
Het kabinet voegt € 300 miljoen additionele middelen toe aan het bestaande instrumentarium om de vitale onderdelen in de culturele infrastructuur in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de eindrapportage `Begeleiding startende leraren 2014-2019’

An MP asked the minister about the final report on support for starting teachers (2014-2019), which found that support does improve teaching and that outflow falls when all schools in a board provide it, and about why support falls short of the sector accord target. The minister agreed the situation is unsatisfactory, said he is working on statutory strategic HRM requirements and talks with the VO-raad, and gave no firm new deadline or binding commitment beyond ongoing work.
That is why I am working on statutory requirements for strategic HRM policy.
Daarom werk ik aan wettelijke eisen voor strategisch HRM beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Van den Berge en Kwint over een noodfonds voor de culturele sector

Three opposition MPs asked whether the government will provide extra funds to compensate the cultural sector for lost income during the COVID-19 crisis and whether they support an emergency fund. The minister answered that an additional 300 million euros is being added for key cultural infrastructure, while pointing to general COVID-19 support measures and repeating the same reply to most follow-up questions.
The cabinet is adding 300 million euros in additional funds to the existing instruments to maintain the vital parts of the cultural infrastructure.
Het kabinet voegt € 300 miljoen additionele middelen toe aan het bestaande instrumentarium om de vitale onderdelen in de culturele infrastructuur in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat lokale en regionale kranten steun zoeken om de coronacrisis te overleven

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education and Media whether local and regional newspapers facing coronavirus revenue losses would be supported, and whether support would be conditional on protecting freelancers and refraining from profit payouts to shareholders. The minister answered that a temporary support fund for free newspapers and local public broadcasters is being set up, that no conditions on profit distributions are considered necessary given the type of organisations, and that support will be provided as a credit later convertible to a grant.
Given the type of organisations the support fund targets and the size of support per organisation, conditions on profit distributions are in my view not relevant.

Gezien het type organisaties waar het Steunfonds zich op richt en de omvang van de verleende ondersteuning per organisatie zijn voorwaarden ten aanzien van winstuitkeringen mijns inziens niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het coronavirus en onderwijs

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about school closures and childcare during the coronavirus outbreak, including whether schools should serve as childcare, whether parents may keep children home under the Compulsory Education Act, and the Inspectorate's stance. The minister confirmed that in-person teaching and childcare are suspended until 28 April with online teaching where possible, and set out exam, internship, study-advice and funding adjustments.
Until and including Monday 28 April, no on-site teaching will take place in primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, and regular childcare will be suspended.

Tot en met maandag 28 april wordt er geen les gegeven op locatie in het primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs, en de reguliere kinderopvang wordt gestaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over de sluiting van de onderwijstak van De Hoenderloo Groep

MPs Hijink and Kwint asked the ministers whether Pluryn's separation of the Hoenderloo College education branch into a separate foundation was used to strip teachers of their rights and funds, and what action the government would take. Minister Slob answered that the closure of the Hoenderloo College followed inevitably from closing the care locations, that the Inspectorate monitors Pluryn's finances and compliance, and that Pluryn has promised a social plan and new posts for teachers.
The Inspectorate of Education supervises compliance with laws and regulations, and if irregularities are found it will take appropriate measures.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs ziet toe op naleving van wet- en regelgeving en als blijkt dat er onrechtmatigheden zijn begaan dan zal de inspectie passende maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de uitzending van BOOS dat de NCOI sjoemelt met overheidsgeld

MP Kwint (SP) asked the Minister of Education about a BOOS broadcast alleging NCOI pockets public voucher money from students who drop out, and about NCOI's quality and fees. The minister denies clear proof of cheating, notes NCOI must repay DUO only in limited cases, reports NCOI's dropout and fee practices, and says NCOI is asked for further accountability that DUO will examine.
Following this additional information from NCOI about the offsetting upon termination of study, NCOI is asked for further accountability, which DUO will examine.
Naar aanleiding van deze aanvullende informatie van NCOI over de verrekening bij stopzetting van de studie wordt NCOI gevraagd om een nadere verantwoording, die door DUO wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de GenietFabriek als voorziening voor thuiszitters

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether she supports the GenietFabriek initiative for children who cannot attend regular or special schools, and about enforcing a motion on school-board cooperation with such initiatives. The Minister said the initiative is still only a concept, that existing options such as orthopedagogical didactic centres and upcoming education-care arrangements address the problem, and declined to see the initiative as a pilot candidate for collective funding.
I am working with Minister De Jonge on solutions to this problem through the education-care arrangements.
Oplossingen voor dit probleem werk ik samen met Minister De Jonge uit bij de onderwijszorgarrangementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Laçin over het bericht dat de lucht op achterstandsscholen vuiler is

SP MPs Kwint and Laçin asked the government about research showing children at disadvantaged schools breathe dirtier air, and about fine-dust zones, filtration, and school segregation. Minister Slob rejected the general conclusion, said data on fine-dust per school and filtration is not centrally available, and said responsibility for school housing lies with municipalities and school boards, while pointing to a planned integrated housing plan obligation.
No national data on fine-dust concentration per school are known to me.
Er zijn mij geen landelijke gegevens bekend over de fijnstofconcentratie per school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de overstap van de voormalige voorzitter van het Commissariaat van de Media als lobbyist naar Netflix

An SP MP asked whether the former chair of the Commissariaat voor de Media moving to Netflix as a lobbyist, shortly before lobbying on the audiovisual directive, conflicts with integrity rules and whether this should be prevented. The minister answered that the move complies with current rules because about half a year passed between her departure and joining Netflix, and said he intends to introduce a longer cooling-off period in upcoming governance proposals.
I will include this in the amendment proposals I expect from the ongoing investigation into the governance of the Commissariaat.
Ik zal dit meenemen bij de wijzigingsvoorstellen die ik verwacht uit het nog lopende onderzoek naar de governance van het Commissariaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de dreigende gijzeling van een journalist

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about threatened detention of two journalists (NOS and AD) for refusing to testify as witnesses, and whether the source-protection law is clear enough. The minister answered that these were two separate court cases, the law leaves room for case-by-case weighing, and he sees no reason to amend the law or its criteria.
I regard these as two separate incidents.
Ik beschouw het als twee losse incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over misstanden in realityshows

An MP asked the minister whether participants in reality shows such as De Villa and Temptation Island are manipulated through staged scenes and contractual pressure, and whether rules should be drawn up with the Commissariaat voor de Media. The minister replied that producers bear responsibility, that RTL commissioned an independent external inquiry, and that the media regulator has no remit over commercial productions, while criminal liability is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess.
It is not the Commissariaat's task to supervise how commercial broadcasters produce programmes and shape their content.
Het is niet de taak van het Commissariaat om toezicht te houden op de wijze waarop commerciële omroepen programma's produceren en inhoud geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat jonge kinderen betaald krijgen om reclame te maken

MPs Kwint and Van Dijk asked how child labour rules apply to children paid to advertise brands on YouTube and social media, and how enforcement and transparency of sponsored content work. The Secretary of State answered that child labour rules apply when children work under authority or under a contract, including payment in kind, that children up to 12 need an Inspectorate exemption, and that the Inspectorate handles reports that are directly fineable, with a review planned for 2020.
It is conceivable that young vloggers and influencers who talk about a product they have received enter the commercial sphere, so that the ban on child labour applies.

Het is denkbaar dat jonge vloggers en influencers die iets vertellen over een product dat ze hebben gekregen daarmee in de commerciële sfeer raken, waardoor het verbod op kinderarbeid van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de inhuurkosten van externen bij de NPO vier keer hoger dan de Roemernorm is.

MP Kwint (SP) asked the minister why the NPO cannot attract talent for permanent posts and why consultancy hiring has grown, and whether the minister will agree to a 10% external-hiring norm (the Roemer norm). The minister answered that the specialist labour market is tight and the NPO cannot always compete on pay, that consultancy use reflects specialist needs for several projects, that external costs have since fallen, and that the NPO itself decides on its hiring, with its board and supervisory board responsible.
It is up to the NPO itself to decide how it spends the available budget as wisely as possible and to what extent it uses external advice and hiring.
Het is aan de NPO om zelf te bepalen hoe hij het beschikbare budget zo verstandig mogelijk inzet en in welke mate hij bijvoorbeeld gebruik maakt van (extern) advies en inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over onrust bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

MP Kwint asked whether a new chair had been appointed to the Commissariaat voor de Media so binding administrative decisions could resume, what the consequences were for local broadcasters, whether an emergency procedure existed, and whether the rules on disclosure and vetting of side jobs would apply to a new chair. The minister answered that an interim chair would start on 15 November 2019, that routine decisions continue under a mandate decision, and that disclosure and vetting of side jobs will apply to all members and that talks with the Commissariaat will follow.
I will talk with the Commissariaat as soon as possible about how that transparency and vetting will be structurally guaranteed in practice from now on.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk met het Commissariaat in gesprek gaan over de wijze waarop die transparantie en toetsing voortaan in de praktijk structureel gewaarborgd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over schoolkassa van ParnasSys

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether the ParnasSys Schoolkassa brochure and emails wrongly suggest multiple or compulsory parental contributions, implicitly encourage excluding children who do not pay, and whether the minister will discuss this with ParnasSys. The minister answered that schools must state contributions are voluntary, that ParnasSys has already revised the wording, and that schools themselves are responsible for their communications and compliance.
Schools are obliged to state the voluntary nature of the parental contribution in the school guide and to communicate this clearly.
Scholen zijn verplicht om de vrijwilligheid van de ouderbijdrage te vermelden in de schoolgids en daar duidelijk over te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen over het bericht dat ondanks extra geld mbo-docenten in de laagste salarisschaal terechtkomen

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked whether rising numbers of mbo teachers in the lowest salary scale, alongside growing institutional reserves and a critical report on medezeggenschap, reflect misuse of extra funds. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that the Inspectorate is examining reserves, that she disagrees with the report's analysis, and that she will meet the MBO Raad and unions to review whether the convenant's goals were met.
That is why the Inspectorate of Education is currently conducting further research into this.
Daarom doet de Inspectie van het Onderwijs op dit moment hier nader onderzoek naar
Antwoord vragen van het  lid Kwint over het bericht dat er veel maatregelen worden genomen, maar er nog lang niet  genoeg leraren zijn

MP Kwint asked the minister about reports that many measures are taken against the teacher shortage but not enough, including whether the national approach is too limited, whether the PO-Raad's projected shortage is correct, and whether the government will prioritise the issue in the 2020 budget. The minister answered that the government invests in salaries, workload reduction, career changers and regional approaches, that the cited projections use non-comparable methods, and that no further concrete budget commitment was made.

As I indicated in my answers to earlier parliamentary questions from members Van den Hul and Van Meenen, the definitions and methods used for the studies I send to your House annually, the labour market projections and the labour market barometer differ from those used in the PO-Raad study, so the results are not easily comparable.

Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op eerder gestelde Kamervragen van de leden Van den Hul en Van Meenen heb aangegeven zijn de definities en methoden die gebruikt worden voor de onderzoeken die ik jaarlijks aan uw Kamer stuur, de arbeidsmarktramingen en de arbeidsmarktbarometer, anders dan de definities en methoden die in het onderzoek van de PO-Raad zijn gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het Stella Maris in Meerssen gedeeltelijk stopt met Kunskapsskolan

An SP MP asked the education minister about reports that Stella Maris in Meerssen is partly ending the Kunskapsskolan concept after poor inspection ratings, and whether experimenting with unproven teaching concepts is acceptable. The minister declined to judge the school's choice, noted the inspectorate is investigating and has issued a recovery order with a follow-up in spring 2020, and rejected concern that the new-schools bill weakens quality control because a quality test will be introduced.
The inspectorate closely monitors this school, and a recovery inspection will take place in spring 2020.
De inspectie volgt deze school nauwgezet, er vindt in het voorjaar 2020 een herstelonderzoek plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van den Hul en Kwint over de subsidiepot voor zijinstroom in het onderwijs

MPs asked why the subsidy pot for career changers (zij-instroom) in education hit its ceiling for a second year, why DUO sent letters saying applications were on hold, and whether the scheme should become open-ended. The minister says the ceiling has been raised, unfunded applications will be reallocated after the October deadline, the letter wording will be corrected, and budgets will be monitored and reset annually.
The content of the letter will be adjusted.
De inhoud van de brief wordt aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over de ongepaste en onwettelijke inzage in de onderzoeksopzet Shell Papers

Two SP MPs asked whether the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate's request for the research outline of a journalistic FOIA request on Shell was improper and unlawful. The minister answered that the request was too broad and needed clarification under the Wob, that EZK speaks on behalf of 14 other bodies without a formal mandate, and that the purpose question was asked only to specify the request, not to restrict journalism.
It is up to the requester to indicate what specific information they wish to receive; the administrative body can only assist in this.
Het is aan de verzoeker om aan te geven waar hij of zij specifiek informatie over wenst te ontvangen; het bestuursorgaan kan hierbij slechts behulpzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de kaartverkoop van de Formule-1

An SP MP asked the government about the rapid sale and resale at inflated prices of Formula 1 tickets, public funding of the event, and collusion between artists and ticket resellers. The government answered that it provides no direct financial support, points to earlier answers and to planned consumer-protection measures and a campaign, and says it is in talks about rail capacity without a decision yet.
The organisation managed to raise the necessary budget without financial support from central government.
Het is de organisatie gelukt om het benodigde budget zonder financiële steun vanuit het Rijk bij elkaar te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Kwint over tal van constructies om het salarisplafond (WNT-norm) bij de publieke omroep te omzeilen

MPs Aartsen and Kwint asked whether public broadcasters use contracting constructions, such as external producers paying presenters, to circumvent the WNT salary cap, and how side-job registers are kept and published. The minister answered that he has no overview of the contracts, that the broadcasters report no such constructions, and that oversight of the Governance Code and registers lies with CIPO and the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Because contracts do not have to be submitted to me, I have no overview.
Omdat overeenkomsten niet aan mij voorgelegd hoeven te worden, heb ik geen overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er onrust heerst binnen het Commissariaat voor de Media

An MP asked the minister about unrest at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including the effect of board resignations on decision-making, rules on side jobs, the chair's generous severance scheme, and safeguards against post-employment conflicts of interest. The minister answered that mandate extensions keep routine decisions going, that a new chair is expected soon, that the severance scheme will be revised and the chair will not claim it, and that existing rules sufficiently prevent conflicts of interest.
Once a new chair is in office, I will consult with the Commissariaat on how optimal transparency and review of side positions can be achieved.
Zodra een nieuwe voorzitter in functie is, zal ik met het Commissariaat nader overleggen hoe optimale transparantie en toetsing van nevenfuncties bereikt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat er grote verschillen zijn in financiële steun die scholieren krijgen voor digitale middelen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about large differences in financial support for pupils' digital learning materials, including whether schools may require expensive laptops and who should pay. The minister replied that schools must fund digital materials from their lump-sum budget, may request but not require a specific device, and that a study on the adequacy of funding will report in March 2020.
I am currently having research carried out into the efficiency and adequacy of the funding.
Ik laat op dit moment onderzoek doen naar de doelmatigheid en toereikendheid van de bekostiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Kwint over het bericht ‘Sportende kinderen maken teveel herrie: sluiting sportveld dreigt na veertig jaar’

MPs Heerema and Kwint asked the minister about a Nijmegen primary school's sports field facing closure over noise complaints from neighbours, questioning the investment, the noise-based closure, and possible guidance for schools. The minister replied that the municipality is responsible for local matters, the closure procedure has been paused for joint talks, and no guidance document for schools is considered necessary.
How this is shaped within the legal framework is a local matter.
Hoe dit binnen de wettelijke kaders wordt vormgegeven is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het  bericht dat  bijlesscholen de zomerklandizie zien toenemen.

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that private tutoring firms see summer demand rising, linked to teacher shortages and education quality, and asked about costs, inequality and causation. The minister answered that a study on supplementary education is underway with results due in September, that the costs are not separately recorded, that teacher shortage is not a stated motive in earlier research, and that the regional teacher-shortage approach is still too early to evaluate.
In September I will share the final report of the study on the forms, scope and motives of supplementary and private education with your House.
In september zal ik het eindrapport van het onderzoek naar de verschijningsvormen, omvang en motieven van aanvullend en particulier onderwijs met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er woede is over de woekerhandel in kaartjes voor een voetbalwedstrijd

An SP MP asked the government about ticket scalping for the Feyenoord-Ajax match, including enforcement, a national ban, ACM action, EU initiatives, and transparency obligations for ticket resellers. The Staatssecretaris answered that a national ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, that clubs block scalped tickets under KNVB conditions, and that the government will not pursue further national rules given the cross-border nature of the problem.
I do not have the means at my disposal to map the total extent of this problem, since it is a cross-border matter.
Ik heb niet de middelen tot mijn beschikking om de totale omvang van deze problematiek in kaart te brengen, aangezien het hier gaat om een grensoverschrijdende aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat mensen hun servicekosten niet terugkrijgen als een concert wordt geannuleerd

An SP MP asked whether ticketing company Ticketmaster breaks the law by not refunding service fees when a concert is cancelled, and how consumers can enforce their rights. The State Secretary confirmed the ACM considers non-refunding unlawful, pointed to the ACM's enforcement powers, consumer complaint routes, and said ticket prices and fees are not capped by law, only subject to transparency requirements.
It is up to the ACM to judge whether companies comply with the consumer protection rules.
Het is aan de ACM om te oordelen of bedrijven zich houden aan de consumentenbeschermingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht Leraar waarschuwt tegen ‘wurgcontract’ van uitzendbureau

Two MPs asked the minister whether a staffing agency's demand for a buyout fee before a teacher could be hired on a permanent contract, and the resulting teacher turnover, is acceptable and harms pupils. The minister said school boards are responsible for staffing, called the practice undesirable, will raise the case with the PO-Raad and is running a pilot on non-employed staff, but declined to propose new restrictions.
School boards are responsible for appointing temporary agency staff, in line with what has been agreed in the collective labour agreement.
Schoolbesturen zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van uitzendpersoneel, in overeenstemming met wat daarover is afgesproken in de cao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de hoge ouderbijdrage van ouders met hoogbegaafde kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about very high voluntary parental contributions (up to 500 euro and beyond) charged for gifted-child classes, and about the possibility of parents appealing to schools or subsidies to normalise these fees. The minister agrees that implicit barriers are unacceptable and that a high voluntary contribution can deter enrolment, but points to school complaint procedures, says no maximum amount will be introduced for now, and promises only to discuss the example at a future meeting with the PO-Raad and to raise the monitoring question with researchers.
There is no complete picture of how many gifted-child classes ask for voluntary parental contributions.
Er is geen compleet beeld bij hoeveel hoogbegaafdenklassen vrijwillige ouderbijdragen worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht ‘Dagbehandeling autisme voor kinderen uit regio Eindhoven op de helling; GGzE worstelt met bezuinigingen'

An MP asked the minister whether a special day-treatment programme for children with severe autism in Eindhoven, threatened by municipal budget cuts, should be preserved, and whether the minister would intervene with the municipality and the education inspectorate. The minister answered that the municipality has extended the programme to August 2021, that the education offered there is not fully in line with regulations and needs clearer arrangements, and that contacts with the municipality and inspectorate are ongoing without committing to direct intervention.

It is up to the municipality, within the framework of the Youth Act and the regional youth policy set by the youth region, to provide a coherent package of youth care for all young people in the municipality.

Het is aan de gemeente om binnen de kaders van de Jeugdwet en het regionale jeugdbeleid zoals vastgesteld in de jeugdregio, een samenhangend geheel aan jeugdhulp te bieden voor alle jeugdigen in de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Meenen en Kwint over de uitvoering van de motie Van den Hul c.s. (35 000 VIII, nr. 173) inzake het inzichtelijk maken van de ruimtebrief

Four MPs asked the government why it will only 'point to' a Parliament motion asking education employers to make the 'ruimtebrief' (budget space letter) public at collective bargaining tables, and why the letter's name is changing. The minister replied that the government cannot oblige employers to disclose the letter's contents, that collective bargaining freedom precludes forced disclosure, and that it will send employers a cover note pointing to the motion while noting it conflicts with confidentiality and negotiating freedom.
The cabinet cannot and will not oblige education employers to make the contents of the letters transparent at the negotiating table.
Het kabinet kan en wil de onderwijswerkgevers niet verplichten om de inhoud van de brieven inzichtelijk te maken aan de onderhandelingstafel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kwint en Westerveld over examens van 38 eindexamenleerlingen van de Duin en Kruidbergmavo uit Driehuis aangetekend op weg waren naar de tweede correctie, maar niet op de plaat

MPs asked why exam scripts sent by registered post to second correctors went missing again, questioning the reliability of postal transport and the fairness to pupils who must retake exams. The minister said schools are responsible for dispatch under the protocol, that such losses are rare (six cases this year, mostly theft), that retakes are unnecessary once scores are established, and that scanning and emailing scripts carries fraud and hacking risks.
As a rule, sending exam work by registered post is reliable.
In de regel is verzending van het examenwerk per aangetekende post betrouwbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht van de gemeente Rotterdam dat Stichting Acato, een onderwijsvoorziening voor leerlingen met autisme met dit werk moet stoppen

An MP asks the education and health ministers whether they still stand by their letter ending the Acato autism education project in Rotterdam, and whether they will investigate and intervene to keep it running. The ministers answer that Rotterdam and the schools must find a suitable alternative, that the matter is under examination by the municipal ombudsman, and that they will not intervene directly but will report on the motion in a later letter.
The situation is currently being examined by the Rotterdam municipal ombudsman.
De situatie wordt momenteel onderzocht door de gemeentelijke ombudsman van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de uitzending van BOOS over het feit dat mbo-studenten zakken op keuzedelen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a BOOS broadcast reporting that mbo students were failing elective modules (keuzedelen), whether other institutions had reported similar problems, whether a student can fail on a grade or only be given no grade, how future failures will be prevented, and how rules will be communicated. The Minister said the broadcast underlines the need for clear communication, that results for keuzedelen do not yet count toward diplomas for current students but will from 2020/2021, that schools set the exam format, and that schools are responsible for informing students.
Since the introduction of the keuzedelen, clear communication on this has been pursued.
Vanaf de inwerkingtreding van de keuzedelen is ingezet op duidelijke communicatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht dat kleine gemeenten met erfgoed hulp nodig hebben

MPs Beckerman and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she shares the Raad voor Cultuur's view that small municipalities need more help protecting their heritage, and whether she will provide more money and options and coordinate with provinces and the Interior Minister. The Minister agreed in principle, describing existing support (Erfgoedacademie, RCE advice, provincial heritage hubs, Erfgoeddeal) and promised a written response to the Raad's advice in May.
I will respond in writing to your House's request regarding the advice of the Raad voor Cultuur, in which I will go further into how I support municipalities.
Ik kom op het verzoek van uw Kamer met een schriftelijke reactie op het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur, waarin ik nader in zal gaan op de wijze waarop ik gemeenten ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld inzake het bericht ‘Meneer Bouwels moet blijven’

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether LVO, a school board in Limburg, is not renewing temporary teacher contracts amid a teacher shortage, and about the situation at VMBO Maastricht. The minister denied that all temporary contracts are being cut, attributed non-renewals to declining pupil numbers and the board's personnel policy, and said he will report on LVO and VMBO Maastricht in June 2019.
The school board has the responsibility for conducting good strategic personnel policy.
Het schoolbestuur heeft de verantwoordelijkheid voor het voeren van goed strategisch personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de macht van de netmanager groot is

An SP MP asks whether the growing power of NPO network managers over programme content, at the expense of broadcasters, is undesirable, whether this was foreseen when the Media Act was amended, and whether combining the network manager and director roles is acceptable. The minister says such concerns are known and views differ, points to statutory safeguards added in 2016 to protect broadcasters' responsibility for programme content, and considers combining the roles poor checks and balances but expects the NPO to remedy any excessive concentration of power.
From the standpoint of checks and balances, I do not consider this a good combination.
Vanuit een oogpunt van checks and balances vind ik dit geen goede combinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Kwint over de fusie van Partou en KidsFoundation

MPs Bruins and Kwint asked about the merger of childcare providers Partou and KidsFoundation, their takeover by investment firms Onex and Waterland, and whether private equity harms public interests in childcare. The State Secretary answered that all providers must meet the Childcare Act, that the competition authority ACM reviews such mergers, that sector margins are modest, and that studies show no quality decline.
In 2017 parents reported €3.5 billion in gross childcare costs to the Tax Administration.
In 2017 hebben ouders voor € 3,5 mld aan bruto kosten voor hun kinderopvang doorgegeven aan de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht 'ZZP-docent rukt op'

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about the growing number of teachers working as self-employed freelancers (zzp'ers), its effect on workload, costs and possible sham self-employment. The minister called such self-employment undesirable where aimed at higher pay, said he lacks specific data on teachers as zzp'ers or on sham self-employment, and pointed to planned data collection and regional agreements.
I do not have information about cases of possible sham self-employment.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over gevallen van mogelijke schijnzelfstandigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het lerarentekort mogelijk op te lossen is met de Onderwijsassistent-Plus

An SP MP asked whether a Summa College and Scholengroep Eenbes pilot training teaching assistants into 'Onderwijsassistent-Plus' staff, who could effectively teach alone, circumvents teaching-qualification rules and lowers quality. The minister replied that such staff may not teach independently except in emergencies under a qualified teacher's responsibility, that no rules are being relaxed, and that the initiative is an in-house training programme.
There is no question of an experiment in the sense of deviating from national laws and regulations.
Er is geen sprake van een experiment in de zin van afwijken van de landelijke wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat lokale poppodia dreigen te verdwijnen

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she recognises that local pop venues are at risk of closing and whether she will map the adequacy of pop infrastructure, talk with municipalities and provinces, and step in to save venues. The minister acknowledged the importance of local venues, pointed to existing investment schemes and a 2017 study, and said cultural policy responsibility is shared with subnational governments and that she has asked the Raad voor Cultuur for advice, with a policy letter to follow.
I am now awaiting the advice of the Raad voor Cultuur.
Ik ben nu in afwachting van het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat 20 procent van de startende docenten in het mbo na één jaar uitstroomt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that 20 percent of new vocational (mbo) teachers leave after one year, and whether this is worrying, what causes it, and what will be done about support for new teachers. The minister called the outflow worrying, pointed to cao agreements on supporting new teachers, said she cannot identify causes from available research but will explore including an analysis of outflow causes in the 2019 career survey.
I will explore whether an analysis of the causes of outflow can also be included in this.
Ik zal verkennen of hierin ook een analyse naar de oorzaken van uitstroom opgenomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht “dat Pim wil en kan leren, maar niet naar vwo mag”

An SP MP asks why a pupil with autism and a high havo average (8.6) is refused permission to move to vwo, given the missing second modern foreign language, and whether the hardship clause and a right to move from havo to vwo should be used. The minister refuses a hardship exemption, arguing the second modern language is an integral part of the vwo diploma, but says no legal barrier prevents the move and a uniform havo-vwo transfer right is being explored.
I am currently considering a havo-vwo transfer right with possible uniform admission requirements.
Daarom beraad ik mij momenteel op een doorstroomrecht havo-vwo met eventuele uniforme toelatingseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Buitenweg over collectief beheer bij Video on Demand

MPs Kwint and Buitenweg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about collective management of remuneration for Video on Demand, including whether American rightsholders are paid and whether similar international arrangements could apply. The Minister answered that a convenant between Dutch PAM collecting societies and Rodap covers VOD remuneration until 1 January 2020, that no data exist on cross-border flows, that some non-Rodap VOD providers such as Netflix have not paid so far, and that an evaluation of the Wet auteurscontractenrecht will be started.

Inquiries with the CBOs show that no overviews exist of the total remuneration collected through mandatory and voluntary collective management and its distribution to foreign authors and neighbouring rightsholders.

Navraag bij CBO's levert op dat er geen overzichten bestaan van het totaal via verplicht en vrijwillig collectief beheer geïnde vergoedingen en de repartitie daarvan aan buitenlandse auteurs- en naburig rechthebbenden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht ‘Archeologie bij gemeenten ondergeschoven kindje’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how to respond to a report that municipal archaeological oversight falls short, citing monitor figures on policy currency, staffing, inter-municipal cooperation, finds reporting and enforcement. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, argues the figures do not necessarily mean poor practice, points to ongoing instruments and projects with the heritage agency, and sees no need for an action plan.
I see no reason for an action plan.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een te snelle keus voor mbo dreigt

An SP MP asked the Education Minister whether she would inventory mbo programmes with enrolment caps, and whether such caps could force pupils into premature study choices and harm access and equal opportunity. The minister replied that schools may cap places for labour-market or capacity reasons, that early enrolment is not a definitive choice, and that she will monitor and critically examine capped programmes with high labour-market demand, without committing to a full inventory.
Based on the monitoring information, I will critically examine vocational programmes with a numerus fixus and high labour-market demand.
Op basis van de monitoringinformatie zal ik kritisch kijken naar beroepsopleidingen met een fixus en een grote arbeidsmarktbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de lokale omroepen aan de rand van de afgrond staan

MPs Kwint and Van der Molen asked whether the minister knows of financial distress at local broadcasters such as 1Twente and whether bankruptcies would damage local democracy, and what should be done to make them viable. The minister replied that funding is a municipal responsibility, that an advisory request on organisation and financing was sent in February 2019, that a possible pilot for regional broadcasters is being explored, and that the EUR 5 million for investigative journalism is not meant to keep local broadcasters afloat.
I am aware of the signals about the precarious financial situation of the broadcasters 1Twente and Omroepstichting ZuidWest.
Ik ben bekend met de signalen over de precaire financiële situatie van de omroepen 1Twente en Omroepstichting ZuidWest
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over peperdure zesweekse schoolreizen van vierduizend euro

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about costly six-week school trips of 4,000 euro organised by 't Wylde Leren, including whether schools may outsource teaching, whether such trips count as lawful education, and whether they may be compulsory or exclude pupils. The minister answered that such trips can fit within the rules if run under school responsibility and approved by the works council, flagged inequality risks, but gave no monitoring inventory and said the school board, not the provider, is accountable for quality.
I currently see no reason for further inventory.
Ik zie op dit moment nog geen aanleiding voor verdere inventarisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over initiatieven voor passend onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about the ZON-approach to inclusive education, including whether schools may experiment with it, how to provide education outside school for some children, and the Linawijs initiative. The Minister said schools may choose their method within current law, that existing rules already allow education outside school, and that an evaluation and joint policy work with VWS will follow, but declined to answer the questions before the committee meeting.

As indicated in the education-care letter 2, Minister de Jonge and I are developing education-care arrangements in which we examine whether the current education and care frameworks provide enough scope and clarity to offer tailored support to children with strong support needs.

Zoals aangegeven in de onderwijs-zorgbrief 2 werken Minister de Jonge en ik onderwijs-zorgarrangementen uit waarin wij bekijken of de huidige onderwijs- en zorgkaders genoeg ruimte en duidelijkheid bevatten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Aartsen over het bericht 'Geen Nederlandse media meer op Europese nepnieuwslijst'

MPs Kwint and Aartsen asked whether Dutch media had been excluded from EU East StratCom's EUvsDisinfo list, whether the Dutch government would send a letter on it, whether Dutch journalists would stop appearing on the list, and who funds EUvsDisinfo. The minister replied that no Dutch sources remain on the website after assurances from the EEAS, that she assumes no future Dutch press articles will appear, and that the taskforce is funded from the EEAS communication budget within the general EU budget, without a copy of the agreement being provided.
There is no copy of that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de cijfers over bevoegde en benoembare docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked the education minister to explain the difference between old and new measurement methods for qualified and appointable teachers in secondary education, to provide 2009–2018 breakdowns, and to distinguish qualified from appointable teachers in official reporting. The minister answered that pre-2014 data are unreliable so only 2014–2017 tables are provided, that the government will distinguish the categories going forward, and that the Inspectorate will be asked to do the same.
It is not possible to provide a reliable series for the entire period 2009–2018.
Het is niet mogelijk om een betrouwbare reeks voor de gehele periode 2009–2018 aan te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een 16-jarige scholier wil doorstromen naar het vwo, maar geen enkele school hem wil hebben

MP Kwint asked whether it is acceptable that a 16-year-old with a havo diploma was refused admission to vwo at every school in the Hague region, how common extra admission requirements are, and whether a right to progress from havo to vwo should be legislated. Minister Slob answers that a conditional progression right is planned for havo to vwo, that extra requirements are used regularly according to a sample study, and that an impact analysis will be sent to parliament.
I will therefore develop a right to progress from havo to vwo, in line with the planned progression right from vmbo to havo.
Ik zal daarom analoog aan het te ontwikkelen doorstroomrecht vmbo-havo een doorstroomrecht havo-vwo uitwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor Rammstein binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether her consultations and the Senate's rejection of the earlier ticket-resale bill justify dropping legislation against resale of concert tickets at excessive prices, and whether national law can work given cross-border resale. The minister answered that national legislation is not effective because resale is online and cross-border, that she will pursue an awareness campaign, support industry initiatives and raise the issue at EU level instead of enacting the requested law.
I choose an information campaign to make consumers more aware of resale.
