Ik kies voor een voorlichtingscampagne om de consument bewuster te maken van doorverkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over websites die sjoemelen met kaartverkoop

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a secondary ticket seller offering tickets to a Michelle Obama lecture before sales had started, and promising 100% ticket guarantees while its terms allow cancellation of resold tickets. The minister confirmed the facts, said misleading-information rules under the Civil Code apply but that individual judgments are not hers to make, offered to inform the ACM, and pointed to a consumer awareness campaign and European action rather than new legislation.
However, it is not for me to pass judgment on this in individual cases.
Het is echter niet aan mij om daar in individuele gevallen een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een docent op een reformatorische school mag worden ontslagen om een theaterstuk

An MP asked the minister whether an identity committee could dismiss a teacher for a theatre play in his free time, given that the school's info guide offered drama, and whether a committee jointly appointed by boards and staff is independent. The minister answers that drama was never taught at the school, that the committee's composition is statutory and independent, and that he sees no reason to doubt the procedure was followed.
I have no reason to assume that in this case the rules were not followed, nor that the independence of the committee is at stake.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat bij onderhavige casus niet conform deze regels gehandeld zou zijn, noch dat de onafhankelijkheid van de commissie in het geding zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de nieuwbouw van een school in de problemen komt door stijgende bouwkosten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers whether rising construction costs delaying a school building in De Bilt reflect a national problem, whether budgets are sufficient, and how mould and damp in schools are addressed. The ministers replied that rising costs are a market trend with no specific school-building data kept, that existing budgets for maintenance are adequate, and that they see no further options to curb cost increases beyond a pilot programme.
Beyond that, I see no options for curbing the rising costs of school construction resulting from market developments.
Verder zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de stijgende kosten van scholenbouw als gevolg van marktontwikkelingen in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de AOb past voor landelijk overleg over lerarentekort

MPs Kwint asked the minister about the AOb union withdrawing from the national teacher shortage talks and whether the shortage can be solved without structural extra funding. The minister regrets the withdrawal, says the national talks will continue, defends the handreiking and the regional approach, and points to existing structural investments in workload reduction and salaries.
I regret the AOb's departure from the national teacher shortage consultation.
Ik betreur het vertrek van de AOb uit het landelijke overleg lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Gezocht, oppasouder voor als de leraar ziek is'

MP Kwint (SP) asks the education minister about reports of schools using parents as supervisors when teachers are ill, whether this is education, its effect on quality, how many schools take such measures, and whether first-year pabo students may teach alone. Minister Slob answers that supervision alone is not education, that unqualified staff may only be a temporary emergency measure, that the inspectorate is investigating shortages and that first-year students may not teach independently, while admitting no national overview of unqualified teachers exists.
Deploying unqualified staff in certain situations, however, remains a temporary emergency solution.
Het inzetten van onbevoegde medewerkers in bepaalde situaties blijft echter een tijdelijk noodoplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen inzake de zorgboerderij de Grote Brander

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked why funding for education at the Grote Brander care farm in Deventer stopped, leaving children without the schooling they benefited from. The minister answered that the location does not meet legal requirements for a school site, so it is not eligible for education funding, and that the school board and municipality are working on individual solutions.
However, it is also my responsibility to be able to guarantee the quality of education for every child.
Het is echter ook mijn verantwoordelijkheid om de kwaliteit van onderwijs voor elk kind te kunnen garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor Rammstein binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An MP asked why Rammstein tickets sold out within minutes and resellers offered them at many times face value, and why the government had not enforced the motion to curb ticket profiteering. The minister answered that a national resale ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, so the government chose a consumer awareness campaign and support for existing industry initiatives instead.
Our conclusion is that such legislation is ineffective and hardly enforceable, if at all.
Onze conclusie is dat dergelijke wetgeving ineffectief en niet of nauwelijks handhaafbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een docent op een reformatorische school mag worden ontslagen om een theaterstuk

An MP asked the minister whether a teacher at a reformed school may be dismissed over a theatre production about his gambling addiction, whether the identity committee's approval is sound, and whether the inspectorate granted exemptions from core curriculum goals on arts and citizenship. The minister said the identity committee's approval is outside his role, that no exemption from the core goals was granted since 2006 and none is needed, and that the school's claim about an exemption rested on a misunderstanding.
I have no further role in that.
Ik heb daar verder geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over terugloop van het aantal kinderen met een (leer)achterstand in de voorschoolse opvang in Amsterdam

The SP MP Kwint asked the minister whether the share of children with a learning disadvantage in Amsterdam pre-school care is falling by 20-25% as a city alderman claimed, whether this is a national trend, and how the government will tackle it. The minister answered that the Inspectorate will report reach figures in 2020, that a harmonisation study is planned, that additional funding of 170 million euros per year is provided from 2020, and that no national trend of drop-out due to income-related contributions has been found.
State Secretary Van Ark will conduct research early next year into the state of affairs of the harmonisation.
Staatssecretaris Van Ark zal begin volgend jaar onderzoek doen naar de stand van zaken van de harmonisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de subsidie voor zij-instromers primair onderwijs bijna op is

An SP MP asked whether the subsidy ceiling for career-changer teachers in primary education was nearly exhausted, and whether redistributing funds between education sectors is acceptable given the teacher shortage. The minister confirmed the ceiling was nearly reached, raised the budget by 4 million euro, and defended inter-sector redistribution as efficient budget use.
The budget is therefore being increased by 4 million euro.
Het budget wordt daarom met 4 miljoen euro verhoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een school een blaastest invoert voor dronken leerlingen

Two SP MPs asked the government about a school introducing voluntary breath tests for intoxicated pupils and about alcohol use among minors at school and local events. The state secretary said the school's voluntary test is its own choice, enforcement of the age limit lies with municipalities, and prevention and a national prevention accord are being pursued.
Supervision and enforcement of the 18-year age limit for alcohol sales is assigned to municipalities.
Het toezicht en de handhaving van de leeftijdsgrens van 18 jaar bij de verkoop van alcohol is belegd bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het verplicht betalen van de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage bij het bestellen van schoolboeken

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether schools may require parents to pay the voluntary parental contribution when ordering textbooks online, and what the minister will do about it. The minister answered that payment must never be a condition for receiving textbooks, that the inspectorate monitors this and sanctions may follow, but declined to guarantee it will not recur and refused to require distributors to change their systems.
It is contrary to the law to make payment of the parental contribution mandatory, for example by imposing it as a condition when ordering school textbooks.
Het is in strijd met de wet om het betalen van de ouderbijdrage te verplichten, bijvoorbeeld door deze als voorwaarde op te leggen bij het bestellen van schoolboeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de kosten van digitale leermiddelen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked the minister about parents struggling to pay for compulsory laptops or tablets at secondary school and rising ICT costs. The minister said the contributions are voluntary, that schools must provide devices if they go fully digital, and that a new cost monitor and a 2020 evaluation of the Free School Books Act will follow.
Schools may not oblige parents to pay for a laptop or tablet.
Scholen mogen ouders niet verplichten om een laptop of tablet te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over de alarmerende omvang van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked the ministers about the teacher shortage, including the lack of vacancy data, spending on temp agencies, overtime, and higher tuition for second degrees in education and care. The ministers acknowledged the shortage, said they do not hold current vacancy figures, pointed to schools' own choices and the work-pressure accord, and referred to a recent letter on the shortage.
The ministry does not have a current vacancy overview.
Het ministerie heeft geen actueel vacatureoverzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over het bericht Miljoenen aan onderwijsgeld gaat naar commerciële bureaus

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked whether schools spending millions on commercial staffing agencies is desirable given the teacher shortage, and whether the government would cap such spending. The minister said the teacher shortage is urgent, that the government does not know how many schools use agencies, will collect data from agencies in January 2019, and that staffing contracts are a matter for school boards, so no cap is planned.
Recruiting staff is a matter for school boards.
Het werven van personeel is een zaak van besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de brief van het Platform VVVO aan de Coördinatiegroep over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de curriculumherziening

An SP MP asks the education minister about the Platform VVVO letter criticising the curriculum.nu redesign: whether the development task is too big, whether the breadth of school subjects is secured, whether assessment is being planned too early, and whether teachers and subject associations should lead. The minister answers that the timeline is feasible, subject expertise is safeguarded through subject circles, assessment follows content, and the current format gives sufficient direction.
For that reason I maintain the assignment for the development teams.
Ik houd om die reden dan ook vast aan de opdracht voor de ontwikkelteams
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat particulier onderwijs een vlucht neemt

An SP MP asked the minister about the rapid growth of private education and whether it signals declining quality and rising inequality in regular schools. The minister rejects the claim that regular education quality is declining, states that parental choice for private schools is protected by freedom of education, and says he sees no reason to discourage it.
I therefore see no reason for the ministry to discourage parents from enrolling their child in a private school.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om vanuit het ministerie ouders te ontmoedigen hun kind in te schrijven op een particuliere school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de CPB notitie ‘Effectieve interventies leerachterstanden in het primair onderwijs’

An MP asked the education minister how he responds to the CPB's tips on effective interventions for learning disadvantage in primary education, including teacher quality, class size and universal versus targeted pre-school education. The minister endorses the CPB tips, points to funding and a teacher release pilot, notes class size only helps with large reductions, and defends targeted pre-school education based on Dutch longitudinal research.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) compenseert in de normering bij examens

MPs Kwint asked whether the CvTE's practice of compensating errors through normering rather than adjusting correction models, as argued by Rene Kneyber, is accurate and defensible. The minister answered that the picture is incorrect, that the CvTE is responsible for the exams, that expert reports confirm the normering method is correct, and that teachers may not invoke article 32e(2) WVO to override correction guidance but must use the route in article 7 of the general correction rules.
The CvTE is responsible for the content and assessment of the central examinations in secondary education.
Het CvTE is verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en beoordeling van de centrale examens in het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat wanbetaling van freelance-journalisten in de hand wordt gewerkt door de overheid

SP MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked whether freelance journalists are underpaid, whether minimum rates and collective bargaining should be allowed, and whether labour inspections target abuses at publishers. The minister answered that the government wants more protection for low-paid self-employed workers through a rule presuming an employment contract, that collective rate-setting by freelancers is restricted by competition law, and that inspections are risk-based without commenting on ongoing investigations.
I do not make any statements about possible ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de helft van de mbo’ers spullen moet kopen die ze vervolgens niet gebruiken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that about half of mbo students must buy books and materials they never use, raising costs and asking about controls, the scale per institution, and a forthcoming guidance document on school costs. The minister agreed unused books are undesirable, announced a handreiking (guidance) on school costs with the MBO Raad and JOB, said no checks on necessity are carried out, and noted the Inspectorate will supervise school costs under the guidance.
I believe it should be regularly evaluated whether prescribed books are actually used and the book lists adjusted accordingly.
Ik vind dat regelmatig dient te worden geëvalueerd of voorgeschreven boeken daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt en de boekenlijsten daarop worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over onderwijs aan hoogbegaafde kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about parental contributions of thousands of euros for gifted-children programmes, whether these are lawful, funding adequacy, teacher training and oversight of the additional 15 million. The minister answered that voluntary contributions are allowed but admission may not depend on them, that no recent national figures exist, and that a subsidy scheme with evaluation will be introduced.
No recent national figures are available on developments in parental contributions for support for gifted children.
Er zijn op landelijk niveau geen recente cijfers beschikbaar over (ontwikkelingen in) ouderbijdragen voor ondersteuning van hoogbegaafden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Kwint over de St. Maartenschool te Nijmegen

MPs Westerveld and Kwint asked about the financial and care arrangements of the St. Maartenschool in Nijmegen, including a loan with municipal guarantees, responsibility between the ministries, and whether parents must arrange care funding themselves. The ministers answered that a process to organise care during school hours is underway with a process facilitator, that municipalities provided a bridging subsidy, and that the government is exploring direct funding for complex cases but this will take time.
In the letter we will send to the House of Representatives on this issue, we will also set out how we can support schools and parents in the meantime.
In de brief die wij over deze problematiek aan de Tweede Kamer zullen sturen, zullen we ook opnemen op welke wijze wij scholen en ouders in de tussentijd kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat de ouderbijdrage in het basis- en voortgezet onderwijs steeds hoger wordt en daardoor de ongelijkheid tussen leerlingen groeit

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked whether voluntary parental contributions in primary and secondary schools have risen sharply, widening inequality, and asked for figures by denomination, region and level. Minister Slob answered that the cited data do not show that rise, that a new Schoolkostenmonitor is due end 2018, that per-denomination and per-region figures are not monitored, and that PO-Raad and VO-raad agreements are expected by year end, with legislation possible if they fail.
If no or unsatisfactory agreements come, I will consider whether it is necessary to amend the law.
Mochten er geen of onbevredigende afspraken komen, dan zal ik bezien of het nodig is de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij-instromers die binnen een jaar hun lesbevoegdheid halen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked how a one-year pabo teacher training run by LOI Hogeschool for career changers fits with the regular four-year route and the accreditation and suitability requirements, and how its quality is ensured. The ministers answered that the programme is NVAO-accredited (valid to 2021), is the only such one-year route found, and that the training includes all required outcomes, so teaching requirements are not being compromised.
It is a 240-credit programme. No exemptions are granted.
Het is een opleiding van 240 studiepunten. Er worden geen vrijstellingen verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Rudmer Heerema en Van Meenen over het oppotten van geld door schoolbesturen

Four MPs asked the minister whether school boards are hoarding funds, whether a liquidity upper bound of 1.5 is desirable, and related questions on reserves, the Commissie-Don benchmarks, and the inspectorate's oversight. The minister rejected an absolute upper bound, argued that average liquidity is not a causal result of lump-sum funding and that the 'oppotten' label does not fit, and said the inspectorate uses signalling values as detection tools while committing to adjust the framework.
I see no reason to take a different position.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een ander standpunt in te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij instromers

Two MPs asked the ministers about career-entrant teachers who obtain their teaching qualification within a year, after a TV programme showed trainees teaching alone after five weeks. The ministers replied that career-entrants must qualify within two years under individual support, that the TV programme's one-year course is a separate intensive pabo track where trainees are not fully alone in the classroom, and that they will not weaken teaching standards.
We have no plans to tamper with the requirements of the teaching profession.
Wij hebben geen plannen om te tornen aan de eisen van het leraarschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Van Meenen en Westerveld over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint, Van Meenen and Westerveld asked whether Avatar-related ideas spreading in democratic private schools, paid Avatar courses being advertised at schools, and the lack of stricter inspection and diploma requirements are acceptable. Minister Slob answered that the inspectorate will take the signals into its regular supervision of private schools, that paid services may be offered at schools, that no equalisation of inspection with publicly funded schools is planned, and that the qualification obligation remains important though students may take the state exams or pursue other routes.
The signals will be taken into account by the inspectorate in its supervision.
De signalen zullen door de inspectie worden betrokken in haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat OCW geen standpunt meer inneemt over doorbetalen stakers in het basisonderwijs

MP Kwint (SP) asked why the education ministry takes no position on whether schools should pay striking teachers, and why the minister did not clarify this for school boards. The minister replied that pay during strikes is a matter between employer and employee since primary-education pay has been decentralised, that the law does not require payment, and that he does not wish to appear to endorse paying strikers.
Whether the employer actually pays the salary or not is a matter between employee and employer.
Of de werkgever het salaris daadwerkelijk al dan niet doorbetaalt is een zaak tussen werknemer en werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor U2 binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew concert tickets for U2 sold out within minutes while hundreds were offered on resale site Seatwave, and what they would do about resale practices and a motion on ticket profiteering. The ministers said resale is under study with the sector, cannot guarantee LiveNation does not sell directly to resale sites, point to the consumer authority ACM, and refer to a separate letter on implementing the motion.
I cannot guarantee that LiveNation does not sell tickets directly to secondary ticket websites.
Ik kan niet garanderen dat LiveNation kaarten niet direct verkoopt aan secundaire ticketwebsites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het subsidiëren van privaat onderwijs door gemeenten

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked whether municipal and national subsidies for international schools, aimed at attracting foreign investors and expats, are a responsible use of public money compared with regular schools. The minister replied that foreign investment mostly creates jobs for Dutch workers, that the subsidies were a one-off measure to reduce international school waiting lists, and that funds were not given directly to a private school group.
The central government did not provide any funds to the Amity Education Group. That was a decision of the municipality of Amsterdam.
Het Rijk heeft geen middelen beschikbaar gesteld aan de Amity Education Group. Dat betreft een besluit van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen over de begeleiding van leerlingen in en de kwaliteit van het particulier onderwijs

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked whether it is acceptable that tutors and therapists recruit clients on private schools, the number of such schools, and the quality of private democratic schools, including a case where a pupil learned nothing for two years. The minister answered that schools must provide necessary support themselves, that paid extra services are permitted, that the Inspectorate monitors quality and can withdraw recognition, and that no further research or legal change is planned.
I have no insight into the number of schools where additional paid services are offered.
Ik heb geen zicht op de hoeveelheid scholen waarop aanvullende betaalde diensten worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld  over het bericht dat ouders steeds meer aan de basisschool betalen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about rising parental contributions to primary schools for trips and extra activities, unclear voluntariness, exclusion of children, and whether contributions should be capped or limited. The minister answered that schools may only request voluntary contributions, that schools must communicate this clearly, that the parental-consent role in school councils governs amounts, and that new measures will be announced in a letter, but declined to cap contributions.
In my letter on the implementation of the Vermue and Van Dijk motion I state that I am also concerned about the parental contribution, based on the signals I receive.
In mijn brief over de uitvoering van de motie Vermue en Van Dijk geef ik aan dat ik me ook zorgen maak over de ouderbijdrage, op basis van de signalen die ik ontvang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over kwaliteit van en toezicht op de archeologie nav advertentie Volkskrant d.d. 26 januari ´Creatief met archeologie, tips voor projectontwikkelaars´

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an advertisement advising developers how to avoid archaeological obligations, and about oversight of archaeology by municipalities and inspectorates. The minister denied that unlawful excavation is widespread, said no structural oversight gap exists, but acknowledged definitional confusion and some quality and backlog issues, and promised further case study and monitoring.
I have no reason to think that this system does not meet its requirements.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te denken dat dit stelsel niet voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Kinderopvang kampt met personeelstekort'

The SP MP Kwint asked the state secretary how the childcare sector will be helped to recruit enough qualified staff, given the staff shortage linked to the stricter staff-child ratio, the stalled collective bargaining, and whether employers' stance and fixed contracts could ease the problem. The state secretary answered that the sector itself must secure staffing, that the stricter ratio for infants takes effect in 2019 with a looser rule for after-school care, that bargaining is for the social partners, and that the government wants more permanent jobs but leaves this to the sector.
It is up to the sector itself to ensure that enough qualified staff are recruited.
Het is aan de sector zelf om te borgen dat er voldoende kwalitatief personeel wordt aangetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de publieke omroep informatie doorgeeft aan adverteerders

An MP asked the minister whether the public broadcaster's app shares viewing data with advertisers without consent, and whether this should stop until users can opt out. The minister answered that the NPO is responsible for its advertising choices within privacy law, that supervision lies with the Commissariaat, ACM and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is investigating the app, without committing to a new step.
It is the NPO's own responsibility to make considerations and choices within the applicable laws and regulations and to account for them.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de NPO om binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving afwegingen en keuzes te maken en daar verantwoording over af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Van den Hul en Van Raan over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen in 'plofklassen''

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, PvdA and PvdA-adjacent PvdD asked the ministers about reports that more children are in large classes, with questions on class size trends, staffing ratios, teacher workload and passend onderwijs. The minister answered that large-class shares fell in 2017, gave statistics across primary and secondary education, and said no binding class-size targets or sector-wide agreements would be made.
The share of large classes has fallen over the past year.
Het aandeel grote klassen is het afgelopen jaar gedaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat tonnen aan onderwijsgeld verloren gaan

MP Kwint asked whether schools using costly staffing and recruitment agencies to hire teachers, diverting education funds, is desirable, and how many schools do so and why. The minister answered that schools are responsible for staffing, that data on agency use is lacking and is being explored, and that the government is monitoring developments and will raise the matter with the PO-Raad without halting the practice.
There is no data available on the number of school boards that use commercial companies to recruit teachers.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal schoolbesturen dat gebruik maakt van commerciële bedrijven om leraren te werven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over het bericht dat middelbare scholen, universiteiten en bedrijven de handen ineens slaan voor het aanpakken van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked about a plan in which secondary schools, universities and Shell jointly retrain surplus Shell staff as teachers, raising questions about funding ties, teacher independence, loyalty and pay. The ministers welcomed the initiative as a way to expand career-changer entry, said Shell only points staff to the option and funds some training costs, and stated that schools set contracts and pay while relying on existing checks.
We rely on the checks and balances built into education regulation, among other things.
Wij vertrouwen op de checks and balances die onder meer door regelgeving in het onderwijs zijn ingebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint inzake de Muur van Mussert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Muur van Mussert, a historic wall in Ede, should be protected as a national monument given reports it may be demolished for a campsite expansion. The minister said a review on remembering wartime heritage will conclude next year, the wall is currently protected by a municipal heritage ordinance, and a rijksmonument designation will be decided after talks with the municipality and owner.
Based on talks with the municipality and the owner and on the mentioned review, I will decide whether protection of the Wall as a national monument is the most suitable instrument.
Op basis van gesprekken met de gemeente en de eigenaar en op basis van de genoemde verkenning zal ik besluiten of bescherming van de Muur als rijksmonument het meest geschikte instrument is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld inzake het bericht dat op de ene school de helft van de vmbo'ers doorgaat naar de havo en op de andere niemand

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked why some vmbo schools send over half their pupils on to havo while many others send none, and whether schools' fear of dropout and their performance ratings discourage stapelen. The minister attributes differences to school admission policy and transition programmes, says there are no signals of schools refusing pupils for dropout fears, and defends the statutory vmbo-havo right conditional on one extra exam subject.
I have no signals that havo schools refuse pupils solely because they are negatively assessed on dropout.
Ik heb geen signalen dat havo-scholen leerlingen enkel weigeren om de reden dat zij negatief worden afgerekend op uitval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over STER-inkomsten

An SP MP asked why the shortfall in STER advertising revenue and the expected gap in the public broadcaster budget were not raised at the coalition talks, and why the EY reports and the ministry's knowledge of the shortfall were not disclosed sooner. The minister replied that these issues were not discussed at the formation table, that the EY draft reports are internal and not published, that the ministry informed the state secretary and NPO during the study, and that the November media budget letter was the proper moment to inform parliament.
Draft versions are part of the internal process and are not made public.
Conceptversies zijn onderdeel van het interne proces en worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld en Van den Hul inzake het eindrapport van de Taskforce Voortgezet Onderwijs Zeeuws-Vlaanderen 'Gewoon goed onderwijs!'

MPs Kwint, Westerveld and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Zeeuws-Vlaanderen secondary education taskforce report, including OCW's role, the funding of about 3 million euro per year, eligibility for island-school status, passend onderwijs deficits and start groups. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, that OCW funds only mandatory education and will contribute only one-off transition costs, that the schools do not qualify for the island regulation, and that other items fall to other ministries or to the regional partners.
The national government makes no contribution to the structural additional costs.
Het Rijk levert geen bijdrage aan de structurele extra kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over Ster-inkomsten

MP Kwint asked when the falling STER advertising revenues became known at OCW, why the EY report dated 9 September 2017 was not shared, and why the shortfall was absent from the coalition agreement and reported only after the new minister took office. The minister answered that EY's final report was delivered on 5 October 2017, the 9 September date being a planned deadline, that the findings were used in the media budget letter of 17 November 2017, and that no other shortfalls are known.
EY delivered the final report on 5 October last.
Het definitieve rapport heeft EY opgeleverd op 5 oktober jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over hoe de leraar verplicht werd zich bij te scholen

MP Kwint asks how the teacher register's slogan 'by, for and of the teacher' fits with petitions against it and why it was imposed without support. The minister defends the register as developed with teacher organisations, saying ownership by the profession remains central and that voluntary uptake fell short of the 40% target.
The law was developed through intensive cooperation with the Onderwijscoöperatie, consisting of the largest representative teacher organisations.
De wet is tot stand gekomen op basis van een intensieve samenwerking met de Onderwijscoöperatie, bestaande uit de grootste vertegenwoordigende lerarenorganisaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de door leraren (LerarenAdviesRaad) voorgedragen kandidaat-voorzitter voor de Onderwijscoöperatie is afgewezen door het bestuur van de Onderwijscoöperatie

An SP MP asked whether the Onderwijscoöperatie board rejected the teacher-nominated chair candidate and, if so, for what reasons. The ministers declined to ask the board for its reasons, stating that appointment decisions belong to the independent organisation.
We do not consider it appropriate to ask about the reasons for appointing or not appointing a specific candidate.
Wij vinden het niet gepast om te vragen naar de beweegredenen om een specifieke kandidaat wel of niet te benoemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Raan over het bericht dat olie- en gasbedrijven het Nederlandse onderwijs beïnvloeden

MPs Kwint and Van Raan asked the Minister of Education whether oil and gas companies influence Dutch schools, citing a report on fossil-industry teaching materials, and whether such materials should be banned. The Minister saw no reason to believe pupils are targeted, said schools are responsible for choosing materials, and refused a ban because the teaching materials market is free.
I have no reason whatsoever to assume that pupils are being 'bombarded' by oil and gas companies with arguments 'from the fossil industry'.
Ik heb daarbij geen enkele aanleiding om te veronderstellen dat leerlingen door olie- en gasbedrijven «worden bestookt» met argumenten «van de fossiele industrie».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kwint over het bericht 'Groot deel leerlingen locatie Zadkine Rotterdam volgt lessen niet'

MPs Van den Hul and Kwint asked the Minister of Education about reports that many logistics students at ROC Zadkine Rotterdam rarely attend lessons, and how the institution, inspectorate and municipality respond. The Minister calls the attendance findings serious, says Zadkine must fix its absence policy with the municipality's help, notes a follow-up inspection check in January, and outlines the municipal truancy-supervision legal gap and planned legislation.
The management of the five examined courses can, however, as the Inspectorate report showed, do more to reduce absenteeism and dropout.
Het management van de vijf onderzochte opleidingen kan er echter, zo is uit het Inspectierapport gebleken, nog meer aan doen om verzuim en uitval terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over zorgen bij ouders over de studievoortgang van kinderen door problemen met toegang tot digitaal lesmateriaal

MP Kwint asked the minister whether it is acceptable that vocational students waited weeks for digital course material from distributor Studers, how many lack access, whether there are problems at other distributors, and how students will be protected from learning delays and cost. The minister answers that the matter is a private contractual issue between suppliers, schools and students, that most problems are now solved, that an independent investigation will follow, and that the government has no formal role in the refund or assessment questions.
Agreements between suppliers of course material and schools are agreements between two private parties. I have no direct involvement in them.
Afspraken tussen leveranciers van lesmateriaal en scholen zijn afspraken tussen twee private partijen. Ik heb daar geen directe bemoeienis mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over het bericht dat een NRC-journalist in de cel zat omdat hij weigerde foto’s af te staan

SP MPs asked whether a NRC journalist was jailed for refusing to hand over photos without a judge's authorisation, and what would prevent recurrence. The Minister confirmed the incident, said the prosecution service apologised, acknowledged no judicial review took place contrary to the guidelines on coercive measures against journalists, and said the case will be discussed widely within the prosecution service.

When the Public Prosecution Service wants material held by a journalist, the public prosecutor must submit a request to the investigating judge under Article 105 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to obtain an order to surrender it.

Wanneer het Openbaar Ministerie wil beschikken over materiaal dat onder een journalist berust moet de Officier van Justitie ex artikel 105 Wetboek van Strafvordering, bij de Rechter-Commissaris een vordering indienen om van de Rechter-Commissaris een bevel tot uitlevering te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kwint over de 1,4 miljoen euro die Nederland steekt in een onderwijsbedrijf voor de allerarmsten

Two SP MPs asked the minister whether the indirect 1.4 million euro Dutch investment in Bridge International Academies, a profit-seeking school operator, is responsible given reported quality, pricing, teacher pay and transparency problems, and what action was taken. The minister defended the investment as supporting affordable private education, reported contact with Bridge and ongoing independent evaluations, and declined to withdraw the support.
The cabinet sees no reason to recover this indirect support.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om deze indirecte steun terug te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint inzake het bericht dat het ROC West-Brabant onwettig lesgeld vraagt

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that ROC West-Brabant charges students more than the legal tuition fee when they are not financially attractive to the institution, and about related funding and stapelen issues. The Minister called it unacceptable and a single incident by one manager, said no amounts were billed after intervention, promised the Inspectorate and MBO Raad will be asked to watch for similar cases, and defended the cascade funding model as balanced.
To prevent such an undesirable situation, I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to pay extra attention to this during its regular supervision.
Om een dergelijke ongewenste situatie te voorkomen zal ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs verzoeken om hier tijdens het reguliere toezicht extra op te letten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over cursussen in het lerarenregister

MP Kwint asked the state secretary about commercial professionalisation events and courses validated for the teacher register, including early-bird discounts, prizes, a trampoline course and ticket raffles, and whether this undermines teachers' informed choices. The state secretary replied that validation is done by a teacher-only commission, declined to give a substantive view, said the law leaves course choice to teachers, and said she has no insight into providers or spending.
I have no insight into the individual providers in the register, nor into the budget that teachers or schools have spent on them.
Ik heb geen inzage in de individuele aanbieders in het register, noch in het budget dat leraren of scholen hieraan hebben besteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat conciërge ‘Meester Appie’ graag wil werken, maar wat niet mogelijk is

An SP MP asked the state secretary why a school could not hire conciërge 'Meester Appie' despite structural funds for conciërges and classroom assistants, and asked about the number of such staff, vacancies and trained assistants. The government said it has no figures on schools unable to hire for lack of funds, that school boards decide how to spend the funds, and gave staff and vacancy numbers without committing to any new action.
That is not known. School boards make their own choices about how to spend their financial resources.
Dat is niet bekend. Schoolbesturen maken zelf keuzes in de besteding van hun financiële middelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over het bericht dat er deze zomer meer mensen verdronken zijn dan in voorgaande zomers

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked the Minister of Health about reports of more drownings this summer, the decline in swimming skills linked to cuts to school swimming, and what measures are needed. The minister said the number of drownings is comparable to other years, that parents are primarily responsible for teaching swimming, that school swimming is the responsibility of municipalities and schools, and that a sector action plan is being finalised.
School swimming is a responsibility of municipalities and schools.
Schoolzwemmen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van den Hul inzake het bericht dat een mbo-student vanwege een spoedkeizersnede haar examens niet kon maken en daardoor het hele studiejaar over moet doen

MPs Kwint and Van den Hul asked whether a mbo student who missed her exams after an emergency caesarean and must repeat the whole year reflects a gap in rules protecting pregnant and student-parent students, and whether the minister will act on the adopted motion calling for a right to pregnancy leave and individual exam programmes. The minister answered that institutions can already offer tailored support, that the student must repeat the year as she missed too much, that consultations with stakeholders are ongoing with a handreiking and a letter to parliament planned for autumn, and saw no reason to intervene in this case.
I still hold the view that the legal position of student mothers and pregnant students is well secured in laws and regulations.
Ik ben nog steeds van mening dat de rechtspositie van studerende moeders en zwangere studenten goed geborgd is in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over ‘dat seksuele voorlichting op scholen niet voldoet’

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked the Minister of Education about reports that sex education in schools is inadequate, including inspectorate findings that many schools do nothing on sexual boundary-crossing behaviour, and whether schools can be compelled to meet core objectives and whether the duty should extend to upper secondary and vocational students. The government answered that schools have freedom in choosing methods, will improve information on intervention effectiveness, notes the inspectorate can impose sanctions for non-compliance, and says it will not extend the curriculum requirements beyond what is already in place.
If a school does not give effect to statutory requirements, the inspectorate will instruct the school to bring its education into line with them.
Als een school geen invulling geeft aan wettelijke eisen, zal de inspectie de school opdracht geven het onderwijs daar alsnog mee in overeenstemming te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, Bruins en Van Meenen over het bericht dat de Onderwijsinspectie uitleg wil over fouten in het vwo-eindexamen Frans

MPs asked the Minister about teacher complaints over errors in the VWO French final exam and whether the College voor Toetsen en Examens (CvTE) fixed them via correction-guideline additions and normering. The State Secretary answered that CvTE handled 95 signals, issued a correction-guideline addition changing three questions, and that the Inspectie found the handling correct, while declining to judge the signals substantively.
I myself do not enter into the substantive assessment or evaluation of signals about central examinations.
Zelf treed ik niet in de inhoudelijke beoordeling of waardering van signalen over centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de zorg- en leerboerderij Lyts Tolsum in Tzum geen onderwijs meer mag geven vanaf schooljaar 2018/2019

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether it is desirable that a care and learning farm in Tzum can no longer provide education from 2018/2019, leaving pupils with no route to their diploma, and whether action will be taken. The state secretary said that schools, partnerships and municipalities are responsible for finding suitable alternatives, declined to comment on individual cases, will leave it to the inspectorate to monitor, and announced a joint exploration of funding and organisation problems at the education-care interface.
It is not for me to go into individual casework and privacy-sensitive pupil data in the House.
Het is niet aan mij om in de Kamer in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek en privacygevoelige gegevens van leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Kwint over het bericht dat de schrijfvaardigheid van kinderen achteruit holt

MPs Futselaar and Kwint asked whether children's handwriting is deteriorating and whether schools and teacher training neglect handwriting instruction. The State Secretary answered that the 2012 Cito survey found no significant decline since 1999, that handwriting practice remains common, and that the curriculum question will be addressed by new development teams.
I therefore have no reason to assume that the handwriting development of pupils in primary school is deteriorating.
Ik heb daarom geen reden aan te nemen dat de handschriftontwikkeling van leerlingen op de basisschool achteruit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat stageplekken soms ‘verkapte werkplekken zijn, waar je geen cent voor krijgt’

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked the ministers whether internships are sometimes disguised regular jobs without pay, how often complaints occur, whether complaints are reported to SBB and the Inspectorate, what the rules on allowances are, and whether a study or safeguards are needed. The minister answers that abuse occurs mainly after graduation, that a sector analysis is underway, that complaints are few and under-reported, that the Inspectorate handles individual reports but does not mediate them, and that no extra study of in-school internships is needed.
To better map the extent of internship abuse after graduation in problem sectors, the Minister of SZW is having a study carried out.
Om de omvang van stagemisbruik na afstuderen in probleemsectoren beter in beeld te brengen laat de Minister van SZW een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat juffen en meesters die staakten een uur minder loon krijgen

An MP from the SP asked the State Secretary whether a school board in Wijchen was right to deduct one hour of pay from teachers who joined a strike, and whether other school boards did the same. The State Secretary answered that the pay was in the end paid out after consultation with the unions, and that the PO-Raad reported no other school boards deducting pay.
It has now become clear that, after consultation between the Kans en Kleur foundation and the unions AOB and CNV, the salary will be paid out.
Inmiddels is duidelijk geworden dat na overleg tussen de stichting Kans en Kleur en de vakorganisaties AOB en CNV het loon wordt doorbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint inzake het bezwaarschrift van een ouder, wiens dochter na het behalen van het havodiploma niet wordt toegelaten tot de vwo-opleiding op de eigen school

An MP asks whether a Berlage Lyceum pupil with a havo diploma can be denied entry to vwo at her own school, and whether this conflicts with the minister's stated right to upward progression. The State Secretary replies that schools set their own admission rules for higher years, that a statutory havo entry right is planned, that no national overview of school admission criteria exists, and that the school's stated vwo criteria were not met by the pupil.
The governing body of a secondary school determines the admission requirements for its own school itself.
Het bevoegd gezag van een school voor voortgezet onderwijs bepaalt zelf de toelatingseisen tot de eigen school.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Kwint over het bericht van fraude met tentamens door mbo-docenten op ROC Zadkine in Rotterdam

Kwint (SP) asked whether pressure on schools to award diplomas quickly and in large numbers raises the risk of exam fraud by vocational teachers at ROC Zadkine. Minister Bussemaker condemned the conduct as unacceptable and said she knows of no link between the funding method and fraud risk.
A link between the way institutions are funded and the risk of committing fraud is not known to me.
Een verband tussen de wijze van bekostiging van instellingen en het risico op het plegen van fraude is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en van Nispen inzake het bericht dat scholen stoppen met schoolzwemmen

The SP MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether they are concerned that four Utrecht primary schools stopped offering school swimming after a child drowned, whether other schools have done so, and what concrete measures the government will take to keep schools offering swimming lessons and to improve supervision and responsibility-sharing with pools. State Secretary Dekker answered that the decision lies with schools, that the government does not track their reasons centrally, that it will reiterate the 2005 school swimming protocol and the national platform's plan due at the end of 2017.
Offering school swimming is a consideration that schools make themselves.
Het aanbieden van schoolzwemmen is een afweging die scholen zelf maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over de kwaliteit van lokale media

MPs Van Raak and Kwint asked the government about the decline of local journalism, its role in democratic oversight of municipalities, the funding of local media, and municipal communications staff. The state secretary answered that declining advertising revenue drives media cuts rather than the 2017 public broadcasting cut, that a separate fund for local journalism is not warranted given existing subsidies, and that municipalities may communicate as they wish.
You will receive the research outline before the summer recess.
U ontvangt de onderzoeksopzet voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kwint en Beckerman over archeologische topvondsten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman asked the minister about archaeological top finds whose costly follow-up research may be unaffordable for municipalities, and about extending the 2015 one-off fund, an excess-cost scheme and funding for maritime and synthesis research. The minister said the regular costs are borne by initiators, rejected reinstating the excess-cost scheme, and will decide on the fund's continuation after an evaluation due by 1 September 2017, deferring cost estimates.
I will inform the House about this before 1 September 2017.
Ik zal uw kamer hierover voor 1 september 2017 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er een halvering van de zendtijd dreigt voor onderzoeksprogramma's

An SP MP asked whether the government shares concern over a proposed halving of airtime for investigative programmes at the public broadcaster and whether a fund for (regional) investigative journalism should be created. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO is independent in programming, that it is not cutting investigative journalism but prioritising quality, and that no new fund is needed since the Stimuleringsfonds voor de Journalistiek already exists.
I will not ask the NPO to make different choices in its programming.
Ik zal de NPO niet vragen om andere keuzes in de programmering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het lerarentekort in de Randstad leidt tot jacht op docent in spe

MP Kwint asked the minister about reports that teacher shortages in the Randstad lead to a rush for pabo students, whether this is undesirable, and what the government will do about the shortage and workload. The minister answers that unqualified pabo students being placed in classrooms is undesirable, that the inspectorate has been instructed to act, and refers to the teacher shortage plan and letters for further measures.
We find the situation in which students are already hired during their training as regular group teachers and stand in front of the class independently and without supervision undesirable.
Wij vinden de situatie waarin studenten al tijdens hun opleiding worden aangenomen als reguliere groepsleerkracht en zelfstandig en zonder begeleiding voor de klas staan niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat InHolland lerarenopleidingen afstoot en gaat doorverwijzen naar de Hogeschool van Amsterdam

MP Kwint asked the minister about InHolland's plan to phase out its teacher-training programmes and refer students to the Hogeschool van Amsterdam, and about the broader teacher shortage, including Germans teachers. The minister answered that the government is monitoring the transfer, that a teacher-shortage plan is underway, and that she will discuss the matter with the sector bodies, while the works council's complaint about being informed too late was acknowledged with apologies from the college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat het uitzendbureau Maandag het lerarentekort commercieel probeert te exploiteren

MP Kwint asked the minister whether staffing agency Maandag's practice of offering teacher lease cars and permanent contracts, including to unqualified teachers, amounts to commercially exploiting the teacher shortage, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary replied that schools are responsible for recruitment, that the government monitors unqualified teaching and will examine any monopoly position with the competition authority if warranted, but it does not intend to change the legal exceptions for unqualified teachers.
I am not aware of the situation as you describe it.
Ik ben niet bekend met de situatie zoals u die omschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht ‘dat schoolbesturen van basisscholen de gasrekening betalen uit de salarispot van leraren’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for education whether primary school boards using teacher salary funds for heating, cleaning and digital boards is acceptable, and whether earmarking personnel and material funding should be introduced. The state secretary replied that lump-sum funding gives boards freedom of allocation, that funding is sober but adequate, that the sector's finances are positive, and rejected earmarking and extra funds while acknowledging room to improve accountability.
I do see possibilities to improve the lump-sum system in the accountability of school boards and to make better use of existing information.
Ik zie wel mogelijkheden tot verbetering van de lumpsumsystematiek in de verantwoording van schoolbesturen en het beter benutten van de bestaande informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Marijnissen over de geplande sluiting van Den Bongerd in Oss

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether the planned closure of Den Bongerd in Oss is justified given the lack of support from staff, parents and pupils, whether co-determination should have binding consent rights, and whether the closure fits the goal of appropriate education for every child. The state secretary answered that the closure is a deliberate decision to move Den Bongerd's expertise into regular schools, that staff and parents were involved through co-determination bodies, that no statutory consent right is planned, and that he sees no reason to meet the board to prevent the closure.
As I explained earlier in the letter to parliament on the progress of the pupil decline measures of 28 October 2016, I see no reason to align the consent right when closing a school.

Zoals ik eerder heb toegelicht in de Kamerbrief over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de maatregelen leerlingendaling van 28 oktober 2016, zie ik geen aanleiding voor het gelijktrekken van het instemmingsrecht bij sluiting van een school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat kinderen en jongeren steeds slechter lezen

MP Kwint asked the minister how she views a report claiming one in ten pupils in group 8 and one in three MBO-2 students do not sufficiently master Dutch, and whether a growing low-literacy generation is acceptable. The minister disputes the report's picture, citing low failure rates on the Centrale Eindtoets and stable PISA results, while describing existing and planned measures such as the Tel mee met Taal programme and a summer 2017 proposal on reading performance.
I have taken note of this report.
Ik heb kennis genomen van dit rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over onbevoegde wiskundedocenten voor de klas

MP Kwint asks the State Secretary about the growing number of unqualified mathematics teachers in secondary schools, their effect on education quality, and whether the 2016 action plan is working. The State Secretary answers that the share of mathematics lessons taught by unqualified teachers rose only marginally, that schools are working on it, and that it is too early to judge the plan's results.
At this point it cannot yet be said how many teachers have obtained their qualification since February 2016, because these data are not yet available.
Het valt op dit moment nog niet te zeggen hoeveel leraren hun bevoegdheid gehaald hebben sinds februari 2016, omdat deze gegevens nog niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het Edith Stein College dat op onwettelijke gronden leerlingen weigerde

MP Kwint asked the State Secretary for Education why the Edith Stein College unlawfully selected pupils based on Cito scores, why the rector and staff did not catch it, what will happen to pupils redirected to another school, and whether other schools use similar selection. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said it was corrected quickly, stated that referral to an alternative school is not compulsory, and declined further investigation, pointing to the Inspectorate and the forthcoming evaluation of the Primary Education Testing Act.
I therefore do not consider further investigation necessary.
Nader onderzoek acht ik dan ook niet nodig.

m: Motie van het lid Van Baarle over bedrijven die zaken willen doen in Israël wijzen op mogelijke mensenrechtenschendingen
Asks the embassy and RVO to standardly warn companies doing business in Israel that they may face human rights violations.
requests the government to standardly point out to companies doing business in Israel via the embassy and RVO
verzoekt de regering om bedrijven die zaken (willen) doen in Israël er vanuit dẹ ambassade en de RVO standaard op te wijzen
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over spoed bij het weren van producten uit nederzettingen in de door Israël bezette gebieden
Asks the government to act urgently on national measures to keep products from Israeli settlements in occupied territories off the market.
requests the government to act with urgency on national measures to exclude products from unlawful settlements
verzoekt de regering om spoed te betrachten ten aanzien van de nationale maatregelen om producten uit de onrechtmatige nederzettingen
Motie van de leden Van Baarle en Dobbe over de behandeling van de Nederlandse opvarenden van de Global Sumud Flotilla door Israël veroordelen
Asks the government to condemn Israel's treatment of Dutch Global Sumud Flotilla passengers and urgently investigate alleged abuse of Dutch citizens.
requests the government to condemn Israel's treatment of the Dutch passengers of the Global Sumud Flotilla
verzoekt de regering om de behandeling van de Nederlandse opvarenden van de Global Sumud Flotilla door Israël te veroordelen
Motie van het lid Piri c.s. over de Afghaanse bewakers en hun gezinnen direct naar Nederland overbrengen
Asks the cabinet to honour earlier commitments and bring Afghan guards and their immediate families to the Netherlands immediately.
requests the cabinet to honour the commitments already made and the safe transfer of Afghan guards
verzoekt het kabinet om de reeds gedane toezeggingen na te komen en de veilige overbrenging van Afghaanse bewakers
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over financieringsmogelijkheden voor economische activiteiten in Israël opschorten
Asks the government to suspend financing, guarantees, export credit, subsidies and co-financing for economic activities in Israel.
requests the government to suspend financing, guarantees, export credit instruments, subsidies and co-financing programmes for economic activities in Israel

verzoekt de regering om de mogelijkheid voor financiering, garanties en ẹxportkredietinstrumenten alsmede de subsidies en cofinancieringsprogramma's voor wat betreft economische activiteiten in Israël op te schorten
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over Israëlische banken en bedrijven uitsluiten van het SWIFT-systeem
Asks the government to work for excluding Israeli banks and companies from the SWIFT payment system.
requests the government to work towards excluding Israeli banks and companies from the SWIFT system
verzoekt de regering zich in te zetten voor het uitsluiten van Israëlische banken en bedrijven van het SWIFT-systeem
Motie van het lid Dobbe c.s. over de steun voor mondiale gezondheidsinitiatieven waarborgen
Asks the government to guarantee continued support for global health initiatives such as Global Fund, Gavi and UNAIDS.
requests the government to guarantee support for global health initiatives such as Global Fund, Gavi and UNAIDS
verzoekt de regering de steun voor mondiale gezondheidsinitiatieven, zoals Global Fund, Gavi en UNAIDS, te waarborgen
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over een mensenrechtenreview voor alle Nederlandse overheidsinitiatieven gericht op handelsbevordering met Israël
Asks the government to subject all Dutch government initiatives promoting trade with Israel to a human rights review.
requests the government to subject all forms of Dutch government initiatives aimed at promoting trade with Israel to a human rights review
verzoekt de regering om alle vormen van Nederlandse overheidsinitiatieven die gericht zijn op handelsbevordering met Israël te onderwerpen aan een mensenrechtenreview
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over boycots, desinvesteringen en sancties tot het beleid tegen Israël maken
Asks the government to make boycott, divestment and sanctions (BDS) the core of its policy towards Israel.
requests the government to embrace the BDS movement and make boycott, divestment and sanctions the policy against Israel
verzoekt de regering om de inzet van de BDS-beweging te omarmen en boycot, desinvesteringen en sancties tot het beleid tegen Israël te maken
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over economische Nederlandse activiteiten in illegaal bezet Palestijns gebied verhinderen

Met voorliggend amendement stellen indieners voor om het extra bedrag in de kinderbijslag (de AKW+), dat uitgekeerd wordt aan ouders van inwonende kinderen met een intensieve zorgbehoefte, wél te indexeren.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Baarle ter vervanging van nr. 8 over het ongedaan maken van de verlaging van de indexatie in het jaar 2024
Amends the child benefit act to cancel the 2024 reduced indexation of child benefit, so benefits are fully indexed.
With this amendment the submitter proposes to reverse the cabinet's proposed reduction in child benefit indexation in 2024.
Met dit amendement stelt de indiener voor om de door het kabinet voorgestelde verlaging van de indexatie van de kinderbijslag in 2024 ongedaan te maken.
Motie van het lid Leijten c.s. over maatregelen ter versterking van de integriteit van het landsbestuur

Asks the government to work out integrity measures for the executive, including an exit interview with parliament for early-leaving ministers, a lobby register, public ministerial agendas, and a shares register for ministers and MPs.
an exit interview with the House of Representatives when a minister leaves early
een eindgesprek met de Tweede Kamer als een bewindspersoon voortijdig vertrekt
Motie van de leden Van Baarle en Leijten over het afdwingbaar maken en sanctioneren van de gedragscode voor bewindspersonen
Asks the government to examine how the code of conduct for ministers and state secretaries can be made enforceable and sanctioned, and to propose this.
requests the government to examine how this code of conduct can be made enforceable or sanctioned and to make a proposal for this
verzoekt de regering om te bezien hoe deze gedragscode afdwingbaar of gesanctioneerd kan worden en hiertoe een voorstel te doen
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over het betreuren van de handelswijze bij de sollicatie van twee bewindslieden
Expresses regret that two former ministers applied for other posts without first clearing it with the Prime Minister, contrary to the handbook for ministers.
regrets this conduct and proceeds to the next business
betreurt deze handelwijze, en gaat over tot de orde van de dag
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over het wetsvoorstel intrekken en een andere dekking zoeken voor de verbetermaatregelen
Asks the government to withdraw the bill on not indexing child benefit and to find other funding for implementation measures at implementing agencies.
requests the government to withdraw the bill on not indexing the basic child benefit amount for 2022 to 2024

verzoekt de regering om het wetsvoorstel «niet-indexeren van het basiskinderbijslagbedrag en het extra bedrag van de kinderbijslag in de Algemene Kinderbijslagwet over de jaren 2022, 2023 en deels 2024» in te trekken
Amendement van het lid Van Baarle c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het extra bedrag van de kinderbijslag voor kinderen met een intensieve zorgbehoefte wel indexeren
Amendment restores indexation of the extra child benefit (AKW+) for families with children needing intensive care, saving about 0.8 million euro in implementation costs.
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over in alle publicaties van de Nederlandse regering alleen de relatieve-armoededefinitie gebruiken
Asks the government to use only the relative poverty definition in all its publications and those of its institutions.
requests the government to use only the relative poverty definition used by surrounding countries in all publications
verzoekt de regering alleen de relatievearmoededefinitie die al onze omliggende landen gebruiken, te gebruiken in alle publicaties
Motie van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over een commissie instellen die de normen voor het bestaansminimum vastlegt
Asks the government with Nibud to set up a commission defining minimum-subsistence norms for different groups, including social participation and access to services.
requests the government, together with Nibud, to set up a commission that defines norms for the subsistence minimum, including social participation
verzoekt de regering samen met het Nibud een commissie in te stellen die normen voor het bestaansminimum – inclusief sociale participatie – vastlegt
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over het effect op kinderarmoede en lage inkomens monitoren
Asks the government to monitor and report on the actual effect of the bill's measures on child poverty and low incomes.
requests the government to monitor the actual effect of the measures in the bill on child poverty and low incomes
verzoekt de regering om het daadwerkelijke effect van de maatregelen in het wetsvoorstel op kinderarmoede en lage inkomens te monitoren
Amendement van het lid Van Baarle over het extra bedrag van de kinderbijslag voor kinderen met een intensieve zorgbehoefte wel indexeren
Proposes that the extra child benefit amount for children with intensive care needs remain subject to indexation.
to index the extra amount of child benefit paid to parents of children with intensive care needs
om het extra bedrag in de kinderbijslag, dat uitgekeerd wordt aan ouders van inwonende kinderen met een intensieve zorgbehoefte, wél te indexeren
Amendement van het lid Van Baarle over het ongedaan maken van de verlaging van de indexatie in het jaar 2024
Amendment to delete the 0.1 percentage point lower indexation of child benefit in 2024, so benefits are fully indexed that year.
With this amendment the submitter proposes to reverse the cabinet's proposed lower indexation of child benefit in 2024.
Met dit amendement stelt de indiener voor om de door het kabinet voorgestelde verlaging van de indexatie van de kinderbijslag in 2024 ongedaan te maken.
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over een hand-out voor ieder erkend stagebedrijf over herkenning van discriminatie tijdens de selectie
Asks the government to ensure every recognised internship company receives a hand-out on recognising and preventing discrimination during selection.
requests the government to ensure that every recognised internship company receives a hand-out with information on how discrimination during selection can be recognised and prevented
verzoekt de regering, om te bewerkstelligen dat ieder stagebedrijf dat erkend wordt een hand-out krijgt met informatie over hoe discriminatie tijdens de selectie herkend en voorkomen kan worden
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over bewerkstelligen dat iedere leerling op de hoogte wordt gebracht van het bestaan van het Meldpunt Stagediscriminatie
Asks the government to ensure every student is informed of the Meldpunt Stagediscriminatie complaints point.
requests the government, in cooperation with education, to ensure every student is informed
verzoekt de regering, om in samenwerking met het onderwijs te bewerkstelligen dat iedere leerling op de hoogte wordt gebracht
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over het aanscherpen of expliciet vermelden van het tegengaan van discriminatie in de voorwaarden voor erkenning van een stagebedrijf
Asks the government to consider tightening or explicitly stating anti-discrimination conditions for recognition of internship companies.
requests the government, in cooperation with SBB, to consider whether tightening or explicitly stating anti-discrimination in the conditions for recognising an internship company
verzoekt de regering, om in samenwerking met de SBB te bezien of een aanscherping of expliciet vermelden van het tegengaan van discriminatie in de voorwaarden voor erkenning van een stagebedrijf
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over een specificering dan wel aanscherping van de huisvestingsvoorwaarde in de Wav
Asks the government to consider specifying or tightening the housing condition for work permits under the Wav via the BuWav to address abuses in migrant worker housing.
requests the government to consider whether specifying or tightening the housing condition in the Wav via the BuWav can help combat abuses
verzoekt de regering, om te bezien of een specificering dan wel aanscherping van de huisvestingsvoorwaarde in de Wav middels het BuWav kan bijdragen aan het tegengaan van misstanden
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over een evaluatie van de wetswijziging binnen vijf jaar na inwerkingtreding
Asks the government to send the House an evaluation of the amended Foreign Workers Employment Act within five years of entry into force.
to send an evaluation of the amendment proposal to the House of Representatives
een evaluatie van het wijzigingsvoorstel te doen toekomen aan de Tweede Kamer der Staten-Generaal
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over een verruiming van de arbeidsduurbeperking voor vluchtelingen tot 26 weken
Motion asking the government to extend the work-hours limit for refugees from 24 to 26 weeks in the BuWav to improve their labour market position.
requests the government, to improve the position of refugees, to extend the limit on working hours for refugees in the BuWav to 26 weeks
verzoekt de regering, ten behoeve van de verbetering van de positie van vluchtelingen, de beperking van de arbeidsduur voor vluchtelingen in het BuWav te verruimen tot 26 weken
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over expliciteren hoe door het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs het lerarentekort wordt aangepakt
Asks the government to explain how the National Education Programme will address the teacher shortage and to share a plan with the Chamber before summer.
to further explain how the National Education Programme will implement the recommendations of the teacher shortage task force
nader te expliciteren op welke manier het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs uitvoering zal geven aan de aanbevelingen van de aanjager aanpak lerarentekort
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over het betrekken van leerlingen bij de totstandkoming van herstelplannen van scholen
Asks the government to ensure more firmly that students are involved in drafting school recovery plans.
requests the government to more firmly ensure that students are involved in drawing up school recovery plans
verzoekt de regering, om nadrukkelijker te borgen dat leerlingen betrokken worden bij de totstandkoming van de herstelplannen van scholen
Motie van het lid De Hoop c.s. over 3% van het budget van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs bestemmen voor sport en cultuur
Asks the government to earmark 3% of the National Education Programme budget for proven sport and culture initiatives in primary and secondary education.
earmark 3% of the National Education Programme budget for primary and secondary education
3% van het budget uit het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs voor het funderend onderwijs te oormerken
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over onderadvisering bij leerlingen met een migratieachtergrond
Asks the government to take additional measures and raise awareness about under-advising of pupils with migrant backgrounds and lower socio-economic status.
requests the government to ensure additional measures are taken against under-advising and that awareness of the problem increases
verzoekt de regering, om te bewerkstelligen dat er aanvullende maatregelen worden genomen tegen en dat er meer bewustwording komt over het probleem van onderadvisering
Motie van het lid Van Baarle over de invoering van digitale hulpmiddelen monitoren op kansengelijkheid
Asks the government to closely monitor the introduction of digital tools for equal opportunities.
requests the government to explicitly monitor the introduction of digital tools for equal opportunities
verzoekt de regering, om de invoering van digitale hulpmiddelen nadrukkelijk te monitoren op kansengelijkheid
Amendement van het lid Vestering c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over een grondslag voor het stellen van brandveiligheidsregels
Creates a statutory basis in the Animal Act so the government can set fire-safety rules protecting farm animals from stable fires by or under a general administrative order (AMvB).
This amendment aims to create the legal basis for setting rules to protect farm animals from the dangers of stable fires by or under a general administrative order

Dit amendement beoogt de wettelijke basis te creëren voor het stellen van regels voor de bescherming van landbouwhuisdieren tegen de gevaren van stalbranden bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Opvarenden Global Sumud Flotilla melden nachtelijke aanvallen van Israël, Italië stuurt fregat'

An MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the government has independent information on reported Israeli attacks on the Global Sumud Flotilla, whether it condemns them, whether it considers the Gaza blockade illegal, what contact it has had with Dutch participants, and how it protects them. The minister answers that the government lacks independent information, declines to condemn or confirm the attacks, reports diplomatic contacts and requests to Israel and Spain and Italy, and says sanctions are not on the table.
The cabinet has no independent information about the precise nature and circumstances of the reported attacks.
Het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over de precieze aard en toedracht van de gerapporteerde aanvallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het illegale 'Israëlische' enteren van de Global Sumud Flotilla

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla, whether the government condemns it, whether it violates international law, how Dutch participants will be freed, and whether sanctions will be imposed. The minister confirmed awareness of the interception, said the ministry requested Israel's legal justification, called for scaled-up humanitarian access, and said sanctions are not currently under consideration while awaiting that justification.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has asked the Israeli authorities for a justification of the legal basis for Israel's actions following the interception of the ships.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft de Israëlische autoriteiten verzocht om een onderbouwing van de juridische basis voor het Israëlische handelen naar aanleiding van de onderschepping van de schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Ceder, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over dat Nederland moet meewerken aan overbrengen ambassadebewakers
