Six MPs asked the ministers whether the Dutch state must help transport 42 Afghan embassy guards after a summary-judgment ruling that the state acted unlawfully by not evacuating them. The minister contests the ruling, says the guards were not state employees, has appealed on an urgent basis, and says the appeal court suspended enforcement pending its decision, so no further transport steps are being taken.
On 12 September the appeal court suspended the State's obligation to immediately implement the judgment until it has ruled on the appeal.
Het gerechtshof heeft op 12 september jl. de verplichting voor de Staat geschorst om per direct uitvoering te geven aan het vonnis totdat het hof in het hoger beroep over deze zaak heeft geoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen de leden van Baarle en Ergin over het rapport ‘Tussen Minaret en Ministerie’ Ministerie’

Two DENK MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers how the government will restore trust among mosque boards and Muslim communities after the 'Tussen Minaret & Ministerie' report, and whether it will apologise, ban discriminatory policy, appoint a national coordinator against anti-Muslim hatred and hold structured dialogue. The government answered that rebuilding trust is needed and it is pursuing dialogue, a discrimination test in the Beleidskompas, and periodic talks with Muslim organisations, but it declined a separate anti-Muslim-hatred coordinator in favour of a single coordinator for all discrimination grounds.

Nevertheless, the cabinet considers it desirable that the other grounds of discrimination be housed in a single institute, so that fragmentation of attention and approach to these grounds is prevented.
Desalniettemin acht het kabinet het wenselijk dat de overige discriminatiegronden bij één instituut belegd worden, zodat versnippering van de aandacht en aanpak van deze gronden voorkomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat de koning aanwezig was bij loftuitingen over het Israëlische leger

An MP from DENK asked the Prime Minister whether he approved of prayers praising the Israeli army, and of the King's presence, at a Portuguese Synagogue event in Amsterdam, given alleged war crimes in Gaza. The Prime Minister answered that the King attended a religious anniversary, has no influence over liturgical content, that such prayers have no political meaning, and that the government rejects the premise that the event served a political purpose.
The King attended the celebration of the 350th anniversary of the Portuguese Synagogue in Amsterdam on Sunday 7 September.
De Koning woonde op zondag 7 september in Amsterdam de viering bij van het 350 jarig bestaan van de Portugese Synagoge.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zakenmannen verkopen voor tientallen miljarden aan Israëlische wapenindustrie’

MP Van Baarle asked ministers about reports that Dutch businessmen supply electronic components via SASMOS to Israeli arms firms, raising prosecution, export control, and complicity questions. The government mostly declined to comment on individual companies, stated that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and reaffirmed Dutch export control and the 2025 measures on Israel.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether conduct that may be criminal and over which the Netherlands has jurisdiction is involved.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of sprake is van gedragingen die mogelijk strafbaar handelen opleveren en waarover Nederland rechtsmacht heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zélf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Israël’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the government has been silent on sanctions against Israel after a leaked EU report documented serious international humanitarian law violations in Gaza, and why it took so long to act on the report. The minister replied that the EU report was reviewed, the Article 2 evaluation was completed and discussed in June 2025, and the government announced concrete measures including backing suspension of the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, banning two Israeli ministers, and tightening export and divestment policy.
The cabinet took the content of the reports into account in deciding to initiate an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement.
Het kabinet heeft de inhoud van de rapporten meegewogen bij het besluit om een evaluatie van Israëls naleving van artikel 2 van het Associatieakkoord te initiëren.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over ‘Israëlische minister Katz wil van Gazaanse stad Rafah een gesloten kamp maken’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a reported Israeli plan to confine Gaza's population in a closed camp in Rafah breaches international humanitarian law, and what the government would do about it including sanctions. The minister replied the plan was not shared with the Netherlands, called an army-sealed zone for civilians unacceptable and a likely violation of international law, said Israel was pressed bilaterally, and pointed to a broader package of EU and national measures.
However, the plan has not been shared with the Netherlands. The cabinet therefore has no knowledge of the content of the plan.
Het plan is echter niet gedeeld met Nederland. Het kabinet heeft daarom geen kennis van de inhoud van het plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Frankrijk zal Palestina erkennen als staat.’

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands would follow France in recognising a Palestinian state, and about Israeli annexation calls and the 2024 ICJ advisory opinion. The minister answered that recognition must be part of a political process toward a two-state solution, that it is a national competence, and that the occupation is unlawful and annexation calls are condemned, but gave no commitment to recognise Palestine now.
Erkenning vraagt om een zorgvuldige afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over wapenexportvergunningen voor het Israëlische Iron Dome-systeem

An MP asked the ministers about the minister's remark on two export licences for parts of Israel's Iron Dome system and what exports were involved. The government answered that two licences (January 2024 and March 2025) covered radar components made in Canada, transited via the Netherlands to Germany, and were not exported directly to Israel.
These are goods that were not produced in the Netherlands but in Canada.
Het gaat hier om goederen die niet in Nederland, maar in Canada zijn geproduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri, Teunissen, Van Baarle, Paternotte en Dassen over het Nederlandse busbedrijf EBS en banden met de illegale bezetting van de Palestijnse Gebieden

MPs asked the government about Dutch bus operator EBS, owned by Israel's Egged Transportation, which the UN lists in connection with settlements, and whether Dutch public money paid through student travel products and provincial concessions amounts to assistance to the occupation. The government confirmed the facts, restated its discouragement policy on economic ties with settlement businesses, said it has no insight into the financial flows between EBS and Egged, and declined to take concrete steps beyond encouraging decentralised authorities to follow the policy.
The cabinet has no insight into the business relationship and financial flows between EBS and Egged Transportation Ltd. and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de zakelijke verhouding en financiële stromen tussen EBS en Egged Transportation Ltd. en kan hier dus geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het oppakken en uitzetten van de deelnemers van de March to Gaza

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether the government would condemn Egypt's arrest and deportation of March to Gaza participants and what it was doing to press Egyptian authorities. The minister replied that expulsion is a sovereign right, that the Netherlands had urged proportionality, and that the travel advice already warned against demonstrating there.
The travel advice for Egypt explicitly warns of the risk of arrest for participating in demonstrations, even if they are peaceful.
In het reisadvies voor Egypte wordt expliciet gewaarschuwd voor het risico op arrestatie bij deelname aan demonstraties, ook als deze vreedzaam zijn.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Paternotte, Dobbe, Teunissen en Van Baarle over het gehouden rondetafelgesprek over de situatie in Gaza en bijbehorende position papers

MPs from Volt, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether there is a serious risk of genocide in Gaza, when the Dutch state became aware of it, and what concrete steps the Netherlands has taken to prevent or end it under the Genocide Convention, including on arms exports, sanctions and an EU association agreement review. The minister answered that the Netherlands is cautious about qualifying situations as genocide, that the duty to prevent arises upon knowledge of a serious risk without a court ruling, and listed diplomatic steps taken such as the EU review of Israel's association agreement, sanctions on two ministers, and the arms export policy, while declining to join the South Africa case.
The Netherlands is generally cautious about qualifying situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend met het kwalificeren van situaties als genocide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de Freedom Flotilla

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Freedom Flotilla's Gaza voyage, Israeli threats of military action, whether the government would condemn them and sanction Israel, and how it monitors the situation. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands had alerted Israel to a Dutch citizen aboard and urged no force, noted the ship was intercepted on 9 June with no current signs of violence, and said consular assistance was provided on request.
There are currently no indications of the use of force by Israel against the ship and its crew.
Er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen voor geweldgebruik van Israël tegen het schip en zijn bemanning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Troops fire warning shots in air as foreign diplomats tour West Bank’s Jenin

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about reported Israeli warning shots fired near a diplomatic delegation touring Jenin, including whether Israel was notified and whether the Netherlands would sanction or summon the Israeli ambassador. The minister condemned the incident, said Israel was asked for clarification and promised written findings from its own inquiry, but did not summon the ambassador or announce sanctions and said the Netherlands is awaiting the investigation.
It is first and foremost up to Israel to investigate the incident and share the outcomes with the international community.
Het is allereerst aan Israël om onderzoek te doen naar het incident en de uitkomsten te delen van de internationale gemeenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Hoe christelijke donateurs in Nederland radicale Israëlische kolonisten steunen'

An MP asks the government about reports that Dutch Christian and Zionist foundations fund Israeli settlers building on the occupied West Bank, asking about legality, oversight, sanctions, tax status and prosecution. The government acknowledges the occupation is unlawful, says private relations are not prohibited but undesirable, states it does not monitor such financial flows, and declines to comment on individuals, prosecutions or tax status.

The cabinet does not conduct general supervision of financial flows abroad and therefore does not have information on where and for what purpose money from foundations such as Christenen voor Israël actually goes.

Het kabinet houdt geen algemeen toezicht op financieringsstromen richting het buitenland en beschikt daarom ook niet over informatie waar en met welke bedoeling geld van stichtingen zoals Christenen voor Israël exact naar toe gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen, Paternotte, Dobbe en Van Baarle over het bericht 'No humanitarian aid will enter Gaza, Israel defence Minister says'

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns Israel's blocking of humanitarian aid to Gaza, whether this constitutes collective punishment or a war crime, whether UN Resolution 2417 is being ignored, whether Israel violates the ICJ provisional measures, and whether she will push for EU sanctions. The minister condemns the blockade as contrary to international law, notes the legal framework and Dutch diplomatic steps, and says a review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement has been requested, while stating that sanctions require EU unanimity.
The cabinet condemns the blocking of humanitarian aid and basic services such as electricity.
Het kabinet veroordeelt het blokkeren van humanitaire hulp en basisvoorzieningen zoals elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dobbe, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over de catastrofale humanitaire situatie in Gaza

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, including whether Israel is starving the population, the risk of famine, the proposal for US-linked security firms to distribute aid, and what the government is doing. The minister answered that Israel's blockade violates international humanitarian law, that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Israel to lift it and has asked the EU to review Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, but that it cannot deliver aid by sea or air without Israeli consent.
Pending this, the Netherlands will not agree to extending the EU-Israel Action Plan.
In afwachting hiervan zal Nederland niet instemmen met verlenging van het EU-Israël Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het rapport ‘Gaza and West Bank Interim Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment’

An MP from DENK asked the government about the World Bank/EU/UN damage and needs assessment for Gaza and the West Bank, covering casualties, reconstruction funding, humanitarian access, and Dutch aid. The minister answered that the government deplores the suffering, has pledged EUR 82 million in extra humanitarian aid plus EUR 20 million for reconstruction, condemns blockades of aid, and is in diplomatic talks with Israel and partners.
The cabinet has no overview of financial support by other countries for the reconstruction of the Gaza Strip.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van financiële steun door andere landen voor de wederopbouw van de Gazastrook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Tseggai over ‘de conclusies van de lokale ombudsman dat de gemeente Almere nalatig was bij het beschermen van de grondrechten van moslimgemeenschap’

MPs Van Baarle and Tseggai asked about the local ombudsman's finding that Almere municipality seriously failed to protect Muslim community fundamental rights through security analyses (krachtenveldanalyses) funded by central government. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own compliance, that the Rijk lacks a complete overview of analyses, and that the government acknowledges the unrest but has not offered formal apologies.
Municipalities are the commissioners of the analyses and the research bureau is the author. It is up to these parties involved to grant access.
Gemeenten zijn de opdrachtgever van de analyses en het onderzoeksbureau is de opsteller. Het is aan deze betrokken partijen om inzage te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Uyghurs detained in Thailand face deportation, persecution in China.’

The MP asks the Foreign Minister about reports that Uyghurs detained in Thailand face deportation to China, including deaths in detention, and what pressure Netherlands can exert. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Thailand not to deport the group and to improve detention conditions, and is coordinating with like-minded countries and UNHCR, but gives no firm new commitments.
The Netherlands has urged the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the group, end the detention, and respect non-refoulement.
Nederland heeft op verschillende manieren, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk en zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband de dringende oproep aan de Thaise autoriteiten gedaan om de groep niet uit te leveren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlandse Syriëgezant spreekt met interim-bestuur in Damascus’

Van Baarle (DENK) asked the Foreign Minister about the Dutch Syria envoy's talks with the interim Damascus authorities and about safeguarding evidence of crimes under the Assad regime, including the fate of Sednaya prison records and the death of Mazen al-Humada. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports the UN evidence bank (IIIM) and the Commission of Inquiry, pursues the ICJ case against Syria, and has no investigative power in the al-Humada death, which lies with local authorities.
Foreign Affairs has no investigative powers and cannot play a direct role in finding the perpetrators; that authority lies with the local authorities.
Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen opsporingsbevoegdheid en kan geen directe rol spelen in het vinden van de daders, die bevoegdheid ligt bij de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Baarle over de juridische stappen van vicepremier Mona Keijzer inzake het besluit van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om haar niet te vervolgen voor groepsbelediging

An MP asked whether Deputy PM Keijzer's legal challenge to the Public Prosecution Service's decision not to prosecute her for group insult was coordinated in cabinet, whether it is appropriate for her to pursue it, and whether the government agrees with her statements about Islam and antisemitism. The minister answered that everyone may use legal rights, that the cabinet does not judge the OM's independent decision, and that it will not pre-empt pending court procedures or comment on her statements.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to anticipate the possible outcome of ongoing procedures, nor to comment on Ms Keijzer's statements.
Het past het kabinet niet om vooruit te lopen op de eventuele uitkomst van lopende procedures en ook niet om zich uit te spreken over de uitlatingen van mevrouw Keijzer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over bedrijven die verdienen aan illegale Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about companies profiting from illegal Israeli settlements, including financial links and pension fund investments, and whether the Dutch settlement discouragement policy and monitoring should be tightened. The minister answered that the government considers settlements unlawful, reaffirms the existing discouragement policy and corporate due diligence expectations for pension funds, and says the policy framework will be implemented in line with the ICJ advisory opinion without committing to new measures.

The cabinet will continue to vigorously implement the current national policy following the Court's advisory opinion and is also in contact with European partners on this matter, such as France and Germany.

Het kabinet zal het huidige nationale beleid nadrukkelijk blijven uitvoeren naar aanleiding van het advies van het Hof en houdt terzake ook met Europese partners contact, zoals met Frankrijk en Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.

Antwoord op het lid Van Baarle over het advies ‘Legal consequences arising from the policies and practices of Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem’ van het Internationaal Gerechtshof

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister, in 47 numbered questions, how the government will respond to the ICJ advisory opinion on Israel's policies and practices in the occupied Palestinian territory, including East Jerusalem, covering settlements, the embassy move, water, discrimination, apartheid and accountability. The Minister answered that the ICJ opinion is authoritative and Nederland respects its interpretation, that the government will analyse whether to adapt its policy framework and discouragement policy, and that prosecution of international crimes is a matter for the independent Openbaar Ministerie.
The Court's advisory opinion is an important guideline, and the Netherlands takes its international obligations seriously.
Het advies van het Hof is een belangrijke leidraad, en Nederland neemt zijn internationale verplichtingen serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Jetten, Dijk, Ouwehand, Bikker, Dassen en Van Baarle over de uitzetting van de elfjarige Mikael

MPs asked the government whether it could grant a residence permit to eleven-year-old Mikael and his mother despite a Council of State ruling, and why the child-amnesty rules required being 'in beeld' with the immigration chain. The minister answered that residence permits require a statutory basis, that the discretionary power was replaced in 2019 and is limited to harsh circumstances in the first application, and that the government will not take measures to prevent harsh outcomes in individual cases.
The cabinet does not intend to take these measures.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om deze maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Aardbevingsslachtoffers Marokko zijn wanhoop nabij: 'Ze zijn ons vergeten'

An MP from DENK asked the minister about reports that earthquake victims in Morocco feel forgotten, including whether many remain in temporary housing and whether reconstruction is lagging. The minister acknowledged uneven reconstruction, described Dutch emergency funding of 5 million euro via the Red Cross and a 50 million euro Invest International contribution, and said the issue is raised internationally.
The importance of reconstruction and relief is raised in international contacts.
Het belang van wederopbouw en hulpverlening wordt in internationale contacten onder de aandacht gebracht.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Vrouw op poster krijgt doodverwensingen en racistische reacties: ‘Dit mag je niet negeren’'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about hateful and racist online reactions to a woman shown on a poster, including whether the perpetrators will be prosecuted quickly and whether the government will act against extreme-right accounts. The minister answered that discrimination is condemned, that prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service, that a national plan against online discrimination is coming after the summer, and that a national study on Muslim discrimination is underway.
It is not for the cabinet to make statements about individual cases, or to give instructions to the police and the Public Prosecution Service in specific cases.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uitspraken te doen over individuele zaken, of in concrete zaken instructies te geven aan de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Abed zit al maanden vast in Gaza, wat wordt er in Nederland gedaan om hem terug te krijgen? 'Niemand heeft me gebeld''

MP Van Baarle asks the Foreign Minister what is being done to bring back Abed Al Attar, a Dutch-linked resident stuck in Gaza, and whether Israeli authorities can be compelled to list him. The minister replies that the ministry is working through diplomatic channels, that border lists are set by Israeli and Egyptian authorities, that Dutch law gives no legal leverage in the area, and cites privacy rules limiting detail on individual cases.
In accordance with the GDPR, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is reticent in providing more details about individual cases.
Conform de AVG is het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken terughoudend in het geven van meer details over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Spying, hacking and intimidation: Israel’s nine-year ‘war’ on the ICC exposed’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that Israel spied on, hacked and intimidated the ICC, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The ministers answered that the Netherlands opposes all interference with the ICC, is in contact with the Court on security, will not comment on individual cases for security reasons, and has discussed the matter with the US and the Israeli ambassador.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about individual cases.
Om veiligheidsoverwegingen kunnen er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Zuid-Afrika gaat burgers straffen als ze vechten voor Israël'

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that South Africa would prosecute citizens who served in the Israeli army, and about Dutch nationals serving in Israeli forces and possible war crimes. The government answered that South Africa's constitution bars such participation, that the Netherlands does not track Dutch nationals in the Israeli army, that serving there is not a crime under Dutch law, and that the Public Prosecution Service can investigate indications of international crimes.
The Netherlands does not keep track of this because the Netherlands is not in armed conflict with Israel.
Nederland houdt dit niet bij omdat Nederland niet in gewapend conflict is met Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri en Van Baarle over het artikel 'Kabinet zoekt na verbod naar andere wegen voor leveren F-35-onderdelen aan Israël'

MPs Dassen, Piri and Van Baarle asked whether the ministry sought indirect routes to supply F-35 parts to Israel after a court ruling, whether parts were delivered to other countries or indirectly reached Israel, and whether indirect supply breaches international law. The minister denied seeking alternative routes, said no internal correspondence exists on this, acknowledged exports of F-35 parts to other F-35 countries since the ruling, and could not exclude indirect end-use in Israel, referring to a letter of 24 April 2024.
There has been no request to look for alternative routes to still supply F-35 parts to Israel.
Er is niet gevraagd naar alternatieve routes te zoeken om alsnog F-35-onderdelen te kunnen leveren aan Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het bericht ‘Nederlanders betalen reisbureau hoge bedragen voor evacuatie familie Gaza’

MP Van Baarle asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Dutch citizens paid travel agencies very high sums to evacuate relatives from Gaza, and about delays in getting Dutch nationals out. The minister said the ministry is pursuing diplomatic efforts with Israel and Egypt, cannot verify the reported sums, and that consular assistance follows official channels without paying for services.
In accordance with the GDPR, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is restrained in providing further details on individual cases.
Conform de AVG is het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken terughoudend in het geven van meer details over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Van genocidale opruiing betichte Israëlische president komt naar Nederland voor opening Holocaustmuseum’

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the Foreign Minister why Israeli President Herzog, whose remarks were cited by the ICJ in its genocide-related order, was welcomed to the Holocaust museum opening, and whether he could be arrested or declared persona non grata given alleged incitement to genocide. The minister answered that the visit was a bilateral courtesy tied to Dutch-Israeli relations, that Dutch prosecutors decide on investigations of international crimes, that head-of-state immunity under customary law bars prosecution while in office, and that the government will not declare him persona non grata.
The starting point of Dutch policy is that the Netherlands may not be a safe haven for perpetrators of international crimes.
Uitgangspunt van het Nederlands beleid is dat Nederland geen vluchthaven mag zijn voor plegers van internationale misdrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over de situatie van Al-Aqsa tijdens de Ramadan

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about reported Israeli plans to restrict Muslim access to Al-Aqsa mosque during Ramadan, and about Dutch positions on the status quo and Israeli compliance. The minister answered that the Netherlands upholds the status quo, has conveyed its message to Israel, that Netanyahu said no additional restrictions would apply, and that no summons of the Israeli ambassador is planned.
The cabinet considers upholding and respecting the status quo of the Haram al-Sharif/Temple Mount essential and calls on all parties to take their responsibility in this regard.
Het kabinet acht handhaving van en respect voor de status quo van de Haram al-Sharif/Tempelberg essentieel en roept alle partijen op om daartoe hun verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het artikel 'Signalen van institutioneel racisme tegen ambtenaren in zes gemeenten'

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Interior about press reports of signals of institutional racism and nepotism in municipal hiring and promotion of civil servants with migrant backgrounds, asking whether procedures should be standardised and sanctions imposed. The minister said municipalities are responsible for their own employment policy, rejected the nepotism conclusion, pointed to existing anti-discrimination law, an anti-discrimination complaints point for municipal staff in Amsterdam as an example, and planned reviews of the anti-discrimination voluntary-organisation system.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for their employment policy and therefore also for combating discrimination and institutional racism in it.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun werkgeversbeleid en daarmee ook voor het tegengaan van discriminatie en institutioneel racisme hierbij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de situatie van Abed Al Attar in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why Dutch national Abed Al Attar remains stuck in Gaza despite his Dutch passport and why he was not on the Rafah crossing list, and what the ministry is doing. The minister said the ministry is in regular contact, is pressing Israeli and other authorities to add him to the list, and cannot give details on the individual case because of privacy rules.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is bound, among other things, by the GDPR regarding individual consular cases and must therefore be reticent in giving details about individual cases.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is gebonden aan onder andere de AVG rondom individuele consulaire zaken en moet daarom terughoudend zijn in het geven van details over individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Hoop, Hagen, Peters, Richardson, Drost, Beertema, Pouw-Verweij, Bisschop, Van Baarle, Sylvana Simons, Omtzigt en Wassenberg over de examenuitslag voor vso-scholieren

MPs asked the minister whether vso (special secondary education) pupils could receive their exam results on the same day as mainstream pupils, and whether an earlier-announcement arrangement from 2024 was progressing. The minister agreed this would be desirable, explained that a structural fix requires rescheduling the state exams and will not be ready until late 2024, and said an interim measure is unlikely to be feasible in 2025.

I will inform your House about these possibilities and the extent to which the group of candidates for whom it becomes possible increases compared with a possible interim solution in 2024, so that your House can weigh the desirability of the interim solution in 2025.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over deze mogelijkheden en in welke mate het de groep kandidaten voor wie het mogelijk wordt gemaakt ten opzichte van een eventuele tussenoplossing in 2024 wordt vergroot zodat uw Kamer de wenselijkheid van de tussenoplossing in 2025 kan wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘De schrik zit erin bij moslims in Culemborg: ‘We willen extra beveiliging’

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that Muslims in Culemborg feel unsafe after a mosque's windows were smashed and whether mosque security should be funded and tightened. The minister condemned the attack, but said mosque security is a local responsibility, no extra national funding is planned, and the earlier motion on mosque security practices has been considered fulfilled.
At this moment there is no reason to finance additional general security measures.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om extra algemene beveiligingsmaatregelen te financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het nieuwsbericht ‘Lien mag niet meer werken als treinassistente omdat ze een abaya draagt: ‘Voelde me vernederd’’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs and the Staatssecretaris of Infrastructure about reports that a train attendant was barred from working for NS while wearing an abaya, and about whether NS dress rules and handling of the case were lawful. The government answered that it lacks full details, that personnel policy is NS's responsibility, that employers may impose dress rules within limits, that questions of discrimination are for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and the courts, and that it cannot share any internal investigation for privacy reasons.
It is for the judiciary to assess in a specific case whether dress rules comply with laws and regulations.
Het is aan de rechterlijke macht om in een specifiek geval te beoordelen of kledingvoorschriften in overeenstemming zijn met wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de oproep van de Israëlische regering om 300.000 militaire reservisten deelte laten nemen aan de lopende vijandelijkheden, met name in deGazastrook

An MP asked the government whether Israel's call-up of 300,000 reservists for fighting in Gaza also reaches Dutch citizens, whether this constitutes prohibited recruitment, and about Dutch citizens in Israel and settlements. The government answered that it has no data on Dutch citizens serving in the IDF, that calling up reservists is not recruitment under Article 205 of the Criminal Code, and condemned settler violence while calling on Israel to prevent it.
The cabinet does not know how many Dutch nationals are currently active in the Israeli army, nor how many have recently been called up or travelled there.
Het is het kabinet niet bekend hoeveel Nederlanders momenteel actief zijn in het Israëlische leger noch hoeveel recentelijk zijn opgeroepen of afgereisd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Overheid haalt eigen diversiteitsdoelen niet of nauwelijks’

An MP from DENK asked the Interior Minister whether central government meets its own diversity targets for its workforce, including ethnic and gender representation in senior roles, and what it will do about it. The State Secretary answered that some quantitative diversity goals are met and others are not, that targets for cultural diversity are an effort obligation rather than a binding result, that the internal monitoring reports will stay internal, and listed ongoing measures such as inclusive recruitment and monitoring.
With a view to sharp and constructive coordination, it is preferable to keep using the monitoring reports as an internal sounding board.
Met oog op een scherpe en constructieve afstemming heeft het de voorkeur om de monitorrapportages als intern klankbord te blijven inzetten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Temmink, Van Raan en Van Baarle over het bericht 'Tien camera’s per vierkante kilometer in database politie: ‘Onbespied over straat kan bijna niet meer’' en de uitzending

MPs from D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that private cameras registered with the police (Camera in Beeld) are growing, whether footage from unregistered private cameras, doorbell cameras and cameras pointed at public roads is lawful and usable, and whether this amounts to a nationwide surveillance network. The Minister answered that police may demand footage under article 126nda Sv for offences carrying four years or more, that misaligned cameras are a concern, that a nationwide network is undesirable, and that courts decide whether unlawfully obtained footage is admissible.
I therefore consider it important that camera owners continue to be reminded that they must adjust their cameras in line with the rules of the General Data Protection Regulation.
Ik acht het derhalve van belang dat camera-eigenaren er blijvend op worden gewezen dat zij hun camera moeten afstellen volgens de regels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het onderzoek naar het (risico)profiel UT001

An MP asks why the Tax Authority withheld documents on the UT001 risk profile during the investigation, whether all related files can be produced, how records were stored and deleted, and whether nationality or birthplace indicators were used. The State Secretary answers that six informal drafts were supplied late, a targeted search found further documents which are being provided, retention rules and information management gaps are acknowledged, and the 2022 decision to reject the profile is referenced.
The exception is six documents without formal status that were only provided during the adversarial hearing procedure.
Uitzondering hierop zijn een zestal documenten zonder formele status die pas tijdens de procedure van wederhoor zijn verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over een Nederlander die vast zit in Spanje vanwege een ongegronde plaatsing op een lijst

An MP from DENK asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about a Dutch citizen detained in Spain on a terrorism-related listing that Dutch authorities said did not stem from any Dutch suspicion, asking why Spain held this information, how data sharing and signalling work, and what consular help was given. The ministers declined to discuss the individual case in detail, citing ongoing proceedings, privacy rules and Spain's sovereignty, stated that the man was not suspected or signalled in the Netherlands, described consular support and contacts with Spanish authorities, and noted he has since been expelled and returned to the Netherlands.
The case of the person concerned is currently before the court.
De zaak van betrokkene is op dit moment onder de rechter.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam en Van Baarle over het illegaal verzamelen van gegevens van uitkeringsgerechtigden door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Dekker-Abdulaziz, Warmerdam and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's unlawful collection of benefit recipients' data via cookies and IP addresses for a fraud risk scan, its ethics and human-rights checks, the discrimination risk, data deletion, costs and proportionality. The minister acknowledged the cookie-based IP data was collected unlawfully and proportionality was lacking, stopped the scan, reopened 460 cases, and promised a technical briefing and further information, while withholding operational details for inspection reasons.
In the interest of inspection, control and supervision I cannot make this public.
In het belang van inspectie, controle en toezicht kan ik dit niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over mogelijke discriminatie van de As-Soennah-moskee

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Authority discriminated against the As-Soennah mosque, why mosques were treated as a fraud risk, and why selection criteria were withheld in court. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual taxpayer citing tax confidentiality, said a pro forma appeal and a KPMG review of the CAF unit are pending, and explained that giftenaftrek fraud had been concentrated partly within the Islamic community.
Because of the tax confidentiality obligation (art. 67 AWR), I cannot address an individual taxpayer or the questions asked about them.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht (art. 67 AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op een individuele belastingplichtige en de gestelde vragen daarover.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het stelselmatig achterhouden van stukken door de Belastingdienst en discriminatie van de islamitische instellingen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority allegedly withholding case documents from a court, targeting Islamic institutions through risk selection based on nationality, and revoking a mosque's ANBI status retroactively. The State Secretary answers that much cannot be disclosed due to tax confidentiality and pending appeal, denies a structural problem, and promises a KPMG report and an IBTD inspection.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Van Baarle, Koekkoek, Den Haan en Mutluer over de illegale undercover onderzoeken bij moskeeën

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about covert undercover investigations of mosques by her ministry, including whether affected citizens should be personally informed as the Landsadvocaat and Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens urged. The minister admitted the processing of personal data lacked a legal basis and said the ministry will now actively inform those whose reliable contact details it can obtain, while others may ask the ministry whether they are in its records.
My ministry will therefore actively inform those people for whom reliable contact details are available.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom die mensen actief informeren, van wie betrouwbare contactgegevens voor handen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over "Het bericht Deense regering wil koranverbrandingen voorkomen met wet"

An MP from DENK asked the government about Denmark and Sweden considering laws to ban Quran burning, and whether the Netherlands would do the same. The Minister said the government monitors those developments, sees no need for its own study, and stresses that free expression and peaceful demonstration are constitutionally protected, with only specific discriminatory speech punishable.
At present the cabinet sees no reason for its own study into additional legal options to prohibit desecration of religious books at demonstrations or in certain places.

Op dit moment ziet het kabinet geen aanleiding voor een eigen onderzoek naar aanvullende juridische mogelijkheden om het schenden van religieuze boeken bij demonstraties of op bepaalde plekken te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de haatactie van Pegida in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers whether they condemn Pegida's planned Koran-burning action in The Hague, whether they would press the mayor to ban it, and how it affects relations with Turkey. The government called the act provocative but said freedom of expression is a fundamental right, that the mayor is responsible for demonstrations under the Wom, and that Turkey was raised in bilateral talks.
The Public Demonstrations Act (Wom) places responsibility for facilitating demonstrations with local authorities.
De Wet openbare manifestaties (Wom) legt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren van demonstraties bij het lokale gezag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk (CDA) en Van Baarle (DENK) over het bericht dat commissarissen en bestuurders bij zo'n twintig woningcorporaties privéhuizen blijken te verhuren voor persoonlijk rendement

Two MPs asked the minister about a report that board members and supervisory directors of about twenty housing corporations rent out private homes for personal profit, and whether this is incompatible with their roles. The minister says conflicts of interest must be prevented, endorses a stricter 'no, unless' governance code rule drafted by Aedes and VTW, and says the Autoriteit woningcorporaties sees no reason yet for its own additional measures.
Conflicts of interest (or the appearance of them) must be prevented at all times.
Belangenverstrengeling (of de schijn daarvan) moet te allen tijde worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het toezicht op informeel onderwijs

MP Van Baarle asked the minister for Primary and Secondary Education, in 85 numbered questions, to justify the planned supervision of informal education, challenging the evidence base, the consistency with the government's earlier position, and the proportionality and privacy implications. The minister answered that the government considers the signals sufficient, that the inspectorate will carry out signal-driven supervision, and that concrete examples are largely available only in publicly known reports and the AIVD annual report, with some examples withheld for security and privacy reasons.
Because of the AIVD's remit and privacy considerations, I cannot share all examples with you.
Vanwege de taakstelling van de AIVD en om privacyoverwegingen kan ik niet alle voorbeelden met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Van Baarle, Eerdmans en Omtzigt over de voordracht van Wopke Hoekstra als Eurocommissaris

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister how Wopke Hoekstra was nominated as Dutch European Commissioner, including the procedure, any candidate profile, whether parliament was informed, and whether his departure leaves the Foreign Ministry without political direction. The government replied that the nomination followed the standard Article 246 TFEU procedure after consultation within cabinet and with the Commission President, that no candidate profile was drawn up, that parliament was not informed beyond the standard procedure, and that ministerial responsibility for the Foreign Ministry is secured.
No. The procedure was followed in line with standing policy on earlier appointments, see the answers to questions 1 and 2.
Nee. De procedure is conform staand beleid van eerdere benoemingen gevolgd, zie de antwoorden op vraag 1 en 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het manifest van studenten- en belangorganisaties over inclusieve stilteruimtes op onderwijsinstellingen

An MP asked the education ministers about a manifesto calling for inclusive quiet rooms at schools and universities, and whether the government would require or guide such rooms. The ministers answered that institutions decide themselves, that the government will not mandate or issue guidance, and pointed to existing student-wellbeing agreements.
It is not for the government to take a prominent position in the discussion on setting up, or obliging, quiet rooms.
Het is niet aan de overheid om een prominente positie te kiezen in de discussie over het inrichten, dan wel verplichten, van stilteruimtes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de veroordeling tot 3 jaar cel van oud-premier Imran Khan van Pakistan

An MP from DENK asked the Foreign Minister about the three-year prison sentence of former Pakistani PM Imran Khan, whether the trials were politically motivated, the crackdown on protesters and party members, and whether the Netherlands would speak out internationally. The minister said the government has no view on Khan's claims, raised concerns about arrests and rule of law in EU and bilateral talks, but stated it does not intervene in other countries' court proceedings.
However, the Netherlands does not intervene in the course of justice in other countries.
Nederland intervenieert echter niet in de rechtsgang in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over gevallen waarin Nederlandse moslims gecremeerd worden

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Interior about cases where Dutch Muslims were cremated despite requests for Islamic burial, including whether care homes were negligent and what rules exist for unclaimed bodies. The Minister answered that care homes are not responsible for funerals, that the Burial Act requires respecting the deceased's wishes where reasonably possible, and that the municipal mayor is the fallback, while leaving documenting wishes to the individuals themselves.
Arranging the funeral is not the responsibility of care homes.
Zorgdragen voor de lijkbezorging is geen verantwoordelijkheid van verzorgingstehuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het door schoolbesturen weigeren van gebedsruimten en gebedsmogelijkheden

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether schools refusing prayer rooms or prayer opportunities breach religious freedom and the 2000 equal-treatment ruling, and whether the Inspectorate will check. The minister said a public school is not obliged to provide prayer rooms, that praying is not banned, that the current rules are clear enough, and declined new guidelines or inspection instructions.
I am continuously in discussion with umbrella organisations and schools on numerous topics.
Ik ben voortdurend met koepels en scholen in gesprek over tal van onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat een jongen al een jaar thuis zit na een onterechte schorsing

MP Van Baarle asked the minister why a 9-year-old boy has been out of school for over a year after an unlawful suspension, and what the school and responsible bodies will do. The minister says the inspectorate will investigate the school's compliance with law and duty of care, that a new school place is being sought, and that Stichting Gedragswerk has been contacted to help.
The Inspectorate of Education will, following the above, conduct further investigation into the school's compliance with laws and regulations, including the procedures for suspension and expulsion.

De Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) zal naar aanleiding van bovenstaande nader onderzoek doen naar de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving door de school, onder andere rondom de procedures voor schorsing en verwijdering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Busje komt weer niet: schrijnende crisis in leerlingenvervoer’

An MP asked the minister whether children missing school due to the pupil transport crisis face home visits and threats of proceedings at Bureau HALT, and what protections exist. The minister said such signals are unknown, that such measures are unacceptable and not at issue, and that absences caused by transport problems are excused.

I find it unacceptable if truancy officers visit and threaten to draw up a official report for Bureau HALT for children who do not go to school when the cause lies solely in the pupil transport crisis.

Ik vind het onacceptabel als er leerplichtambtenaren op bezoek komen en dreigen met het maken van een proces-verbaal bij Bureau HALT bij kinderen die niet naar school komen als de oorzaak alleen bij de crisis in het leerlingenvervoer ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de uitspraak van de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State over het Cornelius Haga Lyceum

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education how the government could have labelled the Cornelius Haga Lyceum guilty of mismanagement, given the Council of State ruling that there was no wanbeheer or unjust enrichment, and asked for apologies, lessons and an external review. Minister Wiersma largely rejected the accusations of error and stigmatisation, defended the inspectorate-based intervention, acknowledged the court's finding that the instruction was disproportionate, and refused an apology and external investigation.

With the bill expanding the administrative instruments, which I informed your House about in letters of 30 May 2022 and 28 June 2022, I expect to be able to intervene more quickly in a comparable situation in the interest of pupils.

Met het wetsvoorstel Uitbreiding bestuurlijk instrumentarium waarover ik uw Kamer in de brieven van 30 mei 2022 en 28 juni 2022 heb geïnformeerd ga ik ervan uit dat ik in een vergelijkbare situatie in het belang van de leerlingen sneller kan ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Van Baarle over moslimdiscriminatie

MPs Belhaj and Van Baarle asked about a study finding Muslim women wearing headscarves are rejected far more often in job applications in the Netherlands, and about measures against labour market discrimination, including meldplicht and sanctions. The minister acknowledges the findings, outlines ongoing research, the Wetsvoorstel toezicht gelijke kansen, an action plan, and says the meldplicht advice will be sent to parliament by year end.
I aim to share this amendment note with your House shortly (before the end of the year), so that the treatment of this bill can be continued.
Ik streef ernaar deze nota van wijziging op korte termijn (voor het einde van het jaar) met uw Kamer te delen, zodat de behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel vervolgd kan worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Baarle over het artikel 'Rekenkamer waarschuwt voor mogelijke 'vooringenomenheid bij politie-algoritmes' en het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer hierover

MPs Mutluer and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the Court of Audit's finding on possible bias in police algorithms, including whether the audit applied the right legal framework (AVG instead of Wpg), privacy risks of the CAS system, reliance on citizen reports, and risks of indirect discrimination. The Minister answered that the Wpg and AVG are not interchangeable, that the police judged a data protection impact assessment not mandatory but is pursuing an AI impact assessment, that CAS output is area-based and excludes ethnicity variables while residual bias risks are being studied, and that the police will share a table of deployment counts per speerpunt.

Nevertheless, the House of Representatives (for example via the Standing Committee on Digital Affairs) has the option of asking the Court of Audit to further reflect on the findings concerning the CAS algorithm.

Desalniettemin bestaat voor de Tweede Kamer (bijvoorbeeld via de Vaste commissie Digitale Zaken) de mogelijkheid de Algemene Rekenkamer te vragen nader te reflecteren op de bevindingen rondom het algoritme van het CAS
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het korten van de uitkering van mensen in het buitenland

MP Van Baarle asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefit reductions for recipients abroad caused by Turkish banks charging transaction fees after the Target-2 transition, and whether UWV had investigated, informed people, or engaged banks. The minister answered that UWV updated its communication with a general warning that banks may charge fees, that bank conditions are the banks' responsibility, that UWV does not negotiate with specific banks, and that UWV does not investigate fees but informs beneficiaries.
It is up to the banks themselves to determine which fees they charge for a foreign transfer.
Het is aan banken zelf om te bepalen welke kosten zij rekenen voor een buitenlandse overboeking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Duizenden leerlingen speciaal onderwijs te laat op school door personeelstekort'

Van Baarle (DENK) asked the minister about reports that thousands of special-education pupils arrive late at school because of staff shortages in pupil transport, and about the lack of contact with transport firms. Minister Wiersma answered that gemeenten are responsible, that emergency solutions and structural measures are being pursued, and that she will engage the VNG and KNV, though no new funding is committed.
Although the legal responsibility for implementing pupil transport lies with the municipalities, I will not refrain from extra or targeted action.
Hoewel de wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid van de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer bij gemeenten ligt, zal ik extra dan wel gerichte actie niet nalaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over dat er wederom racistisch nepnieuws is verspreid door Ongehoord Nederland

An MP from DENK asked whether the government condemns a Ongehoord Nederland broadcast claiming 'white' people are beaten by people of colour, which used the n-word, and whether the public broadcaster should act against the broadcaster or whether it should be removed from the system. The State Secretary declined to judge programme content citing media independence, pointed to the NPO Ombudsman and the Commissariaat voor de Media investigations, and said sanctions or erkenning withdrawal would be considered only within the statutory process.
It is not for me as a minister to assess this.
Het is niet aan mij als bewindspersoon om dit te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de belasting op leidingwater

An MP from DENK asked ministers whether the leidingwaterbelasting (tap water levy) is too favourable to large water users, since a capped levy gives them little incentive to save water, and whether raising it for large firms would help. The minister confirmed the levy's capped structure, acknowledged reduced incentives for large users, said a raise combined with a higher cap could promote saving, and promised to inform parliament in the autumn after an ongoing study.
A study is underway into measures and instruments to promote water saving by households and businesses.
Er loopt een onderzoek naar de maatregelen en instrumenten om waterbesparing door huishoudens en bedrijven te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over woonwagenbewoners die op zwarte lijsten staan bij gemeenten

MP Van Baarle asked whether Dutch municipalities place caravan dwellers (woonwagenbewoners) on 'black lists' under an anti-undermining (ondermijning) checklist, and whether this constitutes ethnic profiling and stigmatisation. The Minister acknowledges the checklist wrongly names caravan dwellers as a group, commits to asking the Justice Ministry to amend it against the Human Rights College framework, and says the government is coordinating an investigation into discriminatory risk models.
That caravan dwellers are named as a specific group on the checklist is incorrect. The Minister of Justice and Security will request that the checklist be adjusted on this point.
Dat woonwagenbewoners als specifieke groep worden genoemd op de checklist is onjuist. De Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zal verzoeken de checklist op dit punt aan te laten passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de beantwoording van de vragen over discriminatie bij de controle op de Basisregistratie Personen

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Interior Affairs about a discriminatory risk profile used in checks on the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including the 22 affected persons, possible compensation, how the profile arose, and accountability for officials. The State Secretary said an independent investigation (Integis BV) will report around end September, condemned the profile, and gave partial answers, declining to address individual officials' accountability or compensation until the facts are known.
I have instructed the investigators to examine how the profile came about, which parties were involved, and what considerations led to drawing up this profile.
Ik heb de onderzoekers opdracht gegeven om na te gaan hoe het profiel is ontstaan, welke partijen betrokken waren en welke afwegingen ertoe hebben geleid dit profiel op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Kwart van de studenten met stage ingezet als goedkope arbeidskracht’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Education about a report that a quarter of students on internships felt used as cheap labour and nearly half receive no internship pay, and about proposals from the ISO student union on stage abuse, mandatory pay and internship agreements. The Minister answered that interns are entitled to minimum wage when doing regular work, that the Labour Inspectorate can fine employers, and that talks with education and employers will explore better oversight, pay and standard agreements, while delaying a monitor of internship supply and quality until end of 2022.
I will therefore explore, in consultation with students, educational institutions and employers, how we can get better insight into the improper use of interns.
Ik zal daarom in overleg met de studenten, onderwijsinstellingen en werkgevers verkennen hoe we beter zicht krijgen op oneigenlijk inzet van stagiairs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Baarle over de mogelijke vooringenomenheid bij algoritmes gebruikt door de Politie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about possible bias in the police predictive algorithm CAS, following an Audit Office report, and whether the system should be suspended. The minister answered that the police have been asked to tighten control procedures, that the system's variables do not include nationality, and that suspension is not necessary now, citing mitigating measures on governance and accountability.
I have therefore asked the police to tighten the procedures for recording these checks in the regular process.
Ik heb de politie daarom gevraagd om in het reguliere proces de procedures voor het vastleggen van deze controles aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de rente op studieleningen en de verhoging van het collegegeld

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Education about the possible end of the 0% interest on student loans and the expected rise in tuition fees, including whether this burdens students unfairly and whether it deters students with religious objections to interest. The Minister confirmed that interest will likely rise above 0% (set at year end), committed to reintroducing the basic grant and examining options to prevent the tuition increase, and promised answers before the committee debate.
I am currently examining those options.
Ik ben die mogelijkheden op dit moment aan het onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van der Werf, Van Strien, De Hoop, Westerveld, Teunissen, Van der Graaf, Van Baarle, Koekkoek en Gündoğan over het verspreiden van een extreemrechtse omvolkingstheorie bij de om

MPs asked the government how the public broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland could broadcast the 'great replacement' conspiracy theory unchallenged, and what risks and sanctions follow. The Secretary of State answered that the NPO Ombudsman found Ongehoord Nederland breached the journalistic code, that the NPO intends to impose a sanction, and that the Commissariaat voor de Media and NPO, not the minister, are responsible for judging compliance with the Mediawet.
It is for the Commissariaat to assess the broadcast of Ongehoord Nieuws in light of the requirements the Mediawet places on broadcasters.
Het is aan het Commissariaat om de uitzending van Ongehoord Nieuws te beoordelen in het licht van de eisen die de Mediawet aan omroepen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de uitgaven ten aanzien van discriminatiebestrijding

The MP asks the Minister of Interior how the structural 12 million euros for anti-discrimination efforts is spent, whether there are funds for new policy, and how the national programme is financed. The Minister provides a breakdown table, says the national programme will come with a letter with financial accountability, and states that new plans must be financed or they remain plans.
In the accompanying letter I will address the request made in the motion Van Baarle/Simons
In de begeleidende brief zal ik in gaan op het verzoek dat gedaan is in de motie-van Baarle/Simons
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Extra maatregelen CBR om wachttijden terug te dringen’

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about new CBR measures to reduce driving-test waiting times, including longer waits before retakes and expiry of booking authorisations after 12 months or two cancellations. The minister confirmed the measures were agreed with driving school associations, justified them as discouraging low pass rates and misuse of the booking system, and stated an intended start date of 1 September 2022.
The intended introduction date is 1 September 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over bericht ‘CBS past indeling rond migratie’

An MP asked the government about the CBS's revised classification of migration categories, including its consultation process, participants and whether 'Dutch' should be used. The minister explained the WRR-based rationale, said the ministry is still exploring terminology and declined to disclose CBS's internal deliberations.
I have no insight into CBS's considerations, nor into the precise input of participants.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de afwegingen van het CBS, noch in de precieze input van deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over discriminatie bij de controle op de Basisregistratie Personen

MP Van Baarle asks the State Secretary about discrimination in the BRP address-check project, including a profile targeting older foreign-born single benefit recipients, whether it was used, what was done, who knew and whether there are other discriminatory profiles. The State Secretary answers that 22 signals were found, that an independent forensic investigation has been commissioned, that she rejects the profile, and that no other profiles with nationality criteria were used.
I am having independent research carried out by an external forensic investigator into the application of this profile, including at the three municipalities.
Ik laat onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren door een externe forensisch onderzoeker naar de toepassing van dit profiel, onder andere bij de drie gemeenten.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Baarle over de privacyrisico’s van de Intelligente Snelheidsassistent

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about privacy risks of the Intelligent Speed Assistant and the mandatory Event Data Recorder, including who can access the data and whether the Data Protection Authority reviewed it. The minister answered that the ISA only warns drivers, the EDR contains no identifying data and is for accident analysis and statistics, and that no further privacy assessment is needed.
EDR data contain no location data and therefore cannot be used to detect speeding offences.
EDR-gegevens bevatten geen locatiegegevens en zijn daarmee niet te gebruiken voor het constateren van snelheidsovertredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over een verlaging van de benzineprijs, zoals in België

MP Van Baarle asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch petrol prices could be cut as in Belgium, through lower excise duty and VAT, and why the Netherlands must wait for the Spring Memorandum. The state secretary answered that the cabinet announced a temporary 21% cut in fuel excise from 1 April and a VAT cut on energy from 1 July, and estimated the revenue cost of an excise cut to reach the EU average at 315 to 505 million euros.
Last Friday, 11 March, the cabinet therefore announced its intention to temporarily reduce the excise duty on petrol and diesel by 21% from 1 April.
Afgelopen vrijdag 11 maart jl. heeft het kabinet daarom aangekondigd voornemens te zijn om per 1 april de accijns voor benzine en diesel tijdelijk te verlagen met 21%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over transactiekosten die ten koste gaan van de uitkering van uitkeringsontvangers in het buitenland

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about bank transaction fees charged to UWV benefit recipients abroad, notably in Turkey, after UWV moved payments to the Target-2 system in November 2021, and whether the government would act. The minister acknowledged the signals, said the fees are set by banks and UWV has no influence over them, and pointed to G20 work on cross-border payments as the remedy.
It is up to the banks themselves to determine which fees they charge for a foreign transfer.
Het is aan banken zelf om te bepalen welke kosten zij rekenen voor een buitenlandse overboeking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht Nederlanders met niet-Westerse migratieachtergrond financieel kwetsbaarder

An MP from DENK asked the government about an AFM report and news that Dutch residents with a non-Western migration background are more financially vulnerable, including that 40% of pensioners in this group live below the poverty line, and about low uptake of the AIO supplementary pension benefit, barriers to financial services, Wwft effects and Islamic finance products. The State Secretary acknowledged the vulnerability, cited CBS data showing 25.5% of potentially eligible non-Western pensioners did not claim AIO, and listed measures such as a data-sharing pilot between SVB and UWV, financial literacy programmes and a consumer choice action plan, while stating that the Wwft requires individual risk assessment.

I share the message behind it. A considerable share of pensioners with a non-Western migration background is financially vulnerable and relies on assistance in the form of the supplementary income provision for elderly people (AIO).

Ik deel de boodschap die erachter zit. Een aanzienlijk deel van de pensioengerechtigden met een niet-Westerse migratie-achtergrond is financieel kwetsbaar en is aangewezen op bijstand in de vorm van een aanvullende inkomensvoorziening voor ouderen (AIO).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Westlandse politiek houdt komst islamitische school opnieuw tegen'

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Education why a Westland municipal council keeps blocking the establishment of an Islamic primary school despite court rulings, and whether the minister will intervene again. The minister says the school legally must be founded, that the council is ignoring the law, and that the school must be able to start on 1 August 2022, but declines to commit to a third replacement decision or to sanctions for now.
The municipality is legally obliged to cooperate and arrange housing.
De gemeente is wettelijk verplicht mee te werken en huisvesting te regelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het wetsvoorstel Het niet-indexeren van het basiskinderbijslagbedrag en het extra bedrag van de kinderbijslag in de Algemene Kinderbijslagwet over de jaren 2022, 2023 en dee

The MP asks why the government said the non-indexation of child benefit formed a balanced 'dekkingspakket' with cuts to the IACK, and how that package was agreed and communicated to parliament. The State Secretary answers that the package was disclosed in the 2021 legislative debate and bill explanation, was agreed within the former coalition, and that the cuts were split evenly (27% child benefit, 27% IACK, 45% Aof premium) to finance parental leave and implementation agencies.
As I indicated in the plenary debate of 13 October, it would have been better had the measures of the overall package been submitted and considered as a whole.
Zoals ik in het plenair debat van 13 oktober jl. heb aangegeven, was het beter geweest als de maatregelen uit het totaalpakket als geheel zouden zijn ingediend en behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het bericht dat volgens de rechter Uber chauffeurs in dienst moet nemen

An MP asked the government how it views the court ruling that Uber must employ its drivers, including whether it constitutes modern employer authority, whether specific regulation against false self-employment on platforms is needed, whether the ruling is immediately enforceable, and the status of the taxi sector review and COVID support. The government answered that it cannot judge court rulings, that clarification of employment relationships is needed and is a task for a new cabinet, that it is studying a legal presumption of employer status for platform work, that the ruling is enforceable pending appeal, and that the taxi sector evaluation and a study on drivers' finances will report in 2022.
The cabinet is therefore examining, for a future cabinet, whether and how a legal presumption for platform work could strengthen the position of platform workers in practice.
Het kabinet onderzoekt daarom, ten behoeve van een toekomstig kabinet, of en hoe een rechtsvermoeden bij platformwerk, de positie van platformwerkers in de praktijk kan versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat de bank voortaan je studieschuld kan opzoeken

An MP asked the education minister about banks being able to retrieve students' study debt from DUO via apps during mortgage applications, including concerns about coercion and comparisons with BKR registration. The minister answered that this only changes how consumers supply data they already must disclose, that no BKR registration is planned, and that study debt keeps its low weighting factor.
This initiative changes nothing in the rights and obligations of (former) students and lenders, but only affects the way in which that obligation can be fulfilled.
Dit initiatief verandert niets aan de rechten en plichten van (oud-) studenten en kredietverstrekkers, maar heeft alleen invloed in de wijze waarop aan die verplichting kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de gedupeerden door de sluiting van een lerarenopleiding aan de Hogeschool Inholland

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Education about students left stranded by the closure of the English teacher-training programme at Hogeschool Inholland, including transfer options, the C2 CPE language requirement, the timing of the retake, and the diploma deadline of 31 August 2021. The Minister answers that all students were offered completion within the programme, transfer to Hogeschool van Amsterdam was arranged with a coulance regime, the C2 level is a sector-wide requirement, and diplomas cannot be issued after the closure date, while noting that some students could appeal.
There has been no question of a take it or leave it proposal.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een take it or leave it -voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de enorme toename van arbeidsuitbuiting in het afgelopen jaar

The MP asks why reports of labour exploitation rose about 70% and what the government will do, and whether the problem is larger than the figures show and why prosecutors judged a case not to be exploitation. The State Secretary answers that reports are a dark number, the enforcement approach is described, the Art. 273f Sr definition is high-threshold, and a revision is being explored but depends on a new cabinet and funding.
However, decision-making on revising Article 273f of the Criminal Code requires a caretaker cabinet and financial coverage.
Voor de besluitvorming over herziening van artikel 273f Sr zijn echter een missionair kabinet en financiële dekking nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de hoge benzineprijzen

An MP asked why petrol prices are high while oil prices fall, whether government can lower them, whether it will ask the competition authority to investigate abuse of market power, and whether it will compensate for the cost-of-living effect. The government answered that pump prices depend on market factors and that it has no direct influence beyond excise and VAT, will forward the abuse questions to the ACM which sets its own priorities, and declined a separate compensation.
I can however commit to forwarding these questions to the ACM.
Ik kan wel toezeggen dat ik deze vragen zal doorgeleiden aan de ACM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Ambtenaren hielpen staatssecretaris Knops bij privékwestie'

An MP asked whether civil servants, the state's lawyer and an agency were used to handle a private matter of State Secretary Knops, including legal analyses, communication advice and a Kadaster note, and whether this was proper and should be investigated. The minister answered that private matters can affect a minister's integrity so the ministry verified facts, that the legal analysis was only background information, that the Kadaster note led to no action, that no specific rules govern this, and that no independent investigation is needed.
This subject will be included in the concrete elaboration of the code of conduct for ministers and state secretaries.
Dit onderwerp zal worden betrokken bij de concrete uitwerking van de gedragscode voor bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het feit dat de Anti-flexwerkwet niet leidt niet tot meer vaste banen en vooral vrouwen en jongeren nu hun baan verliezen

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wab (Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans) is failing to create permanent jobs and is causing women and young people to lose jobs, citing an ABN Amro analysis. The minister answered that it is too early to draw conclusions from the short study period, that the evaluation is scheduled for 2025, and that decisions on further steps are for a next cabinet.
However, it is still too early to draw conclusions based on the short research period on which this report is based.
Het is echter nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken op basis van de korte onderzoeksperiode waarop dit rapport zich baseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat er woede is over de handelwijze van de gemeente Den Haag inzake de aanvraag van een vergunning voor een invalidenparkeerplaats

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of the Interior whether the anger over the municipality of The Hague's handling of a disabled parking permit application was justified. The questions were withdrawn by the MP on 4 October 2021, so no substantive answers were given.
