The written questions from MP Van Baarle (DENK) to the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the report of anger over the municipality of The Hague's handling of a permit application for a disabled parking space have been withdrawn (submitted 4 October 2021).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Baarle (DENK) aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat er woede is over de handelwijze van de gemeente Den Haag inzake de aanvraag van een vergunning voor een invalidenparkeerplaats zijn ingetrokken (ingezonden 4 oktober 2021).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over mogelijke bezuinigingen op het openbaar vervoer

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about planned public transport cuts affecting frequencies, safety, stops and fares, and whether operators should be fully compensated for lost passengers. The State Secretary answered that the earlier scenarios were provisional, that operators are updating 2022 plans under the existing financial framework, that the RET's security cuts are a local decision, and that full compensation is not planned since the subsidy covers 93–95% of costs.
I will inform you about this in the autumn.
Ik zal u hier dit najaar over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het toelaten van elektrische steps

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why electric scooters (e-steps) and similar light electric vehicles remain unlicensed in the Netherlands, asking about rental platforms, enforcement, fines, and timelines for legalisation. The minister answered that a national licensing framework is planned for 2023, that enforcement is by police with fines of 280 euro, and that a study on hoverboards and similar devices is expected in spring 2022.
The police do not keep a separate record of enforcement against e-steps.
De politie houdt geen aparte registratie bij van de handhaving op e-steps.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Baarle over de sloop van de Tweebosbuurt en de VN brief aan Rotterdam

MPs Beckerman and Van Baarle asked the Minister of Interior about the demolition of the Tweebosbuurt in Rotterdam, the UN rapporteurs' communication alleging human rights violations, and resident participation. The minister answered that dialogue with the UN and the municipality continues, that the courts are handling the appeal on the demolition, and that housing policy is a matter for local authorities, declining to order an independent investigation or halt the demolition.
An appeal has currently been lodged in this case, so it is for the court to assess whether the residents have been sufficiently involved.
Op dit moment is in deze casus een hoger beroep ingesteld, het is daarom aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de bewoners voldoende zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Baarle en Sneller over het bericht dat Nederland met de regels voor lobbyisten ver achterop zou raken

MPs Van Baarle and Sneller asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch lobbying rules lag behind other countries, including OECD findings, UK disclosure duties, revolving-door rules and the withdrawn lobbying-ban circular. The minister disputes that Netherlands is far behind, says a lobbying register and integrity code exist, promises new rules for former ministers and a possible code of conduct for ministers, but leaves a supervisory body and some measures to a future cabinet.
The Netherlands has no official supervisory body for lobbying activities, but that does not mean lobbying activities can take place without any restriction.
Nederland kent geen officiële toezichthouder op lobbyactiviteiten, maar dat betekent niet dat lobbyactiviteiten in Nederland zonder enige restrictie kunnen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de huidige stand van zaken met betrekking tot de digitale beveiliging van overheidswebsites in Nederland

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for the Interior about digital security of government websites, including sites of the Tax Authority, GGDs and water boards that reportedly fail NCSC guidelines, and about Wordpress warnings. The State Secretary answered that security is the responsibility of each organisation under the BIO baseline and risk assessments, denied a systemic failure, and pointed to ongoing standardisation monitoring.
It is up to government organisations to determine, by taking the mandatory BIO measures and additional measures arising from a risk assessment, how Wordpress can be used securely.

Het is aan overheidsorganisaties om door het treffen van de verplichte maatregelen uit de BIO en aanvullende maatregelen, voortvloeiend uit een risicoafweging te bepalen hoe Wordpress veilig kan worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over antiziganisme, de National Roma Integration Strategy en stateloosheid

MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the government about anti-Gypsyism, the EU Roma integration strategy, and statelessness among Dutch Roma. The minister answered that policy is generic anti-discrimination plus targeted Roma/Sinti measures, that no data exist on stateless Roma, and that existing law already gives Roma the same naturalisation rights as other aliens.
No data are available on this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over studentenuitwisselingen in coronatijd

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Education about universities cancelling student exchanges during COVID-19, whether policy follows travel advice, and how students can recover costs. The Minister said institutions decide on exchanges within the rules, the government lobbies in the EU for flexibility, and students should contact their institution about compensation.
It is up to the education institutions themselves to decide whether mobility projects can go ahead, within the frameworks.
Tot slot is het aan de onderwijsinstellingen zelf om te bepalen of mobiliteitsprojecten, binnen de kaders, doorgang kunnen vinden of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over gemeenten die mogelijk discriminerende algoritmen gebruiken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipalities possibly using discriminatory algorithms, following a Rotterdam audit office warning, and asked about the legal framework, use of nationality and ethnicity as indicators, supervision and transparency. The state secretary answered that existing equal-treatment law applies, that a government-wide inventory of nationality and ethnicity use in risk models is underway, that guidance and an impact assessment are being prepared, that a possible algorithm register is being explored, and that existing supervisors cover algorithms without a new body being deemed necessary.
I consider this the responsibility of the municipal council, the college of mayor and aldermen, local supervisors and audit offices.

Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het nieuwsbericht 'Gluurapparatuur» in trek door thuiswerken, vakbonden bezorg'

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs about union concerns that employee monitoring of home workers was increasing during the pandemic, and whether employers' use of intrusive surveillance such as spyware should be discouraged. The minister replied that monitoring is allowed only under strict GDPR conditions that apply equally at home and in the workplace, that the government has no direct role in employer-employee monitoring agreements, and that 14 complaints about home-work monitoring were received by the Data Protection Authority in 2020.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans en Klaver over de schending van het Poolse luchtruim door Russische drones

MPs Timmermans and Klaver asked whether the government would convene an extra EU Council, form a leaders' group with Poland, push for a sanctions package banning Russian energy imports, accelerate REPowerEU, pressure blocking member states on frozen Russian assets, and explain remaining Russian oil and gas imports via Dutch ports and port-access powers. The government answered that NATO and EU channels are primary, that a separate leaders' group is not appropriate, that negotiations are ongoing, that Dutch oil imports from Russia have ceased and LNG imports are limited, and that port refusal rests on EU sanctions law and with ports and municipalities rather than the national government.
The cabinet regrettably cannot go further into detail on the Dutch position in ongoing negotiations.
Het kabinet kan helaas niet verder in detail ingaan op de Nederlandse positie in lopende onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over het bericht 'Hungary ruling party drafts bill to crack down on foreign-funded organisations'

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs Klaver and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about a Hungarian bill targeting foreign-funded organisations, questioning its effects on civil society, press freedom, LGBTI groups and the rule of law. Minister Veldkamp answered that the cabinet rejects the bill as it stands, will raise concerns in Benelux and bilateral contacts, supports the EU Commission's infringement case, and reports that a majority for further Article 7 steps is not yet in sight.
The cabinet will raise the concerns about this bill within the Benelux during the General Affairs Council of 27 May, and also raises them in bilateral contacts.
Het kabinet zal de zorgen over dit wetsvoorstel in Benelux-verband uiten tijdens de Raad Algemene Zaken van 27 mei as., en brengt deze ook op in bilaterale contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Klaver en Boswijk over de voorgenomen krimp van EU-vertegenwoordigingen in het buitenland

MPs Paternotte, Klaver and Boswijk asked whether the planned Commission cut of EU delegation staff abroad, and the Dutch cuts, weaken EU diplomatic reach. The minister declined to comment on leaked documents, said the HR/VP decides on delegations, and said the Dutch cuts stay with specifics to be sent in spring.
For this reason, the cabinet does not wish to make substantive statements about the leaked document to which POLITICO refers.
Het kabinet wenst om die reden geen inhoudelijke uitspraken te doen over het gelekte document waarnaar POLITICO verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over het bericht «Sancties omzeild bij project van scheepsbouwer Damen in Rusland»

MPs Klaver and Piri asked whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's components reached Russia despite sanctions, what enforcement is underway, and how transit and dual-use exports via third countries are controlled. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, stated that enforcement is handled by the supervisor, OM and courts, and described general export licensing, due diligence and cooperation measures.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over tijdens de aankomende informele Europese Raad aandringen op veiligheidsgaranties voor Oekraïne naar aanleiding van de verkiezingen in de Verenigde Staten.

MP Klaver asked whether the Netherlands would push at the informal European Council for EU security guarantees for Ukraine after the US election, and how the government views possible shifts in US policy. The Prime Minister answered that the EU and partners will keep supporting Ukraine, that no conclusions should be drawn prematurely about US policy, and that the EU lacks a mandate to give security guarantees, while pointing to a ten-year security arrangement with Ukraine.
The European Union does not have the mandate to give security guarantees.
De Europese Unie heeft niet het mandaat om veiligheidsgaranties af te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Afkicken van Russisch gas blijkt lastiger dan gedacht: één lng-tanker per maand werden er plots twee'

MPs Klaver and Kröger asked whether the 14th sanctions package has increased Russian LNG imports into the EU and the Netherlands, how sanctions are enforced, and whether the government will press for tighter measures. The minister answered that Russian LNG imports into the Netherlands have doubled monthly since July, that this reflects rerouting rather than new purchases, that enforcement and sanctions are limited until March 2025, and that stronger EU-wide measures depend on a forthcoming Commission roadmap.
This concerns commercially confidential information on which I cannot make statements.
Dit betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht dat Corendon Russische toeristen naar de zon blijft vliegen

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Corendon's flights carrying Russian tourists to Turkey breach EU sanctions and whether the government will act against profit from trade with Russia. The minister replied that EU sanctions do not ban such flights, that the government cannot disclose its figures or discussions with individual firms, and that a study into Dutch firms is not opportune.
The cabinet cannot publicly discuss what it discusses with individual companies.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar niet ingaan op wat het bespreekt met individuele bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Timmermans, Klaver, Piri, Mutluer, Kathmann, Tseggai en Chakor over Russische desinformatiecampagnes

GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about Russian disinformation campaigns, including Czech intelligence reports that Voice of Europe served as a conduit for Russian payments to Dutch politicians, and whether the Czech government was asked to share that information and whether further investigation and capacity investment are planned. The answer declines to answer in writing and asks that the questions be put orally in the plenary debate instead.
I request that you put the questions orally during the debate on the report that, according to the Czech secret service, Russia paid cash to Dutch and European politicians
Ik verzoek u de vragen mondeling te stellen tijdens het debat over het bericht dat volgens de Tsjechische geheime dienst Rusland cash betaalde aan Nederlandse en Europese politici
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het rapport van Amnesty International International ‘From freedom to censorship, the consequences of the Hungarian propaganda law’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Amnesty report on Hungary's anti-LGBTIQ+ 'propaganda law', covering information rights, discrimination, sex education, rule of law and EU Article 7 proceedings. The minister condemned the law, supported the Commission's infringement case before the EU Court, and listed Dutch support for LGBTIQ+ groups in Hungary, but did not answer the questions separately.
The Netherlands will participate in this court case and has actively worked to ensure that as many other EU member states as possible do the same.
Nederland zal aan deze hofzaak deelnemen en heeft zich er actief voor ingezet dat zoveel mogelijk andere EU lidstaten dit ook doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Piri over de actuele situatie in Israël en Gaza

MPs Klaver and Piri asked the Foreign Minister about humanitarian access, the al-Ahli hospital explosion, hostage release, Gaza blockade and the Rafah crossing. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs a humanitarian pause and unhindered aid, supports independent investigation via the ICC, and says it cannot yet determine whether a total blockade violates international law.
Thorough and independent investigation will be necessary to bring the relevant facts to light.
Gedegen en onafhankelijk onderzoek zal nodig zijn om de relevante feiten boven water te krijgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en De Hoop over de besluitvorming met betrekking tot de motie Klaver-c.s. over het gelijkstellen van potentieel zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (pZZS) aan zeer zorgwekkende stoffen (ZZS)

MPs Klaver and De Hoop asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why the government did not implement the motion equating potentially very high-concern substances (pZZS) with very high-concern substances (ZZS), and about consultations, administrative burden, benefits, enforcement and the burden of proof. The State Secretary answered that the motion was legally vulnerable, that costs could not be precisely calculated, that no specific consultations followed the motion, and that alternative measures and an updated instrument for competent authorities were announced.
That is why in my letter of 6 October I announced various actions for the instruments of competent authorities.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief van 6 oktober verschillende acties aangekondigd voor het instrumentarium van bevoegde gezagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Sylvana Simons over het Zwarte Piet-geweld in Staphorst

MPs Klaver and Simons asked the Justice and Interior ministers about violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Staphorst, police preparation and protection, and whether independent inquiries or a demonstration-rights review would follow. The minister condemned the violence, pointed to criminal investigations, a mayoral inquiry and an Inspectorate of Justice and Security inquiry, declined to pre-empt them, and saw no reason to ask the Ombudsman or Safety Board to investigate.
This investigation will in any case focus on the police's performance of duties in preparing for the demonstration, during the confrontation between demonstrators and their attackers, and afterwards.
Dit onderzoek zal in elk geval gericht zijn op de taakuitvoering door de politie bij de voorbereiding op de demonstratie, gedurende de confrontatie tussen demonstranten en hun belagers en daarna.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Klaver over de berichtgeving over problemen door hevige regenval op Bonaire

MPs Bouchallikh and Klaver asked about flooding from heavy rain on Bonaire, the damage, whether local authorities have adequate capacity, the situation on other Caribbean islands, EU funds, drainage and reef protection. Minister Harbers answered that no assistance request was made, that the public body is responsible for infrastructure with Rijk support, and that a scan of water retention basins will be done in spring.
No information has been received about the damage, except that electricity on the island was temporarily out and the hospital was temporarily unreachable.
Er is geen informatie ontvangen over de schade, behalve dat tijdelijk de elektriciteit op het eiland is uitgevallen en tijdelijk het ziekenhuis niet bereikbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Klaver over de oorlogsmisdaad in Boetsja

MPs Ploumen and Klaver asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands would do after the Bucha killings, including UN action, ICC and ICJ steps, sanctions on sexual violence, and an energy boycott of Russia. The minister answered that the Netherlands backs UN and ICC efforts, that a UN sanctions regime on sexual violence is unlikely due to a Russian veto, and that further EU energy sanctions are being prepared, but no national boycott is planned.
In UN contexts the Netherlands works to stop the aggression of the Russian Federation, reject it and attach consequences where possible.
Nederland zet zich in VN-verband in om de agressie van de Russische Federatie een halt toe te roepen, te verwerpen en waar mogelijk consequenties hieraan te verbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Van der Lee en Omtzigt over de stroperige implementatie van sancties in Nederland

MPs Klaver, Van der Lee and Omtzigt asked why sanctions implementation in the Netherlands is slow and fragmented, covering ministerial responsibility, the tax secrecy exemption, APA/ATR rulings linked to sanctioned persons, frozen assets held by trust offices, and supervision gaps for non-financial assets. The government answered that sanctions coordination and enforcement are split across ministries and the OM, that the Belastingdienst obtained an exemption from tax secrecy and is reviewing rulings, and that a national coordinator's report with recommendations will follow in May.
The national coordinator is preparing a report with recommendations, to be submitted in mid-May and shared with your House.
De nationaal coördinator is bezig met een rapport met aanbevelingen dat medio mei zal worden aangeboden en met uw Kamer zal worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Omtzigt en Klaver over het gebruik van privé berichtenservices en privé mailboxen door bewindspersonen voor hun werk

MPs asked whether ministers' use of private email and messaging apps for government work is covered by the Wob and parliamentary inquiries, and about the Kamp Gmail and Snel phone cases. The government answered that work-related messages on private accounts fall under the Wob and parliamentary inquiry powers, that a ministry review of the VWS/BZK private accounts found no security or archiving risk, and it promised to supply usage overviews for the current and previous cabinets later.

Under Article 6(1) of the Parliamentary Inquiry Act, a parliamentary inquiry committee can demand copies of, access to, or knowledge of work-related documents, regardless of the form of communication used.

Op grond van artikel 6, eerste lid, van de Wet op de Parlementaire enquête kan er door een ingestelde parlementaire commissie een afschrift van, inzage in of kennisneming van werkgerelateerde documenten gevorderd worden, ongeacht de gehanteerde vorm van communicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Kaag wil extra sancties trustkantoren, grote gevolgen voor Zuidas'

MPs Klaver and Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about Russian assets held through Dutch letterbox companies, the effectiveness of sanctions and enforcement, possible bans on trust services, asset confiscation, a global asset registry, anti-abuse and transparency measures, and treaty safe harbours. The minister answered that the government will consider further sanctions including a ban on trust services to Russian and Belarusian clients, that a working group and a trust-sector study are underway, and that EU-level measures and registers are being pursued, while deferring several questions to the State Secretary and other departments.
As Minister of Finance, I do not have data on Russian assets held in Dutch letterbox companies.
Als Minister van Financiën beschik ik niet over data betreffende Russisch vermogen in Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Ellemeet over endometriose

MPs Klaver and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about endometriosis, including diagnostic delay, prevalence, treatment, education, guidelines and research funding. The minister answered that prevalence is uncertain, that awareness and education are mainly for professional bodies, that ZonMw will be asked about gender-sensitive research, and that talks with NVOG and LHV/NHG are willing to be held.
I am willing to sit down with the NVOG and the LHV/NHG to see which steps need to be taken to make diagnoses faster.
Ik ben bereid om met de NVOG en de LHV/NHG om de tafel te gaan om te zien welke stappen er gezet moeten gaan worden om sneller een diagnose te kunnen stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over 'Geef jongeren nu toegang tot de sneltesten'

GreenLeft MPs Klaver and Kröger asked the health minister about an opinion piece calling for youth access to rapid tests, and about OMT advice and the reopening of secondary schools in February 2021. The minister confirmed the questions were put to the OMT, that a generic framework exists for secondary education, and listed the OMT advice issued, but could not answer each question one by one in time due to a system migration.
The cabinet bases itself on the adopted OMT advice.
Het kabinet baseert zich op de vastgestelde OMT adviezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen en Van der Staaij over de snelheid van het vaccineren en de uitvoering van de vaccinatiestrategie

Four MPs (Jetten, Klaver, Ploumen, Van der Staaij) asked the health minister why the Netherlands lags the EU average in COVID-19 vaccination, about planning, stock management, the role of Defence and business, and vaccinating nursing-home residents. The minister answered that the first shot was given later than in other member states, that a large safety stock was held, that stock management and planning are being adjusted, and that vaccination groups are being prioritised by risk, while the answers on Defence/business offers and prognoses were largely restated policy or deferred.
It is not easy to estimate when the Netherlands will be at the same vaccination rate as the other EU countries or even above it.
Het is niet goed in te schatten wanneer Nederland op dezelfde vaccinatiegraad zit als de andere EU-landen of zelfs daar boven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over de berichtgeving ‘Gommers en Kuipers: 'Begin maandag met vaccineren ziekenhuispersoneel'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister whether he would heed calls by intensivist Gommers and hospital director Kuipers to start vaccinating essential hospital staff immediately, given rising sick leave and postponed treatments, and when staff such as ICU, emergency and ambulance workers would be eligible. The minister replied only by referring to a broader letter on the COVID-19 vaccination strategy update.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 vaccination strategy update status'
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 vaccinatiestrategie update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Klaver over het COVID-19 virus

MPs Kröger and Klaver asked the Health Minister about the RIVM guidance distinguishing 'vluchtig' from 'niet-vluchtig' contact for protective equipment in care, the delay in revising it, mask stocks and prices, regional versus national COVID measures, and whether the OMT should be reconvened. The minister answered that the guidance was a risk-based set of principles that could be departed from professionally, that the revision in August reflected practical problems rather than new science, that masks stocks were sufficient, and that regional measures were preferred with national action when needed.
The Ministry of VWS has no substantive role in determining the guidelines.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen inhoudelijke rol bij het vaststellen van de uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Ellemeet over de laatste ontwikkelingen betreffende COVID-19

MPs Klaver and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 test capacity, lab shortages, PPE shortage claims in elderly care, and the shifting testing targets. The minister answered that testing capacity now exceeds demand, that shortages were due to multiple causes, and that the PPE guidelines were not driven by scarcity, while acknowledging the testing targets were revised upward after demand surged and admitting the answers were late.
I do not have figures on what share of the critical/other COVID-19 category is carried out for healthcare personnel.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over welk deel van de kritieke/overige Covid-19 categorie uitgevoerd wordt voor personeel in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Schaarste testmaterialen dreigt, Nederlandse producten verdwijnen naar buitenland’

GreenLeft MPs Klaver and Kröger asked the Health Minister whether shortages of PCR test materials are looming, why Dutch-based producer Bioplastics supplies only two percent of its output to the Netherlands, and whether shortages can be ruled out. The minister answered that stocks of tubes, swabs and cartridges are adequate, that filter tips are a critical item being actively sourced, and that a Dutch cartridge production line and alternative tests are being pursued, though individual laboratories may still face shortages.
I note that there is currently no need for the centrally purchased cartridges.
Ik constateer dat aan de centraal ingekochte cartridges momenteel geen behoefte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de vraag dat de Koning voor de herfstvakantie naar Griekenland is afgereisd

An MP asked whether the King travelled to Greece before the autumn holiday, whether this sent the wrong signal given lockdown appeals, whether the trip was coordinated with the government, and whether the Deputy PM knew of it when denying any knowledge of a holiday. The Prime Minister confirmed the King returned, admitted a misjudgement, said the constitutional protection of the Crown limits disclosure of contacts, and explained the Deputy PM was not informed in advance.
This means that no information can be provided about political and/or official contacts relating to matters within the Crown.
Dit betekent dat geen informatie kan worden verstrekt over contacten van politieke en/of ambtelijke aard die betrekking hebben op hetgeen zich binnen de Kroon voltrekt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Bromet en Ellemeet over G4 EA H1N1-virus en het bericht ‘RIVM houdt ontwikkeling van Chinees varkensvirus goed in de gaten’

MPs Klaver, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the ministers why RIVM is not preparing for the G4 EA H1N1 swine flu virus despite its pandemic potential, how vaccines could be produced, and what sources RIVM monitors. The ministers answered that human-to-human transmission has not been observed, vaccine production takes 4-6 months via WHO-coordinated surveillance, and that no link exists with African swine fever.
It is currently not known how Chinese employees and pig farmers were infected. That is a Chinese matter and we have no information about it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend op welke manier Chinese medewerkers en varkensboeren zijn besmet. Dat is een Chinese aangelegenheid en we hebben daarover geen informatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Verpleeghuizen wilden al vroeg testen maar werden geweigerd’, 'Protocol voor contactonderzoek kent twee grote zwakke plekken' en ’Inval-minis

Greens MPs asked the health minister about nursing homes being denied COVID-19 testing, the contact-tracing protocol, staffing needs, and the procurement of protective equipment through the national LCH consortium. The minister answered most questions with figures and explanations, while declining to give some data (such as the Germany, Belgium and France mask purchase figures) and deferring on the one-by-one timing request.
No, I do not have this overview at the moment.
Nee, dit overzicht heb ik op dit moment niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Pechtold en Klaver over inzage in e-mails van het ministerie van Algemene Zaken inzake de Teevendeal

MPs Roemer, Pechtold and Klaver asked whether the Prime Minister will reconsider refusing disclosure of the e-mails and attached message about the Teeven deal, and why the government's privacy and advisory-confidentiality interests outweigh openness, plus questions on whether the e-mail was passed to the Oosting commission and forwarded to a private address. The Prime Minister refused to release the e-mails citing civil servant confidentiality and privacy, gave a summary of how the attachment was handled, and stood by his claim that the cabinet never deliberately withheld information while acknowledging serious failures.
Emails of individual civil servants are therefore in principle not provided.
Mails van individuele ambtenaren worden daarom in beginsel niet verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Roemer, Segers, Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma en Klaver over openstaande vragen met betrekking tot de Teevendeal

MPs from SP, ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about the open questions surrounding the Teeven deal, including why officials at Algemene Zaken had a ministry email with draft answers without the PM being informed, and asked for access to the emails. The PM answered that the email was received but not read or discussed, that no reply was sent, and that releasing the underlying internal emails is incompatible with protecting open deliberation and staff privacy.

Granting access to the underlying internal civil-service emails is not compatible with the essential interest in properly preparing decision-making, which is served by confidentiality of free and open exchange of ideas.
Verlening van inzage in onderliggende ambtelijke mails is niet verenigbaar met het wezenlijke belang dat is gemoeid met een goede voorbereiding van besluitvorming
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, van Haersma Buma en Pechtold over onduidelijkheden rond het door de regering gevoerde asielbeleid

Opposition MPs from GroenLinks, CDA and D66 asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice about unclear targets, forecasts, budgets, border controls and information on the asylum intake of 2016. The State Secretary answered at length, often stating that effects cannot be quantified in advance, that a 58,000 intake target is assumed for the budget while contingency planning uses the 93,600 forecast, and that some information is not available in the requested form.
Because the causes of migration are strongly influenced by external factors, it is not possible to quantify the effects of these measures in advance.
Doordat de oorzaken van migratie sterk beïnvloed worden door externe factoren is het niet mogelijk om effecten van deze maatregelen vooraf te kwantificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht 'Wiebes boos om Braziliaanse belastingactie tegen Nederland'

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked the State Secretary of Finance about Brazil placing the Netherlands on its grey list over preferential holding company tax treatment, its effect on Dutch firms, treaty renegotiation, anti-abuse clauses, disclosure of Dutch-Brazilian exchanges, and parallels with Mongolia and Malawi terminating tax treaties. The State Secretary answered that the listing is unjustified, Brazil has not clarified its criterion, treaty talks stalled since 2008 but are being revived with anti-abuse measures, diplomatic correspondence cannot be shared, and the Mongolia and Malawi cases are unrelated.
Given the confidentiality of diplomatic exchanges, I cannot go into detail on this in the answers to these parliamentary questions.
Met het oog op de vertrouwelijkheid van het diplomatieke verkeer, kan ik daar in de antwoorden op deze Kamervragen niet in detail op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de door de Europese Commissie voorgestelde nieuwe handelsstrategie voor Europa

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the European Commission's new trade strategy, covering modernisation of existing trade agreements, the link between trade and sustainable development, GSP rules, labour and human rights, regulatory standards, transparency of negotiations, and investor-state arbitration. The minister answered that the strategy aims to strengthen sustainability and transparency, that Dutch standards will be maintained, and that the Dutch model investment treaty will be revised in line with the EU standard.
The cabinet favours maximum transparency in negotiations on trade and investment agreements.
Het kabinet is voorstander van maximale transparantie van onderhandelingen over handels- en investeringsakkoorden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme, Klaver en Voordewind over het rapport van de onafhankelijke klachtencommissie van de Nederlandse financieringsmaatschappij voor ontwikkelingslanden FMO m.b.t. de Barro Blanco dam i

MPs Thieme, Klaver and Voordewind asked the minister about the FMO complaints committee finding that indigenous rights were not fully assessed before approving the Barro Blanco dam loan in Panama, and about human rights impact assessments, parliamentary oversight of FMO, and the state's influence over FMO investment decisions. The minister acknowledged the incomplete information, promised to raise FMO's tightened approval process and transparency with FMO, supported a dialogue process with indigenous authorities, and rejected several proposals such as a public open session of FMO's supervisory board and a construction halt.
At the next consultation with FMO I will explicitly raise this issue.
In het eerstvolgende overleg met FMO zal ik dit nadrukkelijk aan de orde stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Pensioenfonds moet uit olie en gas”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about press reports that APG/ABP's exposure to fossil fuels differs from DNB's earlier estimate, and whether DNB would reassess its conclusions and monitor carbon bubble and climate-policy risks. The minister answered that the figures differ because APG/ABP used a broader definition of energy investments, that DNB sees no reason to revise its conclusion, and that DNB addresses ESG risks through supervision and dialogue.
The full APG report is not publicly available because it serves internal risk purposes and contains confidential information.
Het volledige rapport van APG is niet publiek beschikbaar, omdat het voor interne risicodoeleinden dient en vertrouwelijke informatie bevat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht ‘Vee heeft invloed op gezondheid’

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about preliminary research suggesting livestock farming affects residents' health, and whether a moratorium on new large stables should follow. The government replied that the findings are not conclusive, that the study will finish in 2016, that no measures are warranted now, and that permitting is a decentralised matter.
That means the interim results are not a basis for taking any measures at this time.
Dat betekent dat de tussentijdse resultaten geen basis zijn om op dit moment maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over automatische uitwisseling van tax rulings

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about automatic exchange of tax rulings between EU member states, including whether the 2012 Code of Conduct Group document commits states to automatic exchange. The State Secretary answered that no automatic exchange of rulings has yet been agreed, only spontaneous exchange under the Administrative Cooperation Directive, and that the Commission's announced directive proposal is welcomed, while the Group's discussions remain confidential.
The Council of the European Union, when establishing the Code of Conduct Group, determined that the Group's discussions are confidential.
De Raad van de Europese Unie heeft bij de instelling van de Gedragscodegroep bepaald dat de besprekingen van de Groep vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over inzage rulingpraktijken

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked whether the government had requested all Luxembourg tax rulings concerning Dutch companies and wealthy individuals, and why Germany was given access to the Dutch ruling practice. Wiebes answered that Dutch tax interest in Luxembourg rulings is still being examined and that rulings will be requested if warranted, while defending bilateral exchange of rulings and the fiscal secrecy duty against calls for public disclosure.
At present it is being examined whether, and if so in which cases, there is Dutch tax interest in relation to Luxembourg rulings.
Op dit moment wordt uitgezocht of, en zo ja in welke gevallen, er Nederlands heffingsbelang is in relatie tot Luxemburgse rulings.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over de berichtgeving “Nederland verzette zich tegen OESO-aanpak belastingontwijking”

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch innovation box, which can benefit firms whose R&D is done abroad, undermines its purpose and whether the Netherlands opposed the OECD's tighter approach to patent boxes. The State Secretary answered that the box requires sufficient substance in the Netherlands, that the Netherlands backed a transfer-pricing approach instead of the nexus approach, and that the box will not be amended via the Fiscale verzamelwet 2015.
The cabinet does not have the picture that the Dutch innovation box enables abuse of internal transfer prices by international concerns.
Het kabinet heeft niet het beeld dat de Nederlandse innovatiebox misbruik van de interne verrekenprijzen van internationale concerns mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Smaling over zoutwinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Smaling and Klaver asked whether the government had properly examined using German brine instead of salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether that option was included in the environmental permit and appropriate assessment. The minister answered that German brine is economically unviable due to lower salt concentration, high transport costs and supply risks, so no renewed talks with Frisia are planned, and that the permit cannot be revoked while objection proceedings are pending.
I see no reason to question this conclusion.
Ik zie geen reden om deze conclusie in twijfel te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “EU berispt Nederland om belastingregels bedrijven”

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about EU criticism of Dutch tax rules for multinationals, including calls to act on aggressive tax planning and a Commission remark that tax-climate warnings would appear in country recommendations. The State Secretary replied that the Netherlands already acts against tax avoidance, that Dutch rules are sound, that a formal state-aid investigation into a Starbucks APA has been opened, and that a letter on corporate tax revenue decline and a position on a beneficial-ownership register will follow.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over het voorkomen van witwassen van Russische vermogens

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked how the government implemented a motion calling for heightened vigilance against money laundering of Russian officials' and oligarchs' assets, and about Navalny's claims that Western police obstructed investigations and that 90% of Russian corruption money is laundered in the West. The minister replied that the Wwft's risk-based regime already requires heightened vigilance, that supervisors issued guidance and circulars, that FIUs cooperated on Ukraine and Russia, and that the government could not verify Navalny's claims, with the OM reporting no contact from Navalny's foundation.
Ultimately it is up to the institutions themselves to determine the degree of risk and which measures to take.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de instellingen zelf om de mate van het risico te bepalen en welke maatregelen men neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Klaver over het nieuws dat de fiscale structuur van Philip Morris wel in Nederland blijft

Opposition MPs Merkies and Klaver asked whether Philip Morris's Dutch tax holding structure remains only for tax reasons, whether tax rulings must be re-tested after mass layoffs, and about support and secret agreements. The State Secretary refused to give information on individual taxpayers under tax secrecy, said the company keeps a significant presence (about 140 jobs), and denied any secret agreements outside legal frameworks.
Based on the secrecy obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot provide information about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het opzeggen van het belastingverdrag met Nederland door Malawi

MPs Klaver asked why Malawi terminated its tax treaty with the Netherlands, whether talks on a new treaty have begun, and why a 2013 IBFD study omitted Malawi. The State Secretary replied that Malawi's reasons are unclear, a new treaty was agreed at official level in August 2013 but the termination leaves a treaty gap, and he will inform the House if a country terminates a treaty.
Are you willing, in future, when a country decides to terminate the tax treaty with the Netherlands, to inform the House of this immediately by letter?
Bent u bereid in het vervolg wanneer een land besluit het belastingverdrag met Nederland op te zeggen de Kamer per ommegaande hierover per brief te informeren?
Antwoord op vragen van de Leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked whether the Dutch embassy in Kiev actively invited companies to a November 2013 seminar on investing in the Netherlands, whether attendees were linked to EU-sanctioned persons, and how trust offices and FIU reports relate to Ukrainian assets. The minister answered that the embassy did not actively approach companies, that the attendee list is not shared for privacy reasons, that no sanctioned person attended, and that embassy promotion events and trust office presentations are not centrally registered.
These reports of unusual transactions are then assessed by FIU, and based on the information available to FIU, FIU may decide to report the unusual transactions as suspicious to law enforcement.

Deze meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties worden vervolgens door FIU beoordeeld en op basis van de bij FIU beschikbare informatie kan FIU besluiten de ongebruikelijke transacties als verdacht door te melden aan de opsporing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver en Omtzigt over Oekraïense vermogens die in Nederland gestald worden en de rol die de Nederlandse ambassade hierin speelt

MPs Van Ojik, Klaver and Omtzigt asked about trust offices and the Dutch embassy in Kiev hosting a November seminar on the Dutch fiscal climate, including whether the presentations fit OECD substance rules, whether they would be shared, the guest list, and the number of anti-money-laundering reports on Ukrainian funds. The minister answered that the seminar was a public event within embassy tasks, that none of the 18 EU-sanctioned persons attended, that FIU-Nederland received 1475 linked transactions and two unusual trust-office reports, and that gatekeepers self-police under DNB supervision, while leaving several questions (presentations, guest list) unanswered.
The Cabinet is of the view that facilitating this meeting falls within the standing mandate of the embassies.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat het faciliteren van deze bijeenkomst past binnen de staande taakopdracht van de ambassades.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel “ook zoon Janoekovitsj sluisde vermogen weg via Nederlandse belastingroute”

GreenLeft MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether Dutch tax structures (Mako Holding, Artvin Holding) were used to channel money from Ukraine's Janukovych family, and whether the Netherlands would support a public beneficial-ownership register and freeze assets. The government answered that tax secrecy prevents details on individual taxpayers, described existing anti-money-laundering and beneficial-ownership rules and a planned restricted central shareholder register, and said EU sanctions on Ukrainian officials were being prepared.
Based on the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General Tax Act, no information can be given about individual taxpayers.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsverplichting van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan geen informatie worden gegeven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het Europese bankenresolutiefonds

Green Left MP Klaver asks whether the intergovernmental treaty underpinning the European banking resolution fund breaches EU law principles such as loyal cooperation, institutional balance, democracy, standstill and equal treatment, and whether the Court of Justice's short-selling ruling undermines the Meroni objection to Article 114 TFEU. The government answers that the intergovernmental route is lawful because the matter falls within shared competence not yet exercised by the Union, that the Court of Justice and European Parliament retain oversight roles, and that it sees no need to seek separate advice from the Council of State.
According to the cabinet, the intergovernmental approach does not conflict with the principles mentioned.
Volgens het kabinet is de intergouvernementele aanpak niet in strijd met de genoemde beginselen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de website scholenopdekaart.nl

An MP asked why the scholenopdekaart.nl school-comparison website went online with much information missing, how it can serve parents' school choice, and what the development cost. The Secretary of State answered that the site is a phased rollout with information added by schools over time, that the project completes in 2015, and that the PO-Raad budgeted over 7 million euros for 2012-2015 across more than 7,000 schools, with a fuller letter on transparency promised.
Moreover, I will set out my vision on transparency, and thereby on Vensters voor Verantwoording PO and VO, in a separate letter to your House this spring.
Overigens zal ik in een aparte brief aan uw Kamer, die ik u dit voorjaar toezend, mijn visie op transparantie en daarmee ook op Vensters voor Verantwoording PO en VO uiteen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over belangenverstrengeling hoogleraren financiële sector

An MP asks the government about conflicts of interest arising from professors in the financial sector holding outside positions, including on the Commission Structuure Nederlandse Banken, and about transparency and funding of chairs. The minister says transparency agreements with universities are being upheld, that outside positions do not disqualify advisers, and that existing codes suffice, promising no new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports country-by-country tax reporting for multinationals, as proposed by the European Parliament development committee, and whether it will push for mandatory per-country tax disclosure in annual reports. The government replied that it supports transparency initiatives on tax payments but stresses coordination with existing rules, the economic risks of public disclosure, and the need for clear EU proposals with assessed effects.
The Netherlands has consistently indicated that alignment with existing transparency obligations, such as the obligation already included in the capital requirements directive, is important.
Nederland heeft steeds aangegeven dat afstemming met bestaande transparantieverplichtingen, zoals de verplichting die reeds is opgenomen in de richtlijn voor kapitaalvereisten, van belang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over uiteindelijke-belanghebbendenregisters in relatie tot de herziening van de derde anti-witwasrichtlijn

An MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about beneficial-ownership registers in the EU anti-money-laundering directive, including whether such a register should be public. The minister answered that the Netherlands prefers a central shareholder register accessible only to authorised public bodies and notaries, not the public, and that the UBO content is still under discussion in the Council.
The Netherlands sees more in a central shareholder register.
Nederland ziet meer in een centraal aandeelhoudersregister.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over Nederlandse financiële instellingen die investeren in kernwapens

An MP asks whether the government will restrict Dutch financial institutions, including the ABP pension fund and ABN AMRO, from investing in nuclear weapons producers, and whether it will pressure them to stop. The government answers that the NPT does not ban such investment, that institutions bear their own responsibility under national law, that no ban is being considered, and that it sees no added value in raising the issue again with ABP.
With reference to the answer to question 1, no ban on investing in companies that manufacture nuclear weapon components is being considered.
Onder verwijzing naar het antwoord bij vraag 1 wordt er geen verbod inzake het investeren in bedrijven die onderdelen voor kernwapens maken overwogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het Nederlands verzet tegen country-by-country reporting voor internationaal opererende ondernemingen

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the Dutch government is opposing an EU-wide country-by-country reporting obligation for multinationals and whether its position remains consistent with earlier commitments. The government answered that it supports transparency initiatives through tax reporting in general, while stressing possible negative economic effects of public disclosure, the need for coordination with existing rules, and clear, well-assessed EU proposals.
The Netherlands will also in future take a position along the lines outlined above.
Nederland zal ook in de toekomst een positie langs de hiervoor geschetste lijnen innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Pensioenbeheer veel duurder”

Rep. Klaver asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that pension fund management costs rose mainly due to higher performance fees to asset managers, and about whether bonuses should be linked to multi-year returns, cost control, and mandatory cost reporting. The State Secretary answers that higher costs are justified only if matched by higher returns, that pension funds are collectively responsible for costs, that the sector already largely bases fees on multi-year returns, that governance and transparency are the main cost-control tools, and that no additional binding measures are currently needed.
I am following these developments with interest, but for the time being I see no reason for additional measures.
Ik volg deze ontwikkelingen met belangstelling, maar zie vooralsnog geen aanleiding voor aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver inzake het bericht Dubieuze stellingnames en rekenfout in SEO-rapport over belastingparadijs Nederland

MP Klaver asked the Finance and Justice ministers about a Quotenet report criticising a SEO study on the Netherlands as a tax haven, covering supervision costs, prosecution of letterbox companies, trust office reporting, and the SEO dividend tax estimate. Minister Opstelten answered that supervision claims are unclear, costs of extra enforcement and prosecution are uncertain, DNB supervises trust offices and has taken enforcement measures, and the SEO revenue figures will be addressed in a separate government response.
Tightening the control of trust offices, by contrast, is a constant concern.
Aanscherping van de controle op trustkantoren daarentegen is voortdurend aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het bericht “Meer dan 3.500 postbusfirma's in Nederland overtreden de wet”

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked whether the government was aware that many postbox firms and foreign cooperatives fail to file annual accounts on time, and what sanctions and oversight are in place. The minister answers that enforcement is multilayered (Chamber of Commerce monitoring, creditor claims, criminal fines, Tax Authority investigation), that sanctions need no tightening, and that a central shareholder register is planned.
I therefore see no reason to tighten the sanctions.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de sancties aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver over seksuele vorming en de seksuele gezondheid van jongeren

MPs Voortman and Klaver asked the ministers about condom use, STI rates among young people, and whether schools and parents should do more sexual education. The government answered that schools' role is set by attainment targets and school-level choices, that GGDs run prevention campaigns, and that no new school-specific measures are planned.
However, schools themselves decide on which topics and in what way they involve parents in their children's education.
Scholen bepalen echter zelf bij welke onderwerpen en op welke manier zij ouders betrekken bij het onderwijs van hun kinderen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over het artikel ‘Alleen losers betalen belasting’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about tax avoidance by multinationals using Dutch letterbox companies, and whether such companies comply with the OECD Guidelines and can be subject to NCP complaints. The minister acknowledges the problem, says compliance is for the National Contact Points to judge, notes no complaint has ever been filed against a Dutch letterbox company, and promises to ask the OECD for clarification while deferring the answer on access to information.

To support the NCPs in forming their judgment, I will ask the OECD whether the Working Party for Responsible Business Conduct, in consultation with the Committee on Fiscal Affairs, can clarify the OECD Guidelines in cases of tax optimisation by multinationals.

Teneinde de oordeelsvorming door de Nationale Contact Punten te ondersteunen zal ik aan de OESO vragen of de Working Party for Responsible Business Conduct in overleg met het Committee on Fiscal Affairs een nadere duiding kan geven van de OESO-richtlijnen in het geval van fiscale optimalisatie door multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Zoveel banen, dat is echt stupide”

MP Klaver asked the state secretary of Finance about criticism by three professors that SEO's job estimates for letterbox companies rested on a calculation error, and whether the claimed job effects would survive without these firms. The state secretary answered only by referring to a joint government letter of 30 August with a cabinet response to the SEO report, without addressing the substance of the questions.
In a joint letter with the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation of 30 August, I sent the House, as previously promised, a cabinet response to, among other things, the SEO report.

In een gezamenlijke brief met de minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking van 30 augustus heb ik, zoals eerder toegezegd, een kabinetsreactie op, onder andere, het SEO rapport aan uw kamer gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over onterecht betaalde belasting door zwangere zzp’ers

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether self-employed women (zzp'ers) who paid income tax on pregnancy benefits from their insurer can recover it, whether earlier years are covered, and what measures will prevent future over-taxation. The State Secretary answered that affected taxpayers can request ex officio reduction until five years after the tax year, that these benefits are not taxable, and that the Tax Administration will add a note on this to general information and the income tax return guidance.
The self-employed person can therefore still submit a request for ex officio reduction throughout 2013 for the years 2008 and onward.
De zzp’er kan gedurende het hele jaar 2013 dus nog een verzoek om ambtshalve vermindering indienen over de jaren 2008 en volgende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over de grondrechtensituatie in Hongarije

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Foreign Minister about the fundamental rights situation in Hungary following the European Parliament's Tavares report, including whether the European Council should respond, whether an 'Article 2 trilogue' should be created, and whether EPP party contacts had worked. The minister said Commission and Venice Commission dialogue has been constructive and that Netherlands opposes country-specific mechanisms, while supporting a general EU rule-of-law mechanism; he acknowledged the EPP efforts had not yet produced results.
In addition, the cabinet is working to develop an additional rule-of-law mechanism within the EU, as recently discussed again in the General Affairs Council.
Daarnaast zet het kabinet zich in voor de ontwikkeling van een aanvullend rechtsstaatelijkheidsmechanisme binnen de EU, zoals onlangs wederom besproken in de Raad Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ojik en Klaver over Investeringen vanuit Nederland in Afrika

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked why around 62 percent of Dutch-channelled investment in Africa comes from foreign multinationals using Dutch holdings, and whether treaty shopping under Dutch tax treaties with African countries costs developing countries revenue and will be curbed. The minister answers that Dutch treaties reduce withholding taxes, that the tax law does not distinguish 'real Dutch' companies from foreign multinationals, that revenue losses are hard to estimate, and that anti-abuse clauses and OECD BEPS work will be used.
Where desired, the Netherlands includes anti-abuse clauses in new treaties and is also willing to extend existing treaties with anti-abuse clauses where unintended use of the treaty is found.

Nederland neemt in nieuwe verdragen desgewenst anti-misbruik clausules op en is ook bereid bestaande verdragen bij gebleken onbedoeld gebruik van het verdrag uit te breiden met anti-misbruik clausules.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Fraude voedsel niet gemeld”

An MP asked whether food fraud is rarely reported to the NVWA, how it will monitor fraud, whether budget cuts reduce inspections, when the traffic-light disclosure model will publish inspection results, and whether shops and producers will be publicly rated. The government referred to its earlier reaction, said inspections are risk-based and the strategy will be revised, that a disclosure pilot starts in autumn with broader rollout after the Health Act amendment, and that the NVWA can set its own priorities.
Based on the experience with food fraud, the NVWA will revise its supervision strategy.
Op grond van de ervaringen met de voedselfraude zal de NVWA de toezichtstrategie gaan herzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het onlangs afgesloten belastingverdrag met China en over het belastingverdrag met Mongolië

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the newly signed China tax treaty and the Mongolia treaty enable profit shifting by multinationals, and whether the Mongolia losses of over 4 billion euros were accurate. The State Secretary defended the China treaty as anti-abuse safeguarded and said the Mongolia figure was unsubstantiated while committing to renegotiate with Mongolia under reformed policy principles.
I will not hesitate to act swiftly if a situation of tax border-probing with regard to this treaty were to arise.
Ik zal niet aarzelen voortvarend aan de slag te gaan als zich een situatie van fiscale grensverkenning met betrekking tot dit verdrag zou voordoen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht ‘Nederland laat fiscale kansen liggen om verder te vergroenen’

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that the Netherlands is missing fiscal opportunities to green its economy, including KPMG's ranking, recent green tax changes and removals, and the employment effects of green taxation. The government answered that the Netherlands is already a frontrunner in environmental taxes, listed the recent measures and their rationale, and said further green taxation is constrained by level-playing-field concerns and that new taxes work best at EU level.
I share the view that green fiscal policy can have positive effects on innovation, the environment and sustainability.
Ik deel de mening dat fiscale vergroening positieve effecten kan hebben op innovatie, milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Merkies over het bericht van de Franse regering om er binnen de EU voor te ijveren dat country-by-country reporting verplicht wordt gesteld voor alle bedrijven

MPs Klaver and Merkies asked whether the government supports France's EU push for country-by-country tax reporting for all multinationals, and what it will do about it. The government supports international efforts against aggressive tax planning, would back France if it raises the proposal in the EU, but favours such reporting only if introduced at EU level.
The cabinet will therefore support the French government if it wishes to consult at EU level on an obligation for such reporting.
Het kabinet zal dan ook de Franse regering steunen als zij in EU-verband wenst te overleggen over een verplichting tot een dergelijke rapportage.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Klaver over mogelijke belastingontwijking door leden van het Koninklijk Huis

MPs Van Ojik and Klaver asked the Prime Minister and State Secretary of Finance about possible tax avoidance by members of the Royal House, including how their structure compares to Princess Christina's, and whether they should be taxed like ordinary citizens. The government answered that royals are subject to the same legal privacy protections in tax matters as other taxpayers, that no change is needed, and that press reports do not alter this.
With regard to the legal protection of personal privacy connected to taxation, members of the Royal House do not differ from other taxpayers.
Ten aanzien van de met belastingheffing verbonden wettelijke bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer verschillen leden van het koninklijk huis niet van andere belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het artikel «Europese Commissie houdt Nederland buiten transactietax»

MP Klaver asks the Finance Minister about a news report that the European Commission had excluded the Netherlands from the financial transaction tax and disputed the pension sector's cost estimates. The minister answers that the Netherlands will not join the enhanced cooperation on the current proposal because pension funds are not exempted, cites DNB estimates of at least €500 million in FTT payments by Dutch financial institutions, and disagrees with the NSFM paper on pension funds.
The Netherlands will continue to actively press Dutch wishes on the Commission and the other member states.
Nederland zal zich er actief voor blijven inzetten om de Nederlandse wensen onder de aandacht te brengen bij de Commissie en de overige lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over dierproeven in het Biomedical Primate Research Centre

An MP asked the state secretary about the reduction of primate experiments at the BPRC, the number of marmosets, the nature of experiments, the independence of its animal experiment committee, and primate imports and exports. The government answered that about 1500 primates are held, mostly in a breeding colony, that primate experiments in the Netherlands fell from 691 in 2002 to 345 in 2011, and that some requested data, such as institution-level figures and alternatives found, are not released or not reported.
Companies are not obliged to report to the government on the use of alternatives to animal experiments.
Bedrijven zijn niet verplicht aan de overheid te rapporteren over het gebruik van alternatieven voor dierproeven.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht “Weekers lokt Japanse investeerders met belastingklimaat”

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance about reported statements promoting the Dutch tax climate to Japanese investors, and how fiscal certainty is given to foreign companies. Weekers answered that the Netherlands was promoted as an attractive investment location, that advance certainty is provided through the APBI contact point for investments of at least EUR 4.5 million, and that agreements remain within the legal framework.
The contact point provides advance certainty on planned investments of in principle at least EUR 4.5 million that lead to sustainable employment in the Netherlands.
Het aanspreekpunt geeft zekerheid vooraf op voorgenomen investeringen van in beginsel minimaal € 4,5 miljoen die leiden tot duurzame werkgelegenheid in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over een dividenduitkering door ABN AMRO

An MP asked the Finance Minister about ABN AMRO's 2013 dividend despite profit gains from one-off items, its loan pricing to SMEs, and whether systemic banks should hold higher capital buffers. The minister answered that dividend and pricing are the bank's decisions, that ABN AMRO meets current capital rules, and that a systemic-relevance buffer for ING and other systemic banks will be introduced via a bill to come.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Zuid Europese bedrijven drukken belasting met Nederlandse postbusfirma’s”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Finance whether he knew that many southern European multinationals use Dutch letterbox companies, and how he viewed low effective tax rates and the fairness of the tax burden. The State Secretary said he holds no data on these holdings or tax paid by non-resident companies, rejected the claim that southern European governments lose revenue through Dutch routing, and pointed to EU and OECD initiatives on the matter.
I do not have data on the extent to which companies established in the said states hold shares in companies established in the Netherlands.
Ik beschik niet over gegevens over de mate waarin vennootschappen gevestigd in de genoemde staten aandelen houden in vennootschappen die in Nederland zijn gevestigd.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht “Mongolië pikt het niet meer en zegt belastingverdrag met Nederland op”

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance whether Mongolia's termination of its tax treaty with the Netherlands, which it said let multinationals avoid Mongolian taxes, was justified and why the Netherlands had not renegotiated it, and asked about IMF criticism and a motion on reviewing treaties for developing-country effects. The state secretary rejected the premise that Mongolian taxes are generally avoided, argued Mongolia retains substantial mining revenue, explained the treaty was concluded in 2002 at Mongolia's request, denied refusing renegotiation terms outright, and said a review of treaties with developing countries is underway with results expected in summer.
Moreover, only dividends on shares not held by the Mongolian state will leave Mongolia.
Daar komt bij dat alleen de dividenden op aandelen die niet in handen zijn van de Mongoolse staat, Mongolië zullen verlaten
Antwoord vragen van de leden Servaes en Klaver over de wijziging van de grondwet in Hongarije

MPs Servaes and Klaver asked whether the Hungarian constitutional amendment limiting the Constitutional Court and checks and balances is a concern, whether the EU and Council of Europe should act, and how EU monitoring of rule of law should be strengthened. The minister said the government shares concerns, will raise the issue at the European Council, supports a stronger Commission role and a new EU safeguard mechanism, and notes the Council of Europe's Venice Commission is reviewing the amendments.

The government will, together with the other member states that wrote the letter and possibly other supporting member states, consult the European Commission and EU member states to further develop these aspects of such a mechanism.

Het kabinet zal, samen met de andere lidstaten die de brief hebben geschreven en mogelijk ook andere lidstaten die voorstander zijn van de totstandkoming van een dergelijk mechanisme, in overleg treden met de Europese Commissie en de lidstaten van de EU om deze aspecten verder uit te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos en het lid Klaver over mogelijke bijdrage van voedselproducenten aan mensenrechtenschendingen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Maij, Jan Vos and Klaver asked whether Dutch food and drink producers contribute to human rights abuses such as land grabbing, exploitation of women and farmers, and labour violations in developing countries, following an Oxfam report. The minister responded that she shares concerns, relies mainly on voluntary OECD guidelines, IFC standards and sector cooperation, will engage the industry federation, and will encourage companies to map gender and labour conditions in their supply chains.
From Dutch companies I ask that they comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, which include the responsibility to prevent human rights abuses.
Van Nederlandse bedrijven vraag ik dat zij de OESO richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven, waarin de verantwoordelijkheid tot het voorkomen van mensenrechtenschendingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “SNS lost risicodragende schuld af ondanks kapitaalnood”

An MP asked the finance minister why SNS REAAL repaid subordinated participation certificates while still owing state aid and negotiating new aid, and whether DNB would explain its decision. The minister answered that DNB, as an independent supervisor, could not explain individual decisions due to confidentiality, that the certificates were repaid after DNB withdrew their Tier 1 status to avoid mass damage claims, and that contractual repayment conditions on state aid would have undesirable side effects.
In principle DNB is bound by supervisory law to keep data on individual institutions confidential, and for that reason DNB is not permitted to send an explanation of its decision.

In beginsel is DNB op grond van de toezichtwetgeving gehouden tot geheimhouding van gegevens over individuele instellingen en is het DNB om die reden niet toegestaan om een toelichting te sturen op haar besluit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het rapport Maatschappelijke effecten afschaffing ov-studentenkaart

An MP asked the minister of Education about the Panteia/Significance report on the effects of abolishing the free public transport card for students, including extra costs, housing, transport demand, and traffic. The minister answered that the report assumes no replacement arrangement, that a new alternative will be designed with transport companies and other ministries, and that the report's negative effects are premature.
What form the arrangement will take exactly and which effects will occur is still unknown.
