Welke vorm het arrangement precies krijgt en welke effecten zich zullen voordoen, is nog onbekend.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht ‘Hoge salarissen bankiers drukken kredietverlening’

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Minister whether high bankers' salaries restrict lending, whether the government will press banks on wage moderation, and whether regulation will be softened while banks lack wage restraint. Minister Dijsselbloem replied that he has raised wage moderation with the Dutch Banking Association, that CAO wages are for unions and employers, and that lending will be monitored with a possible review if credit contracts for several quarters.
If lending is negative for several consecutive quarters or there is an acute sharp contraction in lending, it will be studied whether there are instruments that burden lending less.

Wanneer de kredietverlening enkele opeenvolgende kwartalen negatief zal zijn of er een acuut forse krimp in de kredietverlening optreedt, dan zal bestudeerd worden of er instrumenten zijn die kredietverlening minder belasten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het artikel ‘Banken actief in belastingparadijzen’

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch banks, including state-aided ones, use shell companies in tax havens and what should be done, including on substance rules, transparency and public beneficial-ownership registers. The State Secretary declined to address individual cases, saw no reason to doubt banks' explanations, said existing reporting rules give sufficient transparency, and pointed to ongoing international work in the Global Forum.
Moreover, Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act does not allow me to comment on individual cases.
Overigens staat artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelasting mij niet toe in te gaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht ‘Fiscale trucs onder vuur’

An MP asked the state secretary of Finance about Starbucks paying no UK corporation tax via Dutch structures, whether a Dutch tax arrangement with Starbucks would be published, and how the Netherlands avoids being seen as a tax haven. The government declined to comment on an individual company's tax position citing confidentiality under article 67 AWR, said it finds the Netherlands being labelled a tax haven very undesirable, and committed to supporting international anti-avoidance initiatives while protecting small open economies.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give a judgment on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen Klaver over het bericht "Google houdt 2 mrd weg bij de fiscus"

MP Klaver asked the State Secretary of Finance whether he condemns Google's tax avoidance through the Netherlands, whether tax treaties should be revised, and how the motion on closing avenues for tax avoidance will be implemented. The State Secretary declined to judge an individual company's tax position under the General Tax Act, saw no evidence of unlawful conduct, said treaties aim to avoid double taxation, and pointed to EU and OECD initiatives and a forthcoming letter on the issue.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act does not allow me to give a judgment on the tax position of an individual company.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen staat mij verder niet toe een oordeel geven over de belastingpositie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over het bericht “doof meisje kan geen journaliste worden”.

MPs Klaver and Voortman asked whether a deaf applicant was wrongly denied a place in journalism studies at Hogeschool Utrecht and whether the government would act, including on ratifying the UN disability convention. The state secretary replied that the student was selected, not refused, that the Equal Treatment Act requires reasonable adjustments, that the Commission for Equal Treatment can be called in, and that ratification work and a cost-benefit study are ongoing.
The Equal Treatment Act on grounds of disability or chronic illness prohibits making a distinction on grounds of disability or chronic illness.
De Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte verbiedt onderscheid te maken op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaver en Dibi over "het bericht dat de werkloosheid sterk is toegenomen"

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in unemployment to 510,000 and rising youth unemployment, asking for extra measures, a European youth guarantee and a special Eurotop. The minister replied that the rise is mainly due to weak growth and expected to continue until 2014, that budget consolidation and structural reforms are the answer, and that the youth unemployment level compares well within Europe.
Only with a strong and healthy economy can employment grow.
Alleen met een sterke en gezonde economie kan de werkgelegenheid groeien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht "DUO gaf foute voorlichting zieke student"

MP Klaver asked the state secretary for Education about reports that DUO gave wrong information to a sick student about the long-study penalty, asking the cause, how to correct it, and whether affected students would be informed. The state secretary acknowledged the report, attributed the errors to rapid administrative changes and a late law amendment, said the website is now correct and erroneous information has been corrected, and stated that DUO will provide correct tuition indications to institutions so they can refund overpaid fees.
Where DUO has given incorrect information, this has now been corrected.
Waar DUO onjuiste informatie heeft gegeven, is dit inmiddels gecorrigeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over onderzoek naar de Libor- en Euriboraffaire

An MP asked the finance minister whether Dutch supervisors are investigating possible Dutch bank involvement in manipulating Libor and Euribor and whether they have sufficient powers to act. The minister answered that DNB and the AFM are jointly investigating with foreign authorities, that DNB has adequate prudential powers, and that criminal prosecution options are limited until EU rules are extended to benchmark manipulation.
DNB has invited the AFM to take part in the investigation, given the AFM's expertise on the conduct of financial institutions and its knowledge of market abuse.

DNB heeft de AFM uitgenodigd aan het onderzoek deel te nemen, vanwege de expertise van de AFM op het gebied van gedrag van financiële instellingen en haar kennis van misbruik op de financiële markten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht dat ECB president Draghi lid zou zijn van een lobbygroep van grote banken

Green Left MP Klaver asked the Finance Minister about reports that ECB President Draghi was a member of the Group of Thirty, a bank lobby group, and whether he could keep functioning during an ombudsman investigation. The minister confirmed the reports, described the Group of Thirty as a discussion forum, and said he had full confidence in the ECB and would await the ombudsman's decision.
I have full confidence in the European Central Bank and its management and await with interest the decision of the European Ombudsman.
Ik heb alle vertrouwen in de Europese Centrale Bank en haar directie en wacht met belangstelling het besluit van de Europese ombudsman af.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dibi en Klaver over werkgevers die particuliere recherchebureaus inschakelen

MPs Dibi and Klaver asked ministers whether private detective agencies hired by employers are inadequately supervised after licensing, whether this violates employees' privacy, and whether such agencies should access government databases. Minister Opstelten replied that a risk-based police inspection and a privacy-focused CBP supervision effort are being strengthened, that privacy violations are for courts to judge, and that private detectives get no access to the municipal population register or sensitive vehicle registry data.
In consultation with the police and the CBP, I am examining how supervision of compliance with privacy rules by private detective agencies can be strengthened.
In samenspraak met politie en CBP onderzoek ik op welke wijze het toezicht op de naleving van de privacyregels door particuliere recherchebureaus kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht dat 1 op de 5 werknemer flexwerker is

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports that one in five employees is a flex worker, the reasons for growth, effects on pensions and training, and whether the law still treats permanent contracts as the norm. The minister acknowledged the rise, said permanent contracts remain the norm in law and practice, and pointed to pending labour market reform measures.
Given the caretaker status of this cabinet, I will leave any further measures to a subsequent cabinet.
Gezien de demissionaire status van dit kabinet laat ik eventuele extra maatregelen over aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het nieuwsbericht dat de werkloosheid sterk is toegenomen

MP Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister of Social Affairs about press reports of a sharp rise in unemployment to 489,000 (6.2%) in April 2012, whether it signals a worrying trend, what measures caused it, and whether extra measures for young people and over-55s are planned. The minister answered that the rise is a bad sign but unemployment is relatively low in the eurozone context, that monthly figures are sample-based and cautiously read, that the cause is the economic downturn rather than identifiable measures, and that existing policy (including the 2013 budget agreement and dismissal law reform) is considered sufficient without additional youth- or older-worker measures.
Given the policy already initiated and announced, the cabinet considers additional measures specifically for young people or older workers unnecessary.
Het kabinet acht gegeven het ingezette en aangekondigde beleid additionele maatregelen, specifiek voor jongeren of ouderen, niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen Klaver en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht ten aanzien van de notulen van de onderraad

MPs Klaver and Peters asked why the government will not release minutes of the subcommittee (onderraad) on Olympic Games information, despite the health minister saying she would like to send them. The Prime Minister replied that confidentiality under the Council rules of procedure (art. 26) applies, that no waiver will be granted, and that the government's information duty is not to be read broadly.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen Klavers en Peters over de geheimhoudingsplicht van de notulen van de onderraad

Klaver and Peters asked whether the confidentiality rules of the ministerial council (artikel 26 Reglement van Orde) justify withholding the minutes of the onderraad on the Olympic Games, and whether the minister would grant a waiver. The government confirmed the rule allows waiver but answered that confidentiality of council deliberations is a state interest limiting parliamentary information, and gave no commitment to release the minutes.
Preserving this confidentiality is a state interest that limits the provision of information to parliament.
Bewaring van deze vertrouwelijkheid is een belang van de staat dat de informatievoorziening aan het parlement begrenst
Antwoord vragen El Fassed en Klaver over het gebrek aan open standaarden in het voortgezet onderwijs

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the education minister about the lack of open standards in secondary education, including use of NL-LOM and e-portfolio standards, Magister software access problems and whether accreditation covers digital accessibility. The minister answered that schools bear responsibility under a 'high trust' pas-toe-of-leg-uit principle, cited NOiV activities and Kennisnet/EduStandaard support, and declined further dedicated studies, while promising a round-table discussion on Magister.
National government policy on open standards is based on a 'high trust' principle.
Het rijksbrede beleid ten aanzien van open standaarden is gebaseerd op een «high trust»-principe.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over het onderwerp de uitlating van de Amsterdamse korpschef dat boerkadragers niet altijd beboet zullen gaan worden

An MP asks the ministers whether the Amsterdam police chief's remark that face-covering (boerka) wearers will not always be fined is acceptable, and whether he has taken note of the minister's pledge to enforce the ban loyally. The minister confirms awareness of the article, restates that police must always enforce the law, and states there is no doubt the police will enforce the ban once it takes effect.
The police must at all times enforce the law.
De politie dient te allen tijde de wet te handhaven.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over voorlichting homoseksualiteit op scholen waarin de homoseksuele praktijk veroordeeld wordt (ingezonden

Two GreenLeft MPs asked the education minister about the EenVandaag broadcast on the 'Wonderlijk gemaakt' lesson method, which condemns homosexual practice, and whether schools can offer a safe climate for gay pupils. The minister replied that schools have freedom in curriculum design within core goals, that they must still ensure a safe climate and respect, that the Inspectorate monitors this, and that the ministry is in talks with the reformed school association and will add sexual diversity to the core goals.
This means that all pupils and teachers should feel safe at their school, regardless of the school's direction or denomination. The Inspectorate monitors this.
Het staat hiermee voorop dat alle leerlingen en leraren zich op hun school veilig zouden moeten voelen, ongeacht de richting of grondslag van de school. De Inspectie ziet hierop toe.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het overzicht Financiële stabiliteit van DNB en de antwoorden van de minister van 18 november 2011 (ingezonden 25 november

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister about DNB's November 2011 financial stability overview, which estimates that pension funds need about 200 billion euros to reach required own funds, and about the effects of year-end interest rates and recovery plans. The minister answered that funds must recover within legal frameworks, that the cabinet will consult social partners in summer 2012, and that the decline in coverage ratios is mainly due to interest rates, equity markets and longevity rather than past underpayment of premiums.
Vragen van het lid Van Klaveren (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de oproep van Turken om meer te gaan rellen tegen Koerden (ingezonden 26 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether he shares the view that Turkish calls for riots against Kurds are an import problem caused by mass immigration, and what measures he will take against such calls to violence. The minister acknowledged the article, said Dutch society is open and that conflicts abroad are felt domestically, declined to adopt the 'mass immigration' framing, and said no measures would be taken because public order is primarily a local responsibility and no request for national assistance had arisen.
When it comes to enforcing public order, this is primarily a responsibility of the local authority.
Als het gaat om handhaving van de openbare orde dan is dit primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale autoriteit.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «Helft pensioenfondsen onvoldoende gedekt, «drastische» stappen nodig» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that half of pension funds are underfunded and whether cuts or premium rises are needed in spring 2012, and how falling rates and the euro crisis relate. The minister confirms about 200 funds had a coverage shortfall, says over 100 may not recover within their recovery plans and may cut pensions from April 2013, attributes the decline mainly to falling interest rates, longer life expectancy and stagnant markets, and presents the pension accord's contractual adjustment rules as an improvement.
I regard this as an improvement.
Ik beschouw dit als een verbetering.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat het aantal deeltijdstudenten sterk gedaald is (ingezonden 25 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary for Education whether part-time student enrolment has fallen sharply and whether an exception to the long-term student rule should have been created for part-time students. The state secretary says the figures are only pre-enrolments, outlines several measures in the Strategic Agenda, and says he will monitor the effects of the long-term student rule including on part-time enrolment.
I will monitor the effects of the long-term student measure, including its effect on participation in part-time programmes.
Daarnaast ga ik de effecten van de langstudeerdersmaatregel monitoren, inclusief het effect hiervan op de deelname aan deeltijdopleidingen.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht «pensioenfondsen rekenen zich rijk» (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether allowing pension funds to discount liabilities at expected returns risks overstating funding and forcing indexation at the expense of current workers, and whether this should be reconsidered after expert criticism. The minister answers that the pension accord aims for evenly distributed burdens across generations, that the disconnect rate will be set in the new pension contract drawing on the CPB study, and that no reconsideration is planned.
There is no question of reconsideration, because as I already indicated in answer 3, the starting point of the pension accord is that burdens and benefits are distributed evenly across generations.
Van heroverweging is geen sprake, want zoals ik al heb aangegeven in antwoord 3 is het uitgangspunt van het pensioenakkoord dat lusten en lasten evenwichtig over generaties worden verdeeld.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bereiken van het subsidieplafond van projectsubsidies uit hoofde van het «Beleidskader Sport en Be

Two Green Left MPs asked the health minister whether the subsidy ceiling for the 'private interventions' sport-in-neighbourhoods scheme had been reached in 2011 and why the website still referred to applications. The minister confirmed the ceiling was reached, said 117 applications were received with 12 granted and 105 rejected, and declined to raise the budget, pointing to a new programme for 2012-2016.
No, I do not intend to increase the budget.
Nee, ik ben niet van plan het budget te verhogen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht over het bepalen van de marktwaarde van pensioenen door de hoogleraren Lans Bovenberg, Sweder van Wijnbergen, T

Rep. Klaver (GroenLinks) asks the Social Affairs minister about professors' criticism that individual pension property rights are undefined, that the discount rate could push funds into riskier investments at the expense of younger members, and that the 10-year smoothing period could leave too little for young people. The minister acknowledges the need for an equitable intergenerational distribution, points to research due end February 2012 and a forthcoming framework note, but does not commit to adopting the specific proposals.
This aspect will be taken into account in the further elaboration of the pension agreement.
Dit aspect zal bij de nadere uitwerking van het pensioenakkoord worden meegewogen.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het gebrek aan open standaarden in het voortgezet onderwijs (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

GroenLinks MPs asked the education minister about the lack of open standards in secondary education, including the Magister system and whether it forces Windows purchases, and about whether open standards should be mandatory. The minister answered that open standards are encouraged through the NOiV action plan and existing comply-or-explain rules, but that schools' autonomy means a binding obligation would not be appropriate.
An obligation would therefore not be appropriate.
Een verplichting zou dus niet gepast zijn.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD), Vermeij (PvdA), Ulenbelt (SP), Klaver (Groenlinks), Koolmees (D66), Schouten (ChristenUnie), Dijkgraaf (SGP), Van den Besselaar (PVV) en Thieme (Partij

Ten MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about a reported 450 million euro fee paid by pension funds (PME and another fund) to Mn Services for asset management, and about transparency and remedies for members. The minister said the fee passage in the court ruling contained a typo, that supervisors alone may request such information and are bound by confidentiality, that members can raise concerns with the accountability body and as a last resort the Ondernemingskamer, and that a cost-reporting guideline is due in November 2011.
The Pension Act provides that only the supervisors, DNB and AFM, have the authority to request information from pension funds.
In de Pensioenwet is bepaald dat alleen de toezichthouders, DNB en AFM, de bevoegdheid hebben om informatie op te vragen bij pensioenfondsen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de berichtgeving dat de helft van de 330 000 bijstandsgerechtigden kinderen heeft (ingezonden 20 juni 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that half of the 330,000 welfare recipients have children, the effects of childcare cuts and the Wet werken naar vermogen on welfare numbers, and child poverty. The state secretary says the figure includes adult children, that the policy focus is on work, that childcare allowances remain largely intact, that a poverty trap for single parents is being addressed, and that a SCP study on long-term effects of child poverty will follow.
The Social and Cultural Planning Office (SCP) has been commissioned to conduct research into the long-term effects of child poverty.
Het Sociaal en Cultureel Planbureau (SCP) is opdracht gegeven onderzoek te doen naar de lange-termijn effecten van armoede bij kinderen.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de doorstroming van hbo-studenten naar de master (ingezonden 25 maart 2011).

Klaver asked whether UvA students taking mandatory pre-master bridging years after a hbo bachelor would be charged contract-student fees up to EUR 9000, and why, and what would be done to prevent deterrence. Secretary Zijlstra confirmed UvA and VU plan higher fees for 2012–2013, said bridging programmes should not carry extra fees except for long one-to-two-year programmes, and promised to contact the institutions.
I will contact the institutions concerned, ask them about their plans and point them to the conduct agreed with VSNU on this matter.
Ik zal contact opnemen met de betrokken instellingen en mij laten informeren over hun voornemens en ze wijzen op de met VSNU afgesproken gedragslijn in dezen.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over zorgplicht van scholen (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

The MP asks the Education Minister about the school duty of care under the proposed inclusive education law, including whether schools can avoid leaving children at home while a suitable place is arranged. The minister answers that the existing school remains responsible until another school accepts the child, that cooperation partnerships can support schools, and that schools should be able to offer every child suitable provision.
Until another school is willing to enrol the pupil, the current school remains responsible for the education.
Totdat een andere school bereid is gevonden de leerling in te schrijven, blijft de huidige school verantwoordelijk voor het onderwijs.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht van de ombudsman dat de Belastingdienst 6 miljoen euro ten onrechte niet uitbetaalt aan buitenlandse pens

MPs Klaver and Braakhuis asked the state secretary of Finance about the ombudsman's report that the Tax Authority wrongly withholds 6 million euros from foreign pensioners, and how the Tax Authority can decide itself whether to apply a law. The state secretary said the Tax Authority refunds amounts on its own initiative, that for 2010 it will use file matching, and that since 2006-2009 claimants must request refunds, with CVZ referring complaints and websites updated, plus talks with CVZ about a mailing.
Every government organisation is obliged to respect the rights of citizens.
Elke overheidsorganisatie is gehouden om de rechten van burgers te respecteren.

Vragen van de leden Voortman en Klaver (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de legitimatieplicht bij de verkoop van alcoholische dranken (ingezonden 11 maart 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about a CNV survey on age-verification duties for alcohol sales, including reported aggression toward supermarket staff and whether mandatory safety training is being given. The minister answered that the survey does not address enforcement of age checks, that available data point to incidents rather than a structural problem, and that employers are responsible for staff protection under the Arbo law.
On the basis of the available data I can only conclude that there seems to be more a question of incidents than of a structural problem.
Op grond van de beschikbare gegevens kan ik niet anders dan concluderen dat er eerder sprake lijkt te zijn van incidenten dan van een structureel probleem.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over een tussenoplossing voor stageproblemen voor illegale leerlingen (ingezonden 8 december 2010).

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the promise to end the work-permit requirement for stages in regular education will be carried out, and whether an interim solution would spare employers fines and let illegal students do internships. The minister replied that illegal residents may not work in the Dutch labour market, so the cabinet sees no need for them to do stages, while the right to theoretical education remains.
Therefore the cabinet considers it unnecessary for these foreigners to do an internship and complete their education with a diploma that qualifies them for the Dutch labour market.
Daarom acht het kabinet het niet noodzakelijk dat deze vreemdelingen stage lopen en de opleiding afronden met een diploma dat kwalificeert voor de Nederlandse arbeidsmarkt.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66), Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA), De Rouwe (CDA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de boeten rond de bijve

MPs asked the state secretary about DUO's letters to about 20,000 students who exceeded the income limit for study grants in 2008, the switch to gross income, appeal options, repayment of OV-card costs and possible hardship relief. The state secretary said the number fits a rising trend, that appeals against DUO decisions are possible while the income figure itself must be contested with the tax authority, and that no hardship scheme is planned.
I see no possibilities to arrive at a hardship scheme for this group.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om voor deze groep tot een coulance-regeling te komen.

Vragen van de leden Ulenbelt (SP), Ortega Martijn (ChristenUnie), Klaver (GroenLinks) en Hamer (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over machtsmisbruik, intimidatie en falende leiding bij d

Four MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs about alleged abuse of power, intimidation and failed leadership at the sheltered workplace Pauw Bedrijven, including what workers can do and what measures will prevent such abuses. The state secretary answered that this is a matter for the employer, works council, union and local authorities, that an independent investigation has been commissioned, and that no further measures or known signals elsewhere exist.
This concerns a matter for the implementing organisation and the administrators involved.
Dit betreft een kwestie van de uitvoeringsorganisatie en de betrokken bestuurders.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat het vleesverwerkingsbedrijf VION te Enschede geen Nederlandse uitzendkrachten meer wil inhuren (ingezonden

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that VION in Enschede would stop hiring Dutch temporary agency workers because workers from other EU countries are cheaper, asking how many such workers there are and what action will be taken. The minister said the choice of agency is for the company, that the number of EU agency workers is not known, and that posted workers are entitled to the hard core of Dutch collective agreement conditions.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over pensioenregelingen (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether pension insurers' administrative errors reported by DNB, and the complexity of pension schemes, are unacceptable, and whether the government will push for simplification in the pension negotiations and reduce administrative costs for small firms. The minister acknowledged the errors, supported DNB's request for an action plan, said simplification is for social partners to propose, and pointed to ongoing ministry consultations on wider use of the policy administration to reduce burdens.
I endorse the request DNB made to insurers to draw up an action plan setting out how the shortcomings will be corrected in the short term.
Ik onderschrijf het verzoek dat DNB heeft gedaan aan verzekeraars een plan van aanpak op te stellen waarin wordt aangegeven hoe op korte termijn de onvolkomenheden worden gecorrigeerd.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het vangnet voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp-ers) (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

Klaver (GroenLinks) asked the minister whether the safety net for self-employed workers (zzp-ers) is adequate, given hidden hardship after the crisis, low uptake of the Bbz benefit, pressure to use pensions before accessing Bbz, and limited debt relief for self-employed people. The minister replied that self-employment income naturally tracks the economy, that most entrepreneurs have buffers, that the government promotes Bbz awareness via municipalities and a website, and that the SER-advice response on pensions and debt relief will come before April.
There is no information known about the degree of non-use of the Bbz.
Er is geen informatie bekend over de mate van niet-gebruik van het Bbz.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het voornemen van het Uitvoeringsinstituut WerknemersVerzekeringen (UWV) om de helft tot tweederde van de 130 vesti

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that UWV may close half to two-thirds of its 130 offices due to cabinet cuts, and whether face-to-face service and client support would be preserved. The minister replied that cuts must be made, that fundamental choices including office numbers and e-service are being considered, and that plans will be sent to parliament in spring.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut (SP) en Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de mislukte onderhandelingen van de schoonmakers en DUO en de Belasting

MPs Karabulut and Klaver ask whether it is acceptable that DUO and the Belastingdienst's move to a new Groningen building leads to cleaners losing jobs or worse terms, and about related contracting and the Schoon genoeg covenant. Minister Kamp answers that the cleaning is the responsibility of the private consortium and its cleaning contractor ISS, that the state is not responsible for dismissals, and that talks between the companies are ongoing.

It is therefore not up to the state services DUO and Belastingdienst but to ISS Nederland BV, engaged by Bouwcombinatie DUO2 VOF, to determine whether, and to what extent, cleaning staff are needed for maintaining the office building.

Het is dan ook niet aan de rijksdiensten DUO en Belastingdienst maar aan het door Bouwcombinatie DUO2 VOF ingeschakelde ISS Nederland BV om na te gaan of, en zo ja in welke mate, schoonmaakpersoneel nodig is voor het onderhoud van het kantoorgebouw.
Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de erkenning van freelancers door het Vervangingsfonds (ingezonden 1 december 2010).

An MP asks whether freelancers are excluded from reimbursement by the Vervangingsfonds for teacher replacement and whether this deters freelancers from education, and asks what steps will be taken. The minister confirms that freelancers cannot be reimbursed for replacing teachers (though they can for support staff), has no data on numbers, sees no broad need, and refers the matter to the Fund's board, which wants CAO regulation of freelancers first.
For teachers, however, the Vervangingsfonds does not provide for funded replacement through hiring freelancers.
Voor leerkrachten geldt echter dat het Vervangingsfonds niet voorziet in bekostigde vervanging door middel van het inhuren van freelancers.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Zelfstandigen Zonder Personeel (zzp-ers) in Amsterdam zich slecht

MP Klaver asked the ministers whether they knew that many self-employed without staff in Amsterdam lack health, disability and pension insurance, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledged the figures, said the government is pursuing legislation to trace uninsured people and that regional data on disability and pension coverage is not available, deferring broader policy to the cabinet response to an SER advisory report.
I do not know how many of these uninsured people are self-employed without staff, or what the reasons of the uninsured self-employed are for not meeting their legal obligation.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel van deze onverzekerden zzp'er zijn of wat de overwegingen van de betreffende onverzekerde zzp'ers zijn om niet aan hun wettelijke verplichting te voldoen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat vier op de tien jongeren onder de 24 jaar moeilijk aan de bak komen (ingezonden 1 november 2010).

Klaver asked the minister whether the Manpower report showing four in ten under-24s struggle to find work reflects a failure of the youth unemployment action plan and whether the plan should be changed. The state secretary rejected the four-in-ten claim as not supported by data, cited falling youth unemployment and plan results, and said the plan would not be adjusted before its 2011 end.
The conclusion that four in ten young people have difficulty finding work is not recognised.
De conclusie dat vier op de tien jongeren moeilijk aan de bak komt, wordt niet herkend.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Financiën over tekortschietende fiscale stimulering leerwerkbedrijven bij kleine ondernemingen (ingezonden 27 oktober 20

An MP asked whether the Wet Afdrachtvermindering Onderwijs unintentionally excludes small firms and self-employed people without staff, and whether the government will act on the Hoofdbedrijfschap Ambachten advice. The state secretary answered that the exclusion is an inherent, expected consequence of a tax instrument under the 'no taxes no gains' principle, that no change is currently warranted, and that the advice's alternatives would raise costs and create inequality.
As long as it is a fiscal instrument there is no reason to now revisit the choice made and the consequences attached to it.
Zolang er sprake is van een fiscaal instrument is er geen aanleiding om thans op de gemaakte keuze en de daaraan verbonden consequenties terug te komen.

Vragen van het lid Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht «Kabinet geeft FIFA ongekende privileges en overtreedt de regels» (ingezonden 12 augustus 20

Green Left MP Klaver asked ministers of Finance and Health about reports that the cabinet granted FIFA extraordinary tax privileges and whether the World Cup bid book would be published. The government answered that the bid book is owned by the Dutch and Belgian football associations but was sent to parliament after the KNVB raised no objection, that FIFA would be compensated for VAT not otherwise paid, and that the tax forgone could reach a maximum of 300 million euros.
Whether or not (fully) publishing the bid book is therefore primarily reserved for the two football associations.
Het al dan niet (volledig) openbaar maken van het bidbook is dan ook primair voorbehouden aan beide voetbalbonden.

m: Motie van het lid Léon de Jong c.s. over maatregelen om te voorkomen dat mensen met een WIA-, WW- of Wajong-uitkering een lagere uitkering ontvangen dan waar men recht op heeft
Asks the government to take measures so that people entitled to WIA, WW or Wajong benefits do not receive a lower benefit due to rigid calculations.
requests the government to take measures to prevent people entitled to a WIA, WW or Wajong benefit from receiving a lower benefit through rigid calculations than they are entitled to

verzoekt de regering maatregelen te treffen ter voorkoming dat mensen die in aanmerking komen voor een WIA-, WW- of Wajong-uitkering door rigide berekeningen een lagere uitkering ontvangen dan waar men recht op heeft
